column2: void field_3d_start_backdrop_transition(int dir, int id, void *done_cb, int arg)
column3: Starts the backdrop change-over task: for id 0x169c (5788, Final Countdown) field_3d_create_final_countdown_transition_task(dir, done_cb, arg), otherwise field_3d_create_backdrop_transition_task(dir, done_cb, arg); the task calls done_cb at its end. dir is 1 when the old backdrop leaves, 0 when the new one enters (field_3d.md). Side effects: creates a task. Callers: 2 (field_3d_backdrop_request, field_3d_backdrop_update).

Callers: 1 (field_3d_cutin_default_on_motion_start, motion 0xe7).

column2: void field_3d_board_move_object(ushort dest_code, uint src_code, int instance, int kind)
column3: Moves the 3D card object of a card between zones. Location codes are u16 (bit 0 side, bits 1..5 zone, bits 6..13 index, bits 14/15 orientation); a zone-0 code with index below 5 is normalised to zone = index. Finds the object in the source zone (field_3d_board_get_zone_object index 0, then by instance +0x88; a zero instance is filled in). If the object is still moving (+0x70 < +0x74) and neither +0x8d bit 7 nor +0x8e bit 0 is set, or it carries busy flags (+0x8c bits 1, 6, 7 or +0x8d bit 0), the move is queued: destination +0x78, kind +0x7c, +0x8c bit 0, presentation flag 0. Otherwise: for sources in zones 0x0c..0x0f refreshes the start transform, relinks the object into the destination zone list, copies the code into +0x82 and +0x84, computes the target transform (field_3d_board_get_location_transform), sets +0x8d bit 3 for a hand destination whose bit 14 is set; kinds 5 and 7 (and 8 or +0x8d bit 4) jump at once (duration 0x098c4be8, immediate update, field_3d_start_card_travel_fx), other kinds animate over ui_get_card_motion_duration. Clears +0x8c bit 2, updates the field cursor and, in the Battle Phase (3) for kind != 6 into a monster zone, resets that side's zone value tween. Returns nothing. Side effects: zone lists, the card object, presentation flags. Callers: 6 (ui_cmd_move_card, ui_cmd_swap_field_cards, ui_cmd_change_card_position, field_3d_board_gather_monster_objects, ...).

column3: Draws one glow sprite of field_3d_update_cutin_extra_a_fx in screen space: sets the colour from rgb[0..2] (red, green, blue words) and alpha; builds translate(position) x camera_rotation on the GUM stack, reads it back (system_vfpu_matrix300_store_q) and multiplies it by view_projection; transforms the two corner points corners[0] and corners[1] (vec4 each), projects them to screen (x 240/w + 2048, -y 136/w + 2048), returns without drawing when a point falls outside 0..0x1000, otherwise subtracts the screen offset (0x710, 0x778) and draws a sprite spanning the two points (system_ge_set_sprite_extent with a 16 x 16 source, system_ge_draw_sprite_flipped at texture coordinates (0x28, 8)) when it has positive width and height. Returns the advanced display list. sceVfpu matrix calls read from the Ghidra pseudo-ops; lower confidence. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (field_3d_update_cutin_extra_a_fx).

Draw-task callback of the per-character extra cut-in effect A: a flickering glow traced along the bones of the duelist model in the main scene. Task data: +0 wait counter, +4 start frame, +8 elapsed, +0xc length (-1 = endless), +0x10 fade-in flag (all from field_3d_get_cutin_fx_timing_extra_by_character), +0x14 frame counter, +0x18 fx slot, +0x1c/+0x20/+0x24 colour and +0x28 fx texture (character 2 variant 2: 0x7f, 0, 0x7f, texture 0xd; character 0x2b: 0xff, 0x7f, 0, 0xf; character 0xc: 0x9b, 0xc8, 0xff, 0xd; others 0xff, 0xc8, 0x9b, 0xf), +0x30..+0x6c five corner pairs (half sizes 7/12/17/60/65 for characters 2 and 0x2b, else 5/10/15/20/25), +0xd0.. random phases. Once started it reads node positions of the main scene model (field_3d_get_main_scene_node_position with node lists at 0x098d00f0, 0x098d0120, 0x098d0130, 0x098d0138, 0x098d0148), interpolates points along the segments between them (system_vfpu_vector3_lerp) and draws a glow sprite at each with field_3d_draw_cutin_extra_a_screen_quad, alpha 150 (or 255 for some) x fade-in over 8 frames (when the flag is set) x fade-out over the last 16 frames (when the length is not -1), flickering with sin(phase + k x frame counter); the camera is the cut-in's projection x view matrix. VFPU code read from the Ghidra pseudo-ops; lower confidence. With length -1 it always returns 2 (it runs until removed); otherwise 2 while elapsed < length, else 4; counters advance only while the slot's run flag (+4) is 1. Side effects: GE commands on layer 8, the task data. No direct caller (draw-task callback registered by field_3d_create_cutin_extra_a_fx through ui_duel_create_draw_task).

column2: int field_3d_create_cutin_extra_c_fx(void *fx_slot, int task_arg_a, int task_arg_b)
column3: Creates the draw task field_3d_update_cutin_extra_c_fx with ui_duel_create_draw_task(callback, task_arg_a, task_arg_b, 0xfc bytes) and stores fx_slot (cut-in effect slot, table 0x098e937c) at task data +8. Returns the task handle, or -1 when no task entry was free. Side effects: allocates a task entry and its data. Callers: 1 (field_3d_start_cutin_extra_fx).

Draw-task callback of the per-character extra cut-in effect C, a fixed 0x3c-frame effect. Task data: +0 elapsed, +4 frame counter, +8 fx slot, +0xc two copies of a 4-vertex full-screen quad (through-mode vertices: colour, 16-bit x, y, z; vertex type 0x80011c) chosen by frame parity, +0x6c a 20 x 20 flash fan. Pushes the main camera matrices; reads two node positions of the main scene model (node ids at 0x098d0154, field_3d_get_main_scene_node_position), offset by -1/+1 in x and a constant in y. Draws the full-screen quad untextured with a subtractive-style blend, three corners white with alpha 255 x ui_duel_get_fade_out_ratio(elapsed, 0x28, 0x3c) and the fourth with 255 x inverse progress over 0x28 frames; then the fan (centre 0xc8ff00ff, rim 0x00ff00ff, fx texture 3) camera-facing at both node positions, alpha = sine ease over 0x14 frames x ui_duel_ease_cosine_tail(elapsed, 0x28, 0x3c). That the two nodes are the eyes is a hypothesis (confidence low). Returns 2 while elapsed < 0x3c, else 4; elapsed advances only while the slot's run flag (+4) is 1. Side effects: GE commands on layer 8, the task data. No direct caller (draw-task callback registered by field_3d_create_cutin_extra_c_fx through ui_duel_create_draw_task).
Timing of the cut-in effect for animation id 0xe7: start frame 0x53 and length 0xe6; any other id gets 1/1. Side effects: writes the two outputs. Callers: 1 (field_3d_update_cutin_fx_anime7).

Stores the list of cards shown by the animation-0xe7 cut-in effect: count clamped to 0x28 at 0x098e93f0 and the card ids copied to 0x098e93f4 (up to 40 words). Side effects: writes 0x098e93f0 and the id array at 0x098e93f4. Callers: 1 (field_3d_cutin_collect_deck_card_ids).

column2: int field_3d_create_cutin_fx_anime7(void *fx_slot, int task_arg_a, int task_arg_b)
column3: Creates the draw task field_3d_update_cutin_fx_anime7 with ui_duel_create_draw_task(callback, task_arg_a, task_arg_b, 0x670 bytes) and stores fx_slot (cut-in effect slot, table 0x098e937c) at task data +0x18. Returns the task handle, or -1 when no task entry was free. Side effects: allocates a task entry and its data. Callers: 1 (field_3d_start_cutin_fx).

column2: void * field_3d_draw_cutin_fx_card_quads(void *list, int card_id, int alpha, float *position, float *angles, void *front_quad, void *back_quad)
column3: Draws one two-sided card: sets the ambient alpha, pushes the matrix, translates to position, rotates by the XYZ angles, binds the face of card_id (field_3d_dl_bind_card_face_texture(list, card_id, 1)) and draws front_quad (4-vertex strip, vertex type 0x183), binds the card back (card id -1) and draws back_quad, then pops the matrix. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (field_3d_update_cutin_fx_anime7).

Draw-task callback of the cut-in effect for animation id 0xe7: cards of the list at 0x098e93f0/0x098e93f4 (field_3d_set_cutin_fx_card_list) burst out of the character. Task data: +0..+0xc wait/start/elapsed/length (field_3d_get_cutin_fx_timing_anime7), +0x10 frame counter, +0x14 hover counter, +0x18 fx slot, +0x1c sound bits, +0x20 origin-captured flag, +0x24 origin (main scene node 0x17, captured at the start frame), +0x30 front and +0x80 back card quads, +0xd0 one 0x24-byte record per card (direction x/y/z, start angles, spin). Does nothing while the list is empty. Plays sound 0x7a3d at the start frame. First call: gives every card a distinct random radius 15..30 and height -1..1 (random permutations), a direction spread over an arc (fewer than 4 cards) or the full circle, and random start angles and spins. Once started: t = sine ease over 4 frames + k x hover counter; each card moves to origin + direction x t with a parabolic drop (-70 x (t^2/2 - 0.5), clamped at 0) and rotates by start + t x spin, drawn two-sided with field_3d_draw_cutin_fx_card_quads (clip planes off, culling on, depth writes off), followed by 3 fading trail copies at earlier t (alpha 96 x (3 - k)/3). Global alpha = ui_duel_get_fade_out_ratio(elapsed, 8, length). Returns 2 while elapsed < length, else 4; counters advance only while the slot's run flag (+4) is 1. Side effects: GE commands on layer 8, the task data, a sound effect. No direct caller (draw-task callback registered by field_3d_create_cutin_fx_anime7 through ui_duel_create_draw_task).

Timing of the per-character extra cut-in effect B, read from the fx slot's character (+8), variant (+0xc) and animation id (+0x10): character 9: 0xbb -> start 0x1c, 0xba -> 0x23; character 2 variant 0: 0x136 -> 0x65, 0xbb -> 0x1d, 0xba -> 0x25, 0xa2 -> 10; length 0x20 in those cases; other ids of characters 9 and 2/0 -> 1/1. For any other character *out_start is left unchanged and *out_length is set to 0x20. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 1 (field_3d_update_cutin_extra_b_fx).

column2: int field_3d_create_cutin_extra_b_fx(void *fx_slot, int task_arg_a, int task_arg_b)
column3: Creates the draw task field_3d_update_cutin_extra_b_fx with ui_duel_create_draw_task(callback, task_arg_a, task_arg_b, 0x154 bytes) and stores fx_slot (cut-in effect slot, table 0x098e937c) at task data +0x14. Returns the task handle, or -1 when no task entry was free. Side effects: allocates a task entry and its data. Callers: 1 (field_3d_start_cutin_extra_fx).

Draw-task callback of the per-character extra cut-in effect B (two glints on the duelist model in the main scene). Task data: +0..+0xc wait/start/elapsed/length (field_3d_get_cutin_fx_timing_animba_bb), +0x10 frame counter, +0x14 fx slot, +0x18 sound bits, +0x1c and +0x28 two local offsets chosen by character/variant/animation (character 9 ids 0xba/0xbb; character 2 variant 0 ids 0xa2, 0xba, 0xbb, 0x136; zero otherwise), +0x34 and +0xc4 two 20 x 20 flash fans (colours 0xff/0x800000ff, or 0x7f7f00/0x7fff with other centres for character 2). Pushes the main camera matrices; each frame transforms the two offsets by two main-scene nodes (node ids at 0x098d015c, field_3d_transform_point_by_main_scene_node); plays sound 0x7a45 at the start frame; once started draws both fans camera-facing at those points with fx texture 3, alpha = sine ease over 4 frames x ui_duel_ease_cosine_tail(elapsed, 0x18, length). Returns 2 while elapsed < length, else 4; counters advance only while the slot's run flag (+4) is 1. Side effects: GE commands on layer 8, the task data, a sound effect. No direct caller (draw-task callback registered by field_3d_create_cutin_extra_b_fx through ui_duel_create_draw_task).

Animation-cue callback that draws the pulsing duel-disk light of the cut-in character (hypothesis for the disk, confidence medium: it follows the cut-in disc flag). Task data: +0 counter, +4 frame counter, +0x10 attach matrix (attach point 0x2b, every frame), +0x50 brightness (first call: 1.0 unless the slot's animation id is in 0x1da-0x222 or is 0x1c1, 0x228, 0x238, 0x24a, 0x24e, 0x264, 0x296; id 0x1f1 forces 1.0), +0x54 enabled flag and +0x58 height (character 0x11: on, 0.5; characters 0xf, 0x10, 0x12, 0x19, 0x21, 0x25, 0x26, 0x28, 0x2c: off; others on, -0.25), +0x5c and +0x17c two 17-vertex fans of radius 5 x size (size scaled for characters 0x2b, 2 with variant 2, 0xe and 0x13): a cyan one (0xffffff00 centre) and a red one (0xff0000ff centre). When enabled it draws both fans untextured and depth-tested in the attach frame with alpha = brightness x (k1 + k2 x sin(k x frame counter)) x 255, then sets the brightness for the next frame to 1.0 when field_3d_cutin_get_current_disc_flag() is 1, else 0. Always returns 2 (keeps running). Side effects: GE commands on layer 8, the task data. Callers: 1 (ui_tick_anim_cue_task).

Animation-cue callback that flashes a flame burst at an attach point of the cut-in character. First call: attach point 0x2e for animation id 0x81, 0x2d for ids 0xc4-0xd4 and 0x104-0x114 (except 0xce, 0xcf, 0x10e, 0x10f), none (-1) otherwise; with none it does nothing. It waits until the cut-in's group-mask bit 8 (attach 0x2e) or bit 9 or 10 is clear (field_3d_cutin_is_mask_bit_clear on the slot's cut-in +0x14), then sets +0x50 and from then on each frame: plays sound 0x7a19 at counter 0, takes the attach matrix offset by the vector 0x098d0170, and draws with fx texture 3 a 30-unit fan (centre 0xff00aaff) spinning about Y and 24 small flame quads on 6 x 4 spinning rings, alpha = (0.5 + 0.5 x progress over 4 frames) x cosine ease over 16 frames; the counter (+0) stops at 16. Always returns 2. Side effects: GE commands on layer 8, the task data, a sound effect. Callers: 1 (ui_tick_anim_cue_task).

Timing table of the cut-in effect for animation ids 0x1da-0x21e: sets *out_length to 0x18 and *out_sound_frame from a per-id list (for example 0x1da -> 0x59, 0x1e3 -> 0x6c, 0x206 -> 0x1c2, 0x21e -> 0x69), with *out_start = sound frame + 8; exceptions 0x1f5 (0xb9, start 0xbe) and 0x1df (sound -1, start 0xa7). Ids without an entry give 0/1/1. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 1 (field_3d_update_cutin_fx_anim1e3_21e).

column2: void field_3d_get_cutin_sound_fx_timing(int anim_id, int *out_sound_frame, int *out_start, int *out_length)
column3: Timing table of the sound-only cut-in task (field_3d_update_cutin_sound_fx) for animation ids 0x199-0x2b3: sets *out_length to 1, *out_sound_frame from a per-id list (mostly 7, 8, 0xc, 0xe; for example 0x1a3 -> 8, 0x27e -> 0x29) and *out_start = sound frame + 8. Some ids have no sound (-1) and an explicit start: 0x19e -> 0xb, 0x1aa -> 0x1e, 0x1b2 and 0x295 -> 10, 0x1c0 -> 1, 0x23e -> 0xe, 0x24d and 0x29b -> 0, 0x270 and 0x280 -> 0x1c, 0x286 -> 5. Ids 0x1bf, 0x24c and 0x294 write a start value that the final 'start = sound frame + 8' then overwrites, leaving the sound frame at its previous value (0 in a freshly created task). Ids without an entry give 0/1/1. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 1 (field_3d_update_cutin_sound_fx).

Sets the timing used by field_3d_cutin_aux_fx_layer_hook: delay_frames at 0x098e93e0 and fade_frames at 0x098e93e8, and clears the delay counter 0x098e93dc, the fade counter 0x098e93e4 and the sound bits 0x098e93ec. Side effects: writes those five globals. Callers: 1 (field_3d_start_cutin_aux_fx).

column2: int field_3d_cutin_aux_fx_layer_hook(void **list_ref, int arg1, int layer, int arg3, int after)
column3: Model draw hook installed by field_3d_start_cutin_aux_fx (character 0x19 with animation ids 0xce, 0xcf, 0xee, 0xef) that fades in model layer 0xb; any other layer returns 0 untouched. Before drawing (after == 0): enables lighting (GE state 10), disables lights 0-3 (states 11-14), sets the ambient colour to white with alpha = progress(fade counter 0x098e93e4, fade length 0x098e93e8) x 255 and enables blending, and plays sound 0x7a17 once when the delay counter 0x098e93dc reaches the delay 0x098e93e0. After drawing (after != 0): disables lighting, ambient opaque white, blending off, then advances the delay counter up to its limit and afterwards the fade counter up to its limit. Writes the advanced display list back to *list_ref. Returns 1 for layer 0xb. arg1 and arg3 are not used. Side effects: GE commands, the counters, a sound effect. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer: the model draw hook).

Handler of duel draw command 7 (one argument) in the draw command table 0x098d0180: passes its argument unchanged to field_3d_backdrop_request (the decompiler hides the forwarded register; the argument is the field-spell backdrop id per docs/subsystems/field_3d.md) and returns 1. Side effects: those of field_3d_backdrop_request (a pending or started backdrop change). No direct caller (reached through the draw command table 0x098d0180 via ui_dispatch_draw_command).

Clears the three saved view matrices at 0x098e99e0 (0xc0 bytes) and sets each 0x40-byte matrix to identity (system_vfpu_vmidt_q). Side effects: writes 0x098e99e0..0x098e9a9f. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_draw_begin).

Saves the current GUM view matrix (matrix mode 1) into slot index of the saved view matrices at 0x098e99e0 + index x 0x40 (system_vfpu_matrix300_store_q), restoring the previous matrix mode afterwards. Side effects: writes one 0x40-byte matrix. Callers: 3 (field_3d_board_set_camera, field_3d_backdrop_set_scene, field_3d_cutin_apply_camera).

column2: void field_3d_cutin_play_for_card(int slot, int motion, int card_id)
column3: Starts a character cut-in for a card when cut-ins are enabled (ui_is_cutin_display_enabled): selects cut-in slot slot (field_3d_cutin_select_slot; 4 slots of 400 bytes at 0x098d4d60), stores card_id in it (field_3d_cutin_set_card_id, 0 becomes -1) and switches the current cut-in to motion (field_3d_cutin_reset_current). Does nothing when cut-ins are disabled. Side effects: the current cut-in slot 0x098d4d48 and its motion and voice state. Exported; module callers via import stubs: rel_duel_mgr (12: audio_voice_on_duel_start, audio_voice_on_lp_damage, audio_voice_on_card_play, audio_voice_on_spell_trap_activate, ...).

Destroys every cached model instance of the duel object table 0x098d0960 (40 entries of 0x18 bytes, instance at +0x14) with field_3d_destroy_model_instance and clears the pointers; then for each of the two backdrop archive slots at 0x09adcf20 that is in use (+8) clears it, or marks it release-pending (+0x14 = 1) when its +0x10 flag is set. Side effects: frees model instances, writes the table and the archive slots. Callers: 2 (ui_duel_draw_release_all, ui_duel_draw_reset).

Returns the model instance of a duel object (board mat, coin, dice, cursor, ...) from the table 0x098d0960 (40 entries of 0x18 bytes: +0 id, +4 archive flag (-1 = none), +8 TMS member name, +0xc animation member name, +0x10 TMA member name, +0x14 cached instance), found with ui_find_resource_entry. On first use loads the duel archive (ui_load_duel_archive), finds the TMS member and creates the instance: when the animation member starts with 'TGMT' (0x544d4754) it is bound with field_3d_set_animation after field_3d_create_model_instance(tms, 0), otherwise it is passed as the second argument of field_3d_create_model_instance; a TMA member is bound with field_3d_set_tma. Returns the instance, or 0 for an unknown id, a missing archive or a missing member. Side effects: model creation and the cache at +0x14. Callers: 9 (field_3d_board_draw_mat, field_3d_update_deck_shuffle, field_3d_update_dice_roll, field_3d_update_coin_toss, ...).

Returns the loaded field-spell backdrop archive for backdrop_id, or 0 while it is loading or after starting a load. Archive slots: 2 x 0x18 bytes at 0x09adcf20 (+0 id, +4 buffer, +8 in use, +0xc loaded, +0x10, +0x14 release pending), buffers of 0x80000 bytes at 0x09adcf50 + slot x 0x80000. When no slot holds the id, a free slot is claimed and container_load_file(3, "duel/bg/fmagic%04d.ehp" (format at 0x098d1d54) with the id, buffer, 0x80000, field_3d_on_backdrop_archive_loaded, slot) is started; when container_get_file_size reports no such file, id 0 (fmagic0000) is loaded instead. Side effects: claims an archive slot and starts an asynchronous file load. Callers: 3 (field_3d_backdrop_update, field_3d_get_backdrop_members, field_3d_dl_bind_fx_texture).

Finds the in-use backdrop archive slot (0x09adcf20, 2 x 0x18 bytes) holding backdrop_id; if it is not loaded yet but its +0x10 flag is set, marks it release-pending (+0x14 = 1), otherwise clears the slot. Does nothing when no slot holds the id. Side effects: the archive slot. Callers: 1 (field_3d_backdrop_update).

column2: int field_3d_get_backdrop_members(int backdrop_id, void **out_tms, void **out_tmt, void **out_tma, void **out_etc)
column3: Gets the archive of backdrop_id with field_3d_get_backdrop_archive (the id is forwarded in the same register; hidden by the decompiler) and reads the first four words of its 'filelist-ptrs.txt' member (label 0x098d1d6c): the TMS model, TMT animation, TMA texture animation and '-etc' scene TMT pointers. Returns 1 when found; otherwise sets all four outputs to 0 and returns 0. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 1 (field_3d_backdrop_update).

Prepares the cut-in loading slots for count duellists: allocates once a block from the duel-draw heap (system_duel_draw_heap_alloc, 0x483000 bytes, or 0x2ff000 when ui_is_duel_setup_mode_2) kept at 0x09bdd004, resets the slot count 0x09bdcf50 and fills one 0x2c-byte slot per duellist at 0x09bdcf54: +0 character, +4 variant, +0xc base-archive buffer (0x20c00 bytes for generic characters (world_character_is_generic), else 0x4800); for characters other than 1, when no network session is active, +8 cut-in archive buffer placed right after the base buffer and the cursor advanced by 0x17f800 in total. Side effects: heap allocation, the slots and the slot count. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_draw_start_loading).

Frees the cut-in loading block 0x09bdd004 (system_duel_draw_heap_free) and clears every cut-in loading slot (0x09bdcf54, 0x2c bytes each) except its character and variant words. Side effects: heap free, the slots. Callers: 2 (ui_duel_draw_release_all, ui_duel_draw_release_cutins).

For every cut-in loading slot (0x09bdcf54) that is not ready (field_3d_is_cutin_slot_ready): starts the base archive load if it is neither loading (+0x14) nor loaded (+0x1c): path from field_3d_build_cutin_base_archive_path, container_load_file(root 4, path, +0xc buffer, 0x20c00, field_3d_on_cutin_base_archive_loaded, slot). When cut-ins are enabled, the character is not 1, no network session is active and nothing else is pending, also starts the cut-in archive: name from field_3d_get_cutin_archive_name, container_load_file(4, name, +8 buffer, 0x17b000, field_3d_on_cutin_archive_loaded, slot), and sets +0x20 (face and voice still to load) for generic characters and for character 0x29 with a non-zero variant. Side effects: loading flags +0x10/+0x14/+0x20 and asynchronous file loads. Callers: 2 (ui_duel_draw_start_loading, ui_duel_options_mode_update).

Polls the cut-in loading slots (0x09bdcf54): returns 0 while any base archive is loading or not loaded; when cut-ins are enabled, also while any cut-in archive of a character other than 1 (outside network sessions) is loading or not loaded; for a slot that still needs its face texture and voice archive (+0x20) it starts them with field_3d_load_cutin_face_and_voice and returns 0; returns 0 while a face (+0x24) or voice (+0x28) load is running. Returns 1 when everything is loaded. Side effects: may start the face/voice loads. Callers: 2 (ui_duel_options_mode_update, ui_duel_draw_poll_loading).

Returns the cut-in archive buffer (+8) of the loading slot (0x09bdcf54) for (character, variant) when it is loaded (+0x18), else 0 (also when no slot matches). No side effects. Callers: 3 (ui_draw_cutin_speed_lines, field_3d_cutin_load_voice_anim, field_3d_cutin_load_slot_assets).

Returns the base archive buffer (+0xc, the small portrait archive) of the loading slot (0x09bdcf54) for (character, variant) when it is loaded (+0x1c), else 0. No side effects. Callers: 2 (ui_draw_character_portrait, field_3d_cutin_find_bustup_gim).

Load-completion callback of a backdrop archive slot (0x09adcf20 + slot x 0x18, buffer 0x09adcf50 + slot x 0x80000). size < 1 (failure): returns 0 unless a release is pending (then the slot is cleared and 1 returned). size >= 0x80000: reloads 'duel/bg/fmagic0000.ehp' (string 0x098d1d80) into the same buffer with this callback. Otherwise binds the EHP (container_ehp_bind_with_callback(0, buffer)) and looks up 'filelist-ptrs.txt'; a missing list or a zero first entry also reloads fmagic0000; else marks the slot loaded (+0xc = 1, +0x10 = 0) and, if a release is pending (+0x14), clears it. Returns 1 in those cases. Side effects: EHP binding, possibly a new file load, the slot fields. No direct caller (callback passed to container_load_file by field_3d_get_backdrop_archive).

Returns the cut-in archive path for (character, variant): fixed strings for character 0x29 variant 0 (label s_cutin_kagemaru02_a_ehp, 0x098c5f78) and character 0x27 (0x098c5f60); otherwise world_get_character_cutin_name(character, variant) when world_character_exists(character, variant), else the name of variant 0 when that exists, else that of character 2 variant 0. No side effects. Callers: 1 (field_3d_load_cutin_archives).

True when a cut-in loading slot (0x2c bytes, table 0x09bdcf54) needs nothing more: base archive not loading (+0x14 == 0) and loaded (+0x1c); and either cut-ins are disabled (ui_is_cutin_display_enabled() == 0) or the cut-in archive is not loading (+0x10 == 0), loaded (+0x18) and no face/voice work is pending or running (+0x20, +0x24, +0x28 all 0). No side effects. Callers: 1 (field_3d_load_cutin_archives).

Load-completion callback of a cut-in base archive: when size > 0 binds the EHP at slot +0xc (container_ehp_bind_with_callback(0, buffer)), sets loaded +0x1c = 1 and clears loading +0x14. Returns size > 0. Side effects: EHP binding, the slot flags. No direct caller (callback passed to container_load_file by field_3d_load_cutin_archives).

Load-completion callback of a cut-in archive: when size > 0 binds the EHP at slot +8 (container_ehp_bind_with_callback(0, buffer)), sets loaded +0x18 = 1 and clears loading +0x10. Returns size > 0. column3: Loads card data into a 0x218-byte panel by card id (values below 1 become -1): clears the instance +0x208, stores card id at +0x20c and +0x00, name_id at +0x210, save_get_card_value_bits4_6 at +0x04, 0x160000 at +0x08 and, for a real card, card_db kind +0x0c, frame +0x10, ATK +0x14 and DEF +0x18 (-1 when the database value is 0xffff), Type +0x1c, Attribute +0x20, Level +0x24, icon +0x28, and clears +0xf8-+0x107. No return value. Side effects: writes the panel. Callers: 3 (ui_card_info_open_pair_by_card_id, ui_card_info_open_pair_by_instance, ui_card_info_show_card_id).

Loads card data into a 0x218-byte panel from a duel card instance: stores ref at +0x208 (u16), its card id (duel_core_get_card_id_by_ref) at +0x20c and +0x00, 0 at +0x210, then the same card_db fields as ui_card_info_set_card_id (+0x04-+0x28), clears +0xf8-+0x107 and refreshes the live stats. No return value. Side effects: writes the panel. Callers: 3 (ui_card_info_open_pair_by_card_id, ui_card_info_open_pair_by_instance, ui_card_info_show_instance).

True when the two-panel view is not suppressed (0x098d5d08 zero) and a manual (0x098d5d00) or automatic (0x098d5d04) pair is open. No side effects. Callers: 6 (ui_card_info_draw, ui_card_info_close_pair, ui_card_info_scroll_text, ui_card_info_update, ...).

Clears the 0x90-byte field cursor state 0x098d5d20 and puts the cursor on side 0, zone 7 (the middle spell/trap zone) with ui_field_cursor_set(0, 7, 0, 0). No return value. Side effects: writes the cursor state. Callers: 2 (field_3d_board_init_all, ui_init_duel_draw_state).

Moves the field cursor for one d-pad button (0x10 up, 0x20 right, 0x40 down, 0x80 left); ignored while the cursor is locked (0x098d5d58). In the hand (zone 0xb) left/right step through the hand cards (index wraps, count from field_3d_board_count_zone_objects) and the button towards the field leaves the hand for the nearest spell/trap zone (ui_field_cursor_nearest_zone). Elsewhere it moves in the 7 x 7 grid of u16 location codes 0x098ce928 (row stride 0xe; column 0x098d5d44 wraps 0-6, row 0x098d5d48): leaving the grid vertically enters the hand, a grid cell with zone 0x10 is skipped, entering an empty hand restores the old cell (with special jumps from the deck cell), entering a non-empty hand picks the first, last or nearest hand card (ui_field_cursor_nearest_hand_card); the banished cell moves diagonally. column2: void ui_field_cursor_set(int side, int zone, int index, int save)
column3: Places the field cursor on location code side | zone << 1 | index << 6 at 0x098d5d40 (index 0xffff counts as 0, otherwise 10 bits) and sets the dirty flag 0x098d5d54. When save is set and no location is saved yet (0x098d5d4c zero) the previous location is first saved to 0x098d5d50; 0x098d5d4c = save. Updates the grid column/row (0x098d5d44/0x098d5d48): for the hand column 0 and row 6 (side 0) or 0 (side 1), otherwise the cell of the grid 0x098ce928 that holds the same side and zone. No return value. Side effects: field cursor state. Callers: 14 (ui_cmd_open_card_list, ui_cmd_begin_player_input, ui_cmd_move_field_cursor, ui_field_cursor_handle_input, ...).

When a location was saved (0x098d5d4c non-zero) moves the cursor back to it (ui_field_cursor_set with the side, zone and index of 0x098d5d50 and save 0). No return value. Side effects: field cursor state. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_begin_player_input).

Stores the cursor's location code in *out, normalised for the card piles: Extra Deck (0xc) and Deck (0xd) with index 0, Banished (0xf) and Graveyard (0xe) with index = pile count - 1 (the top card, duel_core_view_get_banished_count / _graveyard_count); other zones unchanged. No return value. Side effects: writes *out. Callers: 10 (ui_open_info_panel, ui_field_cursor_mode_update, ui_card_info_refresh_live_stats, ui_field_draw_zone_highlights, ...).

Updates the cursor (ui_field_cursor_update), sets the highlight-owner flag 0x098d5da4 to the cursor side or, when the card at the cursor may be viewed (ui_can_view_card_at_ref) and exists, to its owner's view side (duel_core_engine_side_bit_to_view), then on GE layer 5 with depth test enabled pushes a model matrix translated to the cursor position 0x098d5d20 and rotated by 0x098d5d30 (system_vfpu_matrix_mogrify) and draws the normal or, when locked (0x098d5d58), the locked cursor variant. No return value. Side effects: writes 0x098d5da4, GE commands on layer 5. Callers: 1 (field_3d_board_draw).

Recomputes the cursor transform: in the hand it clamps the index to the hand-object count and copies the position (+0x10) and rotation (+0x40) of that hand card object, or jumps to the nearest spell/trap zone when the hand is empty; elsewhere it takes field_3d_board_get_location_transform of the location. The result goes to 0x098d5d20 (position) and 0x098d5d30 (rotation). When the dirty flag 0x098d5d54 is set it resolves the card under the cursor (top card of the Extra Deck, Graveyard or Banished pile, card 0 of the Deck), shows its instance (object +0x88) in the card information panel, or instance 0 when the card may not be viewed and object byte +0x8d bit 5 is clear, calls each of the 16 listeners at 0x098d5d5c with (location code, instance) and clears the dirty flag. No return value. Side effects: cursor state, card information panel, listener calls. Callers: 2 (field_3d_board_move_object, ui_field_cursor_draw).

When the local player (view side 0) is awaited for input in open input mode 4-9, scans both sides starting with duel_core_view_get_default_target_side, each in the 16-location order of the table 0x098ceba0 (two u32[16] rows, one per side; every hand card for the hand), and puts the cursor on the first card whose action mask (duel_core_view_get_card_action_mask) has a bit of 0x808. No return value. Side effects: field cursor state. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_begin_player_input).

Handles the cursor-jump button by open input mode: mode 1 nothing, mode 2 ui_field_cursor_toggle_hand, otherwise ui_field_cursor_cycle_selectable when any card of either side (locations 0-0xf, every hand card) has an action-mask bit other than 0x402, else ui_field_cursor_toggle_hand. column2: void ui_field_cursor_draw_model(void *list, int location, int variant)
column3: Draws one cursor/highlight 3D model at the current matrix: picks the duel object model by the zone of the location code (piles and field-spell zone 0x10012/0x10013, hand 0x10011 for side 0 or 0x10013, other zones 0x1000e/0x1000f by side; +8 when variant is non-zero), installs the draw-state hooks ui_field_cursor_alpha_test_hook (slot 1) and ui_field_cursor_bind_highlight_texture or, for the variant, ui_field_cursor_animate_texture (slot 0) with field_3d_exchange_draw_state, commits list and draws the model with field_3d_draw_model on the current layer, then reselects that layer. No return value. Side effects: GE commands, model draw-state hooks. Callers: 4 (ui_draw_zone_card_marker, ui_field_cursor_draw_locked, ui_field_draw_zone_highlights, ui_field_cursor_draw_normal).

Registers callback in the first free entry of the 16 cursor-change listeners at 0x098d5d5c (nothing when all are used); ui_field_cursor_update calls each with (location code, instance) when the cursor moves. No return value. Side effects: writes the listener table. Callers: 1 (ui_open_info_panel).

Clears the first entry of the 16 cursor-change listeners at 0x098d5d5c that equals callback. No return value. Side effects: writes the listener table. Callers: 2 (ui_hide_attack_pointer, ui_update_info_panel).

Returns the spell/trap zone (5-9) of side whose board location transform (field_3d_board_get_location_transform) is nearest to the position pos (system_vfpu_vector_distance_t). No side effects. Callers: 2 (ui_field_cursor_handle_input, ui_field_cursor_update).

Returns the index of the hand card object of side (field_3d_board_get_zone_object, zone 0xb) whose position (+0x10) is nearest to pos, or -1 when the hand has no objects. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_field_cursor_handle_input).

column2: int ui_field_cursor_alpha_test_hook(void **list, void *model, int mesh, int material, int after)
column3: Draw-state hook of the cursor models (slot 1, installed by ui_field_cursor_draw_model): before a draw (after = fifth argument, register t0, zero) enables the alpha test with function 6 (greater), reference 0, mask 0xff; afterwards disables it. Writes the advanced display-list pointer back to *list and returns 0. Arguments 2-4 are not used. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).

column2: int ui_field_cursor_animate_texture(void **list, void *model, int mesh, int material)
column3: Texture hook (slot 0) of the variant cursor model: for the material record at *(model + 0xc) + mesh x 0xa4 + material x 0x20 + 0x1c named field_cursor02.iff it binds duel texture 0x40021 + (frame counter / 4) mod 3 (a three-frame animation), enables texturing and writes the texture function, environment colour, wrap, offset and scale from the material record. Writes the advanced list to *list and returns 1, or 0 when the flag is clear, the material does not match or the texture is missing. Side effects: GE commands. Draws the unlocked field cursor: the cursor model for the location 0x098d5d40 (ui_field_cursor_draw_model, variant 0) and, while the field input is not blocked (ui_get_field_input_block_level 0), the 2D overlay sprite (ui_field_cursor_draw_overlay with blink bit 3; alternate placement for side 0's Deck) and, on GE layer 6, the action icons of the card under the cursor (ui_field_cursor_draw_action_icons), then reselects the previous layer. Returns the display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands on layers 5 and 6. Callers: 1 (ui_field_cursor_draw).

Draws the locked field cursor: the cursor model for the location 0x098d5d40 (variant 0) and the overlay sprite in its alternate placement with blink bit 1 (ui_field_cursor_draw_overlay(list, location, 1, 1)). No return value. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_field_cursor_draw).

column2: void ui_field_cursor_draw_overlay(void *list, int location, int alternate, int blink_bit)
column3: Draws the 2D cursor sprite over a field location: for the piles (zones 0xc-0xf) raises the model matrix by field_3d_board_get_pile_height(pile count), projects the origin with the model, view and projection matrices (sceVfpuMatrix4Mul) to screen pixels, picks the sprite source rectangle from the table 0x098ce98c (16 bytes per location index zone + 16 x side; the alternate table at 0x098ce994 and offset (-16, -32) when alternate is set, (-6, -46) for side 0's hand, else (0, -11)), shifts the source by 32 px when frame-counter bit blink_bit is set (two-frame blink), and draws a 32 x 32 sprite of duel texture 0x4001d with the depth mask off and alpha test greater-than 0. No return value. Side effects: GE commands; GUM matrix stack pushed and popped. VFPU code read from the Ghidra pseudo-ops; lower confidence. Callers: 2 (ui_field_cursor_draw_locked, ui_field_cursor_draw_normal).

Draws a row of action icons above the card under the cursor: projects the cursor position plus an offset (0x098cec5c or, when behind the camera, 0x098cec68; none and a (-6, -33) px shift for the Deck) to screen pixels, collects the set bits 0-12 of duel_core_view_get_card_action_mask for the location, and draws one icon per bit with ui_card_action_draw_icon, 14 px apart and centred, 13 px above the point, with blending on and depth test off (re-enabled at the end). No return value. Side effects: GE commands. VFPU code read from the Ghidra pseudo-ops; lower confidence. Callers: 1 (ui_field_cursor_draw_normal).

Plays sound 0x7a04 and toggles the cursor between side 0's hand and the field: in the hand it remembers the hand index in 0x098d5da0 and returns to the field location saved in 0x098d5d9c (or zone 2 of side 0 when that is also the hand); on the field, when side 0 has hand cards, it saves the location to 0x098d5d9c and moves to hand index 0x098d5da0. No return value. Side effects: field cursor state, 0x098d5d9c/0x098d5da0, sound. Callers: 1 (ui_field_cursor_cycle_or_toggle_hand).

Plays sound 0x7a04 and moves the cursor to the next card (side 0 then 1, locations 0-0xf, every hand card) whose action mask has a bit other than 0x402, after the current cursor location; wraps to the first such card. No return value. Side effects: field cursor state, sound. Callers: 1 (ui_field_cursor_cycle_or_toggle_hand).

Stores callback in the first free of the four callback slots at +0x9c of a board card object (nothing when all are used). No return value. Side effects: writes the object. Callers: 2 (ui_start_card_highlight, ui_start_card_target_glow).

Clears the first of the four callback slots at +0x9c of a board card object that equals callback. No return value. Side effects: writes the object. Callers: 4 (ui_stop_card_highlight, ui_stop_card_target_glow, ui_stop_all_card_target_glows, ui_stop_all_card_highlights).
Calls ui_reset_zone_value_tween for both sides and monster zones 0-4. No return value. Side effects: the ATK/DEF display tweens 0x098e6678. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_show_phase_banner).

Starts the ATK/DEF counters of the ten monster zones towards their new values. Each 0x20-byte tween at 0x098e6678 + side x 0xa0 + zone x 0x20 holds shown ATK +0, shown DEF +4, start ATK +8, target ATK +0xc, start DEF +0x10, target DEF +0x14, timer +0x18, duration +0x1c. The new values come from the engine attack state (duel_core_get_attack_state, record per engine side x 0x48: ATK +0x54 and DEF +0x58 when +0x30/+0x34 name this side and zone) when use_attack_state is set, else from duel_core_view_get_card_stats (+0x18 ATK, +0x1c DEF). When a value differs the tween restarts from the shown values with duration ui_get_card_motion_duration; with animation speed above 1 it jumps to the end at once. No return value. Side effects: writes the tweens. Callers: 2 (ui_cmd_on_phase_banner_done, ui_cmd_show_battle_damage).

Returns a factor for the card marker of a zone from k = zone + 16 x side: 1.0 for k = 0x8000, 6.0 for 0x200-0x2000, 4.0 for 0x10-0x100 (every zone of side 1), 2.0 for 0-4 (side 0 monster zones), 1.0 for 5-9 (side 0 spell/trap zones), 0 otherwise (meaning of the factor: hypothesis, confidence medium; only the ranges up to 0x1f are reachable with side 0/1). No side effects. Callers: 8 (ui_draw_zone_card_marker, field_3d_start_destroy_by_battle_fx, field_3d_start_card_release_fx, field_3d_start_summon_fx, ...).

column2: void ui_push_chain_link_marker(int side, int zone, int link_number)
column3: Records that a chain link was activated from a zone: stores link_number in the badge word 0x098e67b8 + side x 0x44 + zone x 4 and pushes the location code side | zone << 1 onto the u16 stack 0x098e6840 (count 0x098e6880). No return value. Side effects: writes those globals. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_show_chain_link_activated).

Pops the top entry of the chain-link location stack 0x098e6840 (count 0x098e6880), clears the badge word of side/zone (0x098e67b8 + side x 0x44 + zone x 4) and, when a lower stack entry names the same side and zone, sets the badge to that entry's position + 1. No return value. Side effects: writes the stack, count and badge words. Callers: 2 (ui_cmd_show_chain_link_resolving, ui_finish_chain_link_resolve_anim).

Sets duel draw flag 0x40 (ui_test_set_draw_flags) when the local player (view side 0) is awaited for input in open input mode 4, 5, 6, 8 or 9, and clears it otherwise; the flag enables the selectable-card highlights. No return value. Side effects: duel draw flags. Callers: 1 (field_3d_board_draw).

Draws the per-card markers and selectable-zone highlights of the board on GE layer 5. For both sides and the 16 locations of the table 0x098cef98 it walks the zone's card-object list (ui_get_zone_list_sentinel): pile objects only while moving (timer +0x70 below duration +0x74), others unless object byte +0x8d bit 4 is set; each is drawn with ui_draw_zone_card_marker (depth function 1 for the hand, 7 otherwise), the hand card under the cursor last, and a location whose marker reports an action is recorded in a per-side mask. Then, for each location, it draws the chain-link number badge for monster zones with a badge (0x098e67b8) and, when draw flag 0x40 is set, the variant cursor model over any unmarked location whose action mask has a bit other than 0x402. Restores the texture function and ambient colour. No return value. Side effects: GE commands; GUM model matrix pushed and popped. Callers: 1 (field_3d_board_draw).

column2: int ui_draw_zone_card_marker(void *obj, int side, int zone, int index)
column3: Draws the overlay card of one board card object and its markers. When draw flag 0x40 is set and the card's action mask (location side/zone/index) has a bit other than 2 it is selectable: it is drawn darkened (ambient 0xff404040, modulate) on alternate 16-frame periods. During a tag-duel partner switch hand cards shrink by 1 - fade and move vertically by -150 or 250 x fade (tag_duel_get_partner_switch_fade). Draws two textured quads with ui_draw_card_texture_quad_scaled (scale ui_get_zone_card_scale; the second rotated by 0x098ceff0 with the card of object +0x80) at the object position +0x10 and rotation +0x40, then the variant cursor model when selectable, and the chain-link badge number (ui_draw_badge_number_at_position) when the zone has a badge and is not the hand. Returns 1 when the card is selectable, else 0. Side effects: GE commands, GUM matrices. VFPU code read from the Ghidra pseudo-ops; lower confidence. Callers: 1 (ui_field_draw_zone_highlights).

On GE layer 7 with depth test off and blending on, binds the digit texture 0x40006 and, for every monster zone 0-4 of both sides, builds the location code with the face-up flag (bit 14, duel_core_view_is_card_face_up_at) and the battle-position bit (bit 15, duel_core_view_get_location_position); when the zone has a card object and ui_is_zone_battle_marker_visible is true it draws the ATK/DEF overlay with ui_draw_zone_battle_overlay at the object's matrix (+0x30). No return value. Side effects: GE commands on layer 7. Callers: 1 (field_3d_board_draw).

Draws the decimal number count (pile count) above the current model position: projects the model-matrix origin raised by field_3d_board_get_pile_height(count) plus a constant (0x098c4bd4) to screen pixels and draws the digits centred, 4 px above, as 7 x 9 sprites of duel texture 0x40006 (source u = digit x 7), with nearest filtering, depth test off and blending on, on GE layer 5. No return value. Side effects: GE commands. VFPU code read from the Ghidra pseudo-ops; lower confidence. Callers: 2 (field_3d_board_draw_piles, field_3d_draw_pile_with_count).

Read from the disassembly (the float argument is in f12): on GE layer 5 sets texture offset (0.5, 0.5), texture scale 1 + tex_value / 64 in both axes and clamped wrapping, binds the card art of card_id & 0xffff (ui_bind_card_art_texture), updates the GUM matrices and draws the shared 4-vertex triangle strip at 0x098cf000 (vertex type 0x183); then restores offset (0, 0), scale (1, 1) and repeat wrapping and commits the layer pointer. No return value. Side effects: GE layer 5 commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_zone_card_marker).

Unlinks and returns the last object of the free list of board card objects (sentinel 0x098e39b0, links +0x00/+0x04), clearing its links; returns NULL when the list is empty. Side effects: writes the free list. Callers: 4 (field_3d_board_build_deck_objects, field_3d_board_rebuild, field_3d_board_create_object_at, field_3d_board_sync_zone).

column2: void ui_set_card_object_motion(float duration, void *obj, float *pos, float *rot, int play_sound)
column3: Starts a move of a board card object: copies the current position +0x10 and rotation +0x40 to the start fields +0x20/+0x50, stores the target position pos at +0x30 and rotation rot at +0x60, resets the timer +0x70 and sets the duration +0x74, clears object flag bits +0x8d bit 6 and +0x8e bit 0. When play_sound is set and start and target differ it plays one of the card sounds 0x7a2f-0x7a33 at random. No return value. Side effects: writes the object, sound. Callers: 6 (field_3d_board_layout_hand_side1, field_3d_board_flip_pile_top_card, field_3d_board_raise_card_to_pile_top, field_3d_board_gather_monster_objects, ...).

Advances a board card object's move. While the timer +0x70 is below the duration +0x74 (or a two-part move, +0x8c bit 7, has not reached twice the motion duration) it adds dt, raises presentation flags (0 busy, 0x1f, 0x38, 0x39 by object flags), lerps the position (system_vfpu_vector4_lerp_xyz) and slerps the rotation (system_quat_slerp) over the duration (halved by +0x8c bit 5), adding an arc 360 x u x (1 - u) to x (+0x8d bit 1, sign by side) or y (+0x8d bit 2), and snaps to the target at the end. When the move is over it handles the completion flags of +0x8c/+0x8d: resynchronises a pile zone (field_3d_board_sync_zone), starts the destroy-by-effect, card-set, summon or placed-summon effects, chains the next move with field_3d_board_move_object(+0x78, +0x82, +0x88, +0x7c), marks the layout dirty, or plays a random card sound 0x7a2f-0x7a33. Runs the object's callbacks (ui_run_card_object_callbacks) after each step. No return value. Side effects: the object, presentation flags, effects, sounds. VFPU code read from the Ghidra pseudo-ops; lower confidence. Callers: 2 (field_3d_board_move_object, field_3d_board_update).

Calls each non-NULL callback of the four slots at +0x9c of a board card object with obj and clears a slot whose callback returns non-zero. No return value. Side effects: those of the callbacks; writes the slots. Callers: 1 (ui_update_card_object_motion).

Returns the list sentinel of the board card objects of a zone: 0x098e3a60 + s x 0xb00 + zone x 0xb0, where s is side, or for the hand, Extra Deck and Deck (zones 0xb-0xd) the word 0x098e6664 + side x 4 (the deck-set index, hypothesis: tag-duel partner, confidence medium). The first object is the sentinel's +0x04 link; the list is empty when that link is the sentinel. No side effects. Callers: 23 (field_3d_board_release_object_at, field_3d_board_layout_hand_side1, field_3d_board_rebuild, field_3d_board_any_object_busy, ...).

Returns the card motion duration for the current animation speed: entry ui_get_anim_speed() of the float table 0x098cf050. No side effects. Callers: 8 (field_3d_board_layout_hand_side1, field_3d_board_flip_pile_top_card, field_3d_board_raise_card_to_pile_top, field_3d_board_gather_monster_objects, ...).

True when the location code names a monster zone (zone below 5), has the face-up bit (bit 14) set and the duel is in phase 3 (Battle Phase, duel_core_get_phase). The object argument is not used. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_zone_markers_battle_phase).

Draws the ATK and DEF numbers of a monster zone during the Battle Phase: projects an offset point (0x098cf060, z mirrored when matrix +8 is negative) through matrix and the view/projection matrices to screen pixels, takes the shown ATK/DEF of the zone's tween (0x098e6678 + side x 0xa0 + zone x 0x20), picks a colour pair from 0x098cf070 or 0x098cf078 by the position bit 15, darkens the colour of a value that is still rising or falling and draws enlarged 8 x 10 digits while a value changes (else 7 x 9), two centred lines (ATK, DEF) from the digit texture with nearest filtering. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: GE commands. VFPU code read from the Ghidra pseudo-ops; lower confidence. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_zone_markers_battle_phase).

Advances the ten monster-zone ATK/DEF tweens 0x098e6678: for each running tween (timer +0x18 below duration +0x1c) adds dt and sets the shown ATK/DEF (+0/+4) to the linear interpolation between start (+8/+0x10) and target (+0xc/+0x14), or to the target when finished. No return value. Side effects: writes the tweens. Callers: 1 (field_3d_board_update).

column2: void ui_draw_badge_number_at_position(float *pos, int pile_count, int number)
column3: Draws a numbered badge (chain-link number) above a board position on GE layer 5: raises pos by field_3d_board_get_pile_height(pile_count) plus a constant (0x098c4bd4) and moves it by -44 on the second axis, projects it to screen pixels with the view and projection matrices, draws the badge sprite of duel texture 0x4001e (source at (0x2e, 0x48)) with blending and the depth test off, and the decimal number at font scale 12 x 12 in white, centred on the point. The callers seen in the decompilation pass only two arguments, so the number register is set by them outside the visible call (hypothesis, confidence medium). No return value. Side effects: GE commands on layer 5, font state. VFPU code read from the Ghidra pseudo-ops; lower confidence. Callers: 3 (ui_field_draw_zone_highlights, field_3d_board_draw_piles, ui_draw_zone_card_marker).

Draws the current HUD layout animation (state 0x098e6898) while it plays (0x098e68dc): optionally switches to the request's GE layer (+0x30) inside its own ehf draw pass, plays the request's .ehf (+0x00) with a 0x60-byte draw block (frame timing, or ui_ehf_get_player_field_1c once the layout has advanced; flags 0x10000; position +0x28/+0x2c), raises the presentation flag of a queued request (0x098e690c) and the request's own flag (+0x1c, when +0x20 is set or the animation speed is below 1), and after the text frame +0x34 draws the duel dictionary word +0x38 (ui_get_duel_dict_word) at font scale 12 centred on (+0x3c, +0x40), its width limited to (480 - x) x 160 / 100 px (Japanese, language 0, without space trimming). Advances the playing HUD layout animation (0x098e6898): steps the frame by 1, or by ui_get_hud_anim_frame_step while not in the hold loop, clamped to the last frame; wraps to the play-range start at the range end and counts the wraps in 0x098e68ec. At the end frame +0x08 (or the layout's last frame) it stops (0x098e68dc = 0), calls the callback +0x14 with argument +0x18 and starts the queued request 0x098e68f0 if one is pending (0x098e68e0). When idle it copies the request to 0x098e6898, sets the play range and seeks the start frame, plays sound +0x24 unless draw flag 8 is set and raises presentation flag +0x1c when +0x20 is set. When one is playing it queues the request at 0x098e68f0 (0x098e68e0 = 1) and raises the queued request's presentation flag. No return value. Side effects: HUD animation state, layout, sound, presentation flag. Callers: 7 (ui_cmd_show_duel_result, ui_cmd_show_phase_banner, ui_cmd_show_turn_change, ui_show_phase_banner, ...).
Copies a 0x44-byte (17-word) HUD layout animation request from src to dest. Returns dest. Side effects: writes dest. Callers: 1 (ui_play_hud_layout_anim).

Stores the low byte of expression as duelist's portrait expression (0x098e6974 + duelist x 4) and resets its timer (0x098e6984 + duelist x 4) when it differs. Returns true when it changed. Side effects: writes those words. Callers: 1 (ui_set_portrait_expression).

Stores duelist's portrait expression (0x098e6974 + duelist x 4) in *out_expression and its timer (0x098e6984 + duelist x 4) in *out_timer. No return value. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_portrait_expression_picker).

column2: void * ui_draw_lp_digits(void *list, int x, int y, int value)
column3: Draws value (clamped to 0-99999) right-aligned as 8-px HUD digits (glyphs 0x22 + digit of the glyph table 0x098cf27c), from x + 0x20 leftwards and not left of x. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_lp_counters).

column2: void * ui_draw_hud_counter_blinking(void *list, int x, int y, int value, int blink)
column3: When value is not negative draws a counter (the turn timer): value clamped to 999; ambient colour half-transparent white when blink is 0, alternating 0xff00ffff/0xff000000 every 8 frames when blinking and value below 31, else white; draws the icon glyph 0x098cf434 at x and the digits (glyphs 0x2d + digit) right-aligned at x + 0x29. column3: Draws the turn number (ui_get_turn_number_for_display, clamped to 999) in black (ambient 0xff000000) as HUD digits (glyphs 0x22 + digit), right-aligned at x + 8, + 0xc or + 0x10 for 1, 2 or 3 digits so the number stays centred. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_duel_hud).

Draws the LP labels of both sides (glyphs 0x098cf51c and 0x098cf524 at x 0x98/0x9f and 0x1a6/0x1ad, y 1) and each side's shown LP (0x098e6938) with ui_draw_lp_digits at the x of the table 0x098cf0b8, y 1, colour 0xff00ffff. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_duel_hud).

When dt is positive, rolls each side's shown LP 0x098e6938 towards its target 0x098e6940: when the target changes it records the start frame 0x098e6958 (frame timing), the start value 0x098e6948 and the new target 0x098e6950, then sets the shown value to the linear interpolation over 60 frames (the target after that). No return value. Side effects: writes 0x098e6938-0x098e695f. Callers: 1 (ui_update_duel_hud).

Plays the turn indicator layout 0x20002 with a frame-timing draw block; outside a match duel (ui_is_not_match_duel non-zero) it sets draw flag bit 3 with colour words 0xffffffbf and 0xffffffff in the block (hypothesis: a colour transform, confidence medium). Returns the advanced display list (list unchanged when the layout is missing). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_duel_hud).

Drives the turn indicator layout 0x20002 from the shown side 0x098e6960 and the target 0x098e6964: side 0 loops frames 0-0x77, side 1 frames 0x82-0xf9; when the target differs the shown side becomes -1 and the transition 0x79-0x80 plays, after which the shown side takes the target and its loop starts. No return value. Side effects: writes 0x098e6960, layout frame. Callers: 1 (ui_update_duel_hud).

Drives the phase indicator layout 0x20003 through its 27 states 0x098e6968 (0-0xc side 0, 0xd-0x19 side 1, 0x1a neutral). Each state has a frame range (start/end pairs at 0x098cf12c/0x098cf130) and a phase (0x098cf0c0); transition states advance to the next state at their end frame (skipping one when the next does not match the target phase 0x098e696c or the turn side 0x098e6964), hold states (odd ones and 0xe-0x18 even) loop their range until the target phase or side changes, states 0xc and 0x19 wrap to the other side's first state unless the target phase is 7, and state 0x1a leaves to state 0 or 0xd by duel_core_view_get_turn_side when a phase is set. No return value. Side effects: writes 0x098e6968, layout frame. Callers: 1 (ui_update_duel_hud).

In a normal duel it draws ui_draw_character_portrait of field_3d_board_get_side_duelist(side) at (x, y) plus the side's offset (table 0x098cf204, 4 ints per side) with its expression (0x098e6974) and timer (0x098e6984); in a tag duel it draws both partners, their positions and scale interpolated by tag_duel_get_partner_switch_fade / 2 and their order by tag_duel_get_partner_switch_progress, the pulse only on the front one when no switch runs. Arguments 5-8 are in t0-t3. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 2 (ui_draw_player_portrait_panel, ui_draw_portrait_expression_picker).

Initialises the duel presentation: field_3d_backdrop_init, ui_card_info_init, ui_field_cursor_init, field_3d_board_init_all, ui_init_hud_layout_anim and ui_init_hud_state. No return value. Side effects: those of the callees. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_draw_begin).

Draws one duel frame: clears GE layer 0 (colour, stencil and depth 0, clear flags 0x17), then by duel draw flags draws the field backdrop (flag 1, field_3d_backdrop_draw), the board (flag 2, field_3d_board_draw), and the HUD and card information panel (flag 4, ui_draw_duel_hud and ui_card_info_draw). Destroys the attack pointer's duel object (0x098e6bc0, ui_destroy_duel_object) when present and clears the 0xc-byte attack pointer state 0x098e6bc0. No return value. Side effects: object destroyed, state cleared. Callers: 1 (ui_term_duel_objects).

Creates the attack pointer (ui_create_attack_pointer, which receives side and zone unchanged in a0/a1) when there is none, otherwise re-places the existing one on its zone (ui_place_attack_pointer_on_zone). No return value. Side effects: attack pointer object. Callers: 1 (ui_move_attack_pointer).
