column2: void ui_move_attack_pointer(int attacker_side, int attacker_zone, int target_side, int target_zone)
column3: Shows the attack pointer on the attacker's zone (creating it if needed) and starts its flight to the target: a target zone above 4 becomes 0xb (the player, direct attack); aims it (ui_aim_attack_pointer_at_zone), sets the pointer data (0x60 bytes at object +0x18): mode +0x20 = 1, attacker location byte +0x24, target location byte +0x26, target position +0x40 from field_3d_board_get_location_transform with height +0x44 = -2.0, start position +0x30 = current position, duration +0x50 = 0.5 / ui_get_anim_speed_factor; installs the update callback ui_update_attack_pointer_tween (object +0xc), clears object +0x14 and raises presentation flag 0xc. No return value. Side effects: attack pointer object, presentation flag. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer; presumably a duel draw command handler).
True when the attack pointer exists and its attacker location byte (data +0x24) names side and zone. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_attack_ready_markers).

Allocates the 0x60-byte attack pointer data from the duel draw heap, stores the attacker location (side, zone) in byte +0x24, creates a duel object with that data (ui_create_duel_object, 0x1c-byte parameter block with the data pointer at +0x18), stores it in 0x098e6bc0 and places it with ui_place_attack_pointer_on_zone. No return value. Side effects: heap allocation, duel object, 0x098e6bc0. Callers: 1 (ui_show_attack_pointer).

Puts the attack pointer on its attacker zone: position (data +0x00) and rotation (+0x10) from field_3d_board_get_location_transform of the location byte +0x24, height raised by 30, mode +0x20 = 0; installs the object callbacks draw ui_draw_attack_pointer (+0x8), update ui_attack_pointer_follow_selection (+0xc) and free ui_free_attack_pointer_data (+0x10), and aims it at the field cursor location (ui_aim_attack_pointer). No return value. Side effects: attack pointer object. Callers: 3 (ui_create_attack_pointer, ui_move_attack_pointer, ui_show_attack_pointer).

Draw callback of the attack pointer duel object: on GE layer 5 binds duel texture 0x40005, loads a model matrix translated to the pointer position (data +0x00) and rotated by its quaternion (data +0x10, system_vfpu_matrix_mogrify), and updates and draws duel object model 0x1001c (field_3d_update_model, field_3d_draw_model) with the depth test off, restoring it afterwards. No return value. Side effects: GE commands; GUM matrix pushed and popped. No direct caller (installed as draw callback +0x8 by ui_place_attack_pointer_on_zone).

Free callback of the attack pointer object: returns data to the duel draw heap (system_duel_draw_heap_free) when it is not NULL. No return value. Side effects: heap free. No direct caller (installed as free callback +0x10 by ui_place_attack_pointer_on_zone).

Update callback of the attack pointer while the player chooses a target: reads the field cursor location (ui_field_cursor_get_location) and aims the pointer at it (ui_aim_attack_pointer(location, 0)). The callback arguments are not used. No return value. Side effects: pointer rotation, attack arrow. No direct caller (installed as update callback +0xc by ui_place_attack_pointer_on_zone).

Update callback of the attack pointer's flight: with the elapsed time obj +0x14 and the duration data +0x50 it lerps the position data +0x00 from the start +0x30 to the target +0x40 (system_vfpu_vector4_lerp) and raises presentation flag 0xc, or snaps to the target when the time is up. No return value. Side effects: writes data, presentation flag. No direct caller (installed as update callback +0xc by ui_move_attack_pointer).

Calls ui_aim_attack_pointer_at_zone(location, unused, 0): aims the pointer at a location while selecting (selection arrow colour). No return value. Side effects: those of the callee. Callers: 2 (ui_place_attack_pointer_on_zone, ui_attack_pointer_follow_selection); also registered as a field-cursor listener (removed by ui_hide_attack_pointer).

column2: void ui_aim_attack_pointer_at_zone(int location, int unused, int confirmed)
column3: When the attack pointer exists and is in selection mode (data +0x20 = 0), turns it towards the board position of location: rotation (data +0x10) = quaternion about the axis 0x098cf650 by atan2 of the horizontal offset, or the default rotation 0x098cf640 when the positions coincide. Stops the current attack arrow (ui_stop_attack_arrow) when its remembered from/to codes (0x098e6bc8/0x098e6bca) differ from the pointer's attacker location (+0x24) or location; then, when ui_can_draw_attack_arrow(location, confirmed) allows it, creates an arrow from the pointer to the target with colour 0xffff6060 (selection) or 0xff0606ff (confirmed attack) and stores the codes. No return value. Side effects: pointer data, attack arrow, 0x098e6bc8-0x098e6bcb. Callers: 2 (ui_aim_attack_pointer, ui_move_attack_pointer).

False while an attack arrow exists (0x098e6bc4). Otherwise true for a confirmed attack on a monster zone or on the player (hand location 0xb), and, while selecting, true only for a monster zone (0-4) whose card's action mask (duel_core_view_get_card_action_mask) has bit 0x800 (valid attack target). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_aim_attack_pointer_at_zone).

Creates the attack arrow duel object: a 0x70-byte block from the duel draw heap with 64 segment intensities (+0x00-+0x3f), the textures perticle_for_arrow.gim (+0x40) and arrow_head.gim (+0x44) of duel archive 0x80001 (ui_load_duel_archive), repeat flag +0x4c = 1, start point +0x54, end point +0x60 and colour +0x6c; the object gets draw callback 0x0985d004, update ui_update_attack_arrow and free callback 0x0985cffc and is stored in 0x098e6bc4. No return value. Side effects: heap allocation, duel object, 0x098e6bc4. Callers: 1 (ui_aim_attack_pointer_at_zone).

Update callback of the attack arrow: on the first frame plays sound 0x7a34 (unless draw flag 8 is set or the card viewer/help mode is open); advances the head index data +0x48 by ui_get_arrow_grow_step up to 0x3f, restarting at 0 while the repeat flag +0x4c is set, and marks the arrow finished (+0x50) when it reaches 0x3f without repeat; sets the newly covered segment bytes to 0xff and fades the others by ui_get_arrow_fade_step; deletes the object (ui_delete_current_duel_object) when all 64 segments are 0. No return value. Side effects: writes data, sound, object deletion. No direct caller (installed by ui_create_attack_arrow).
Returns the attack-arrow growth per frame for the current animation speed: entry ui_get_anim_speed() of the table 0x098cf6b0. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_update_attack_arrow).
Returns the attack-arrow segment fade per frame for the current animation speed: entry ui_get_anim_speed() of the table 0x098cf6c0. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_update_attack_arrow).

Clears the 0x180-byte zone highlight table 0x098e6bcc (handles [2][16] at +0x00, kinds at +0x80, variants at +0x100) and sets all 32 handles to -1. No return value. Side effects: writes the table. Callers: 1 (ui_init_duel_objects).

Ends every live zone highlight of the table 0x098e6bcc: for each handle other than -1 calls ui_duel_set_draw_task_flag1 (the handle is still in a0, hypothesis, confidence medium), then sets the handle to -1 and its kind to 0. No return value. Side effects: highlight tasks flagged, table written. Callers: 1 (ui_term_duel_objects).

Synchronises the zone highlights with the engine: reads the highlight kinds of zones 0-10 of both sides relative to the location under the field cursor (duel_core_view_get_zone_highlight_states, u16[2][11], low byte = kind); a zone whose card object is still moving gets no highlight; a zone without kind for which the view test duel_core_view_is_zone_usable_lenient(side, zone) returns 0 gets kind 7 variant 4; the zone under the cursor gets none unless the kind is 7. When a zone's kind or variant changes the old highlight ends (ui_end_zone_highlight) and a new one is created with ui_create_zone_highlight; handles, kinds and variants are kept in 0x098e6bcc. No return value. Side effects: highlight tasks, table. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_duel_objects).

column2: int ui_create_zone_highlight(int side, int zone, int kind, int variant)
column3: Creates a highlight effect on a zone: style = kind - 1 for kinds 2-7 (0 otherwise); position from field_3d_board_get_location_transform raised by the constant 0x098c4ce8 plus the pile height for the Extra Deck, Banished, Deck and Graveyard (counts from duel_core_view_get_*_count); orientation from field_3d_quat_to_euler. Starts ui_create_zone_highlight_task(1.0, style, pos, euler, 0xffffffff, 0, 0), or for a non-zero variant ui_create_zone_highlight_task_dl(1.0, variant, style, ...), which uses variant as the GE layer (4 for the kind-7 highlight). Returns the task handle (the callee's result, left in v0; hypothesis, confidence medium). Side effects: highlight task created. Callers: 1 (ui_update_zone_highlights).

Ends a zone highlight task: calls ui_duel_set_draw_task_flag1 (with handle still in a0) when handle is not -1. No return value. Side effects: task flagged for removal. Callers: 1 (ui_update_zone_highlights).

Clears the 0x30-byte LP panel state 0x098e6d4c and looks up the LP panel members of duel archive 0x80001 (ui_load_duel_archive): for language 0 (Japanese) lp_pnl01_j.gim, lp_pnl02_j.gim, lp_pnl_nmb01_j.gim and lp_pnl_nmb02_j.gim into 0x098e6d60-0x098e6d6c; for the other languages lp_pnl_a01.gim (0x098e6d70), lp_pnl_nmb01_a.gim (0x098e6d74) and the layout pnl_a00.ehf (0x098e6d78) with the flags of pnl_a00.tmf applied (ui_ehf_apply_tmf_flags). No return value. Side effects: writes 0x098e6d4c-0x098e6d7b, layout flags. Callers: 1 (ui_init_duel_objects).

column2: void ui_create_lp_roll_panel(int x, int y, int from_lp, int to_lp)
column3: Creates the LP counter panel shown during a cut-in: allocates 0x90 bytes from the duel draw heap with x +0x00, y +0x04, from +0x08 and to +0x0c (both clamped to 0-99999), current value +0x10, state +0x20 = 1 (delay), counters +0x74/+0x78 = 0, panel origin +0x18/+0x1c = (x - 64, y - 48) in Japanese or (x - 92, y - 61) otherwise, where it also sets the gauge maximum +0x14 = 8000, bar scales +0x7c = 0.75 and +0x80 = 1.0, their speeds +0x84/+0x88 and the wide-digit flag +0x8c (a value with 5 digits). Fills the five roll digits at +0x24 (ui_set_lp_roll_digits) and creates a duel object with callbacks ui_draw_lp_roll_panel, ui_update_lp_roll_panel and ui_free_lp_roll_panel, stored in 0x098e6d4c. No return value. Side effects: heap allocation, duel object, 0x098e6d4c. Callers: 1 (field_3d_cutin_default_frame_events).

column2: void ui_create_number_pair_panel(int x, int y, int first, int second)
column3: Creates a two-number panel (same frame as the LP panel): allocates 0x34 bytes with x, y, the two values (+0x08, +0x0c), origin +0x10/+0x14 ((x - 64, y - 48) Japanese, (x - 92, y - 61) otherwise), +0x18 = 1, and two 5-character digit strings at +0x20 and +0x25 (least significant first: digits, '*' for blanks; Japanese blanks leading zeros, other languages keep at least 4 digits; a negative value gives |value| '?' marks), plus wide flags +0x2c/+0x30 for 5-digit values (non-Japanese). Creates a duel object with callbacks ui_draw_number_pair_panel, ui_update_number_pair_panel and ui_free_number_pair_panel (stored in 0x098e6d4c) and plays sound 0x7a1e. No return value. Side effects: heap allocation, duel object, sound. Callers: 1 (field_3d_cutin_default_frame_events).

Destroys the LP panel duel object 0x098e6d4c (ui_destroy_duel_object) when present and clears the pointer. No return value. Side effects: object destroyed, 0x098e6d4c. Callers: 2 (field_3d_cutin_reset_current, field_3d_cutin_stop_current).

column2: void * ui_begin_lp_panel_projection(void *list, int x, int y)
column3: Sets up a private 3D projection for the LP panels: pushes the projection and view matrices, saves the current perspective parameters to 0x098e6d50-0x098e6d5c, moves the GE screen offset to (0x710 - x, 0x778 - y) with viewport (0x800, 0x800, 480, 272) and depth range 0xffff-0, loads a perspective (field of view 0x098c4e50, aspect 0x098c4e4c, near 5, far 400) and a look-at camera (eye 0x098cf7d0, target 0x098cf7e0, up 0x098cf7f0), then sets blending, texture function, ambient white and disables alpha and depth tests and lighting (the last texture-state writes are garbled in the decompilation). Returns the display list (hypothesis, the callers use the result). Side effects: GE and GUM state. Callers: 2 (ui_draw_number_pair_panel, ui_draw_lp_roll_panel).

Restores the state changed by ui_begin_lp_panel_projection: GE offset (0x710, 0x778), pops the projection matrix and reloads the saved perspective (0x098e6d50-0x098e6d5c), pops the view matrix. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: GE and GUM state. Callers: 2 (ui_draw_number_pair_panel, ui_draw_lp_roll_panel).

column2: void ui_build_sprite_quad_s16(short *out, int x, int y, int z, int u, int v, int width, int height, uint colour)
column3: Writes four 16-byte through-mode vertices (u16 u, v; u32 colour; s16 x, y, z; the vertex type 0x80011e) for a width x height quad at (x, y, z) textured from (u, v): corners in the order (u + w, v), (u, v), (u + w, v + h), (u, v + h). The ninth argument (colour) is passed on the stack. No return value. Side effects: writes out[0..31]. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_lp_panel_frame).

column2: void ui_build_textured_quad_f32(float cx, float cy, float z, float width, float height, float *out, int u, int v, int src_width, int src_height, int tex_width, int tex_height, float colour)
column3: Writes four 24-byte float vertices (u, v, colour word, x, y, z; vertex type 0x19f) for a width x height quad centred on (cx, cy, z), texture coordinates normalised from the pixel rectangle (u, v, src_width, src_height) of a tex_width x tex_height texture with a half-texel offset; the colour argument is stored as the vertex colour word. No return value. Side effects: writes out[0..23]. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_lp_roll_digit).

column2: void ui_draw_lp_panel_frame(void *list, int x, int y)
column3: Draws the Japanese LP panel background at (x, y): three animated gradient colours (ui_get_lp_panel_glow_colour rows 0-2 for the current frame) on a 6-vertex strip textured with lp_pnl01_j (0x098e6d60, 128 x 96) with Gouraud shading; writes the panel's alpha into the stencil buffer (alpha test greater than 0, stencil replace); draws a 160 x 160 light sprite rotating by frame / 20 about the panel centre with additive blending where the stencil is set; then the overlay lp_pnl02_j (0x098e6d64, 128 x 96). No return value. Side effects: GE commands, stencil buffer. VFPU code read from the Ghidra pseudo-ops; lower confidence. Callers: 2 (ui_draw_number_pair_panel, ui_draw_lp_roll_panel).

Returns an opaque colour (0xff000000 | b << 16 | g << 8 | r) for gradient row 0-2 of the LP panel: the 81-byte table 0x098cf80c holds 9 keys x 3 rows of RGB; key = (frame mod 45) / 5, linearly interpolated over 5 frames towards the next key (key 8 wraps to 0). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_lp_panel_frame).

Draw callback of the LP counter panel on GE layer 9: inside ui_begin_lp_panel_projection/ui_end_lp_panel_projection at the panel origin (data +0x18/+0x1c) it draws, in Japanese, the frame (ui_draw_lp_panel_frame), the label (ui_draw_lp_panel_label) and the five rolling digits (ui_draw_lp_roll_digit with texture lp_pnl_nmb01_j 0x098e6d68), otherwise the international panel (ui_draw_lp_roll_panel_intl) and five flat digits (ui_draw_lp_digit_intl, texture lp_pnl_nmb01_a 0x098e6d74). No return value. Side effects: GE commands on layer 9. No direct caller (installed by ui_create_lp_roll_panel).

Draws the 48 x 34 label sprite from (0, 0x44) of lp_pnl_nmb01_j (0x098e6d68) at the panel origin + (0xf, 10) with normal blending and nearest filtering. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_lp_roll_panel).

Draws one drum-roll digit of the Japanese LP panel: for the current digit (record +0x08) and the next digit (+0x0c), when not -1, builds a 24 x 34 textured quad from the cell of the 128 x 128 digit texture given by the table 0x098c4d00 (ui_build_textured_quad_f32), places it at x = 0x098c4e44 + 0x098c4e48 x (5 - index), cancels the view rotation and rotates it about X by the roll angle (+0x04) times 0x098c4e40, the next digit one step further, so the digits turn like a drum. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: GE commands; GUM matrix pushed and popped. VFPU code read from the Ghidra pseudo-ops; lower confidence. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_lp_roll_panel).

Draws the international LP panel: the 184 x 122 base sprite of lp_pnl_a01 (0x098e6d70) at the origin (data +0x18/+0x1c); the gauge layout pnl_a00.ehf (0x098e6d78) played at frame (1 - clamp(current +0x10, 0, max +0x14) / max) x 99 (ui_ehf_override_start_frame); two pulsing bars (56 x 8 px scaled by +0x7c and +0x80, at y + 0xc and y + 0x16, centred at x + 100); and a three-frame 65 x 16 animation (cells from 0x098cf870) at (x + 0x3f, y + 0x57). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: GE commands, layout start frame. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_lp_roll_panel).

Draws digit index of the international LP panel: the next-digit value of roll record index (data +0x30 + index x 0x10), when not -1, as an 18 x 37 cell (source table 0x098c4d50) scaled to 18 px wide (4 digits) or 13 px (5 digits, data +0x8c), right to left from origin + 0x3e, at origin y + 0x26. Returns the display list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_lp_roll_panel).

Update callback of the LP counter panel, state data +0x20: 1 waits 10 frames (+0x78) then starts counting (state 2) and the loop sound 0x7a1f; 2 moves the current value +0x10 linearly from +0x08 to +0x0c over 35 frames (+0x74) and updates the five roll digits (ui_update_lp_roll_digit), and once every digit has stopped sets the final digits, stops 0x7a1f, plays 0x7a1d when the new LP is 0 or 0x7a20 otherwise, and goes to state 3; 3 holds 45 frames then 0. Outside Japanese the bars pulse in states 1-3 (ui_update_lp_panel_bar_pulse). In state 0 it deletes the object (ui_delete_current_duel_object). No return value. Side effects: writes data, sounds, object deletion. No direct caller (installed by ui_create_lp_roll_panel).

Sets the five 0x10-byte roll digit records at digits to the decimal digits of value (ui_get_decimal_digit_or_blank, leading zeros blank except the units) without rolling (ui_reset_lp_roll_digit). No return value. Side effects: writes the records. Callers: 2 (ui_update_lp_roll_panel, ui_create_lp_roll_panel).

column2: void ui_reset_lp_roll_digit(int *digit, int value, int keep_angle)
column3: Stops a roll digit record: rolling flag +0x00 = 0, current and next digit (+0x08, +0x0c) = value, roll angle +0x04 = 0 or, when keep_angle is set, angle - 1.0. No return value. Side effects: writes the record. Callers: 2 (ui_set_lp_roll_digits, ui_update_lp_roll_digit).

column2: int ui_get_decimal_digit_or_blank(int value, int position, int blank_leading)
column3: Returns decimal digit position (0 = units) of value, computed with 10^position (sceVfpuScalarPow, sceVfpuScalarCeil); returns -1 (blank) when blank_leading is set, value is below 10^position and the language is Japanese or position is above 3 (other languages always show 4 digits). No side effects. Callers: 2 (ui_set_lp_roll_digits, ui_update_lp_roll_digit).

Advances roll digit index of the LP counter panel (record data +0x24 + index x 0x10): a still digit starts rolling towards the digit of the current value (+0x10) when that differs, or to a random digit (system_rand_shifted mod 10) while a higher digit rolls; a rolling digit advances its angle by the per-position speed of the table 0x098c4cec (Japanese) or jumps to 1.0 (other languages), and at 1.0 takes the next digit and either stops (ui_reset_lp_roll_digit) or keeps rolling. No return value. Side effects: writes the record. Callers: 1 (ui_update_lp_roll_panel).

Advances the two bar scales of the international LP panel: +0x7c by +0x84 and +0x80 by +0x88, each reversing direction at 1.0 and at 0.5. No return value. Side effects: writes data +0x7c-+0x88. Callers: 1 (ui_update_lp_roll_panel).

Free callback of the LP counter panel: clears the layout start-frame override (ui_ehf_clear_override_flag), stops sound 0x7a1f, frees data to the duel draw heap and clears 0x098e6d4c. No return value. Side effects: those listed. No direct caller (installed by ui_create_lp_roll_panel).

Draw callback of the two-number panel on GE layer 9: inside the LP panel projection at origin data +0x10/+0x14 it draws, in Japanese, the frame (ui_draw_lp_panel_frame) and the labels (ui_draw_number_pair_labels), otherwise ui_draw_number_pair_frame_intl, then both values (ui_draw_number_pair_value with 1 and 0). No return value. Side effects: GE commands on layer 9. No direct caller (installed by ui_create_number_pair_panel).

Draws the two 43 x 17 label sprites of lp_pnl_nmb02_j (0x098e6d6c), source (0x55, 0) at origin + (0xf, 7) and source (0x55, 0x11) at origin + (0xf, 0x30). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_number_pair_panel).

Draws one value of the two-number panel from its 5-character digit string (which 0: data +0x25, lower row; which 1: data +0x20, upper row), right to left, each character through ui_draw_lp_panel_glyph: in Japanese 17 x 24 cells of lp_pnl_nmb02_j (0x098e6d6c) at origin + 0x19 and y + 0x41 or + 0x18; otherwise lp_pnl_nmb01_a (0x098e6d74) 20 x 27 cells drawn 20 px wide (4 digits) or 17 px (5-digit flag +0x2c/+0x30) at origin + 0x45 and y + 0x48 or + 0x16, with linear filtering. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_number_pair_panel).

column2: void * ui_draw_lp_panel_glyph(void *list, int x, int y, int ch)
column3: Draws one character of an LP-panel number with the sprite extent set by the caller: '0'-'9' take their source cell from the table 0x098c4da0 (Japanese) or 0x098c4df0 (other languages), '?' a fixed cell ((0x6f, 0x28) or (200, 0x25)); any other character (the '*' blank) draws nothing. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_number_pair_value).

Draws the international two-number panel background: the 184 x 122 sprite from (0, 0x7a) of lp_pnl_a01 (0x098e6d70) at the origin data +0x10/+0x14 with normal blending and nearest filtering. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_number_pair_panel).

Update callback of the two-number panel: counts frames in data +0x1c and after 45 frames clears the active flag +0x18; deletes the object (ui_delete_current_duel_object) once the flag is 0. No return value. Side effects: writes data, object deletion. No direct caller (installed by ui_create_number_pair_panel).

Free callback of the two-number panel: frees data to the duel draw heap and clears the LP panel object pointer 0x098e6d4c. No return value. Side effects: heap free, 0x098e6d4c. No direct caller (installed by ui_create_number_pair_panel).

Initialises the duel UI object system: clears the 0x8a4-byte area 0x098e6d7c (object list sentinel 0x098e6d7c/0x098e6d80, delete flag 0x098e6d98, the 512 glowing card objects at 0x098e6d9c, sixteen shared pile glows {handle, count} at 0x098e759c with handles -1, deck-effect flag 0x098e761c), makes the sentinel point to itself, then ui_init_attack_ready_markers, ui_init_attack_pointer, ui_init_zone_highlight_handles, ui_load_lp_panel_textures and ui_duel_init_draw_tasks. No return value. Side effects: those listed. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_draw_begin).

Shuts the duel UI objects down: ui_stop_zone_highlights, ui_term_attack_pointer, ui_term_attack_ready_markers, destroys every object still in the list 0x098e6d7c (ui_destroy_duel_object), ui_clear_lp_panel_state and ui_duel_destroy_all_draw_tasks. No return value. Side effects: objects and tasks destroyed. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_draw_reset).

Draws the duel UI objects: ui_draw_attack_ready_markers and ui_update_zone_highlights, then walks the object list from 0x098e6d80 calling each object's draw callback (+0x08) with (object, data +0x18); an object that set the delete flag 0x098e6d98 during its callback is destroyed (ui_destroy_duel_object) and the flag cleared. Then clears the GUM dirty flags, loads an identity model matrix and runs the draw tasks (ui_duel_run_draw_tasks). No return value. Side effects: GE commands, objects destroyed. Callers: 1 (ui_run_duel_draw_frame).

Updates the duel UI objects: for each object of the list (from 0x098e6d80) adds dt to its elapsed time +0x14 and calls its update callback (+0x0c) with (dt, object, data); destroys an object that set the delete flag 0x098e6d98. No return value. Side effects: objects updated or destroyed. Callers: 1 (ui_run_duel_draw_frame).

Allocates a 0x1c-byte duel UI object from the duel draw heap, copies the parameter block into it (+0x00/+0x04 links, +0x08 draw callback, +0x0c update callback (dt, obj, data), +0x10 free callback (obj, data), +0x14 elapsed time, +0x18 data) and links it into the object list next to the sentinel 0x098e6d7c. Returns the object. Side effects: heap allocation, list. Callers: 22 (ui_create_attack_arrow, ui_create_wait_object, field_3d_start_placed_summon_fx, ui_start_deck_shuffle_anim, ...).
Copies a 0x1c-byte (7-word) duel object parameter block from src to dest. Returns dest. Side effects: writes dest. Callers: 1 (ui_create_duel_object).

When obj is linked, unlinks it from the duel object list, calls its free callback (+0x10) with (obj, data +0x18) and frees the object to the duel draw heap. Returns 0. Side effects: list, free callback, heap free. Callers: 8 (ui_term_duel_objects, ui_on_lp_change_effect_done, ui_on_deck_effect_done, ui_close_lp_panel, ...); also passed as a completion callback (ui_show_counter_change, ui_start_dice_roll, ...).

Draw callback of the card display object: on GE layer 7 with texturing, blending and nearest filtering on and the depth test off draws the card face of card id data +0x04 at (0x104, 0x2d) (ui_draw_card_face). No return value. Side effects: GE commands on layer 7. No direct caller (installed by ui_create_card_info_display).

column2: void * ui_create_card_info_display(int side, int card_id, int flag, int picture_mode)
column3: When the animation speed is below 3, shows a card in the centre of the screen: allocates 0x18 bytes (+0x00 side, +0x04 card id, +0x08 effect handle, +0x0c presentation flag, +0x14 mode), starts the card flash (ui_start_card_info_flash at (0x13a, 0x7a, 0)) or, for picture_mode, the picture fade (ui_start_card_picture_fade), and creates a duel object with draw callback ui_draw_card_info_object (update 0x0986221c, free 0x09862214). Returns the object, or NULL at higher animation speeds. Side effects: heap allocation, draw task, duel object. Callers: 2 (ui_request_value_increment_popup, ui_request_card_info_display).

Update callback of a deferred card display: when no cut-in mode is active and the board is settled (field_3d_board_is_settled) it calls ui_request_card_info_display(data[0], 0x10, data[1], 0, data[5]) and deletes itself; otherwise it keeps presentation flag data[3] raised. No return value. Side effects: card display, object deletion, presentation flag. No direct caller (installed by ui_request_card_info_display).

column2: void ui_request_card_info_display(int side, int zone, int card_id, int flag, int picture_mode)
column3: Shows a card in the centre of the screen now or later: when no cut-in mode is active and the board is settled it creates the display (ui_create_card_info_display), raises presentation flag flag and either shows card_id in the card information panel (zone 0x10) or moves the field cursor to (side, zone, 0) saving the old location; otherwise it creates a retry object (0x18-byte data, update ui_retry_card_info_display, free ui_free_duel_object_data). The fifth argument is in t0. No return value. Side effects: card display, cursor, duel object. Callers: 5 (ui_cmd_show_chain_link_resolving, ui_cmd_show_negation, ui_cmd_show_announce_activation, ui_finish_chain_link_resolve_anim, ...).

Starts the highlight glow of a board card object (Tribute pick) when it has none (+0x90 = -1): creates a glow task style 1 (ui_create_card_glow_task, scale 0x098c4e5c) at the object position (+0x10, raised by 0x098c4ec8 outside the hand) with the Euler angles of its rotation (+0x40), stores the handle in +0x90, registers the object in the first free entry of the 512-entry glow list 0x098e6d9c and adds the callback ui_sync_card_glow_transform. No return value. Side effects: draw task, glow list, object callback. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_mark_tribute_pick).

Ends the highlight glow of a board card object: flags its task (ui_duel_set_draw_task_flag1 with the handle in a0, hypothesis, confidence medium), sets +0x90 to -1, removes the object from the glow list 0x098e6d9c and removes the callback ui_sync_card_glow_transform. No return value. Side effects: those listed. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_show_tribute).

Ends the highlight glow (+0x90) of every object in the glow list 0x098e6d9c: flags the task, sets the handle to -1, clears the list entry and removes the callback ui_sync_card_glow_transform. No return value. Side effects: tasks, list, callbacks. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_cancel_selection).

Free callback of an object whose data starts with a draw-task handle: stops the task (ui_duel_stop_draw_task) when the handle is not -1, sets it to -1 and frees data to the duel draw heap. No return value. Side effects: task stopped, heap free. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).

Raises presentation flags 0x2c, 0x2f and 0x32 (keeps the engine waiting for the release effects). No return value. Side effects: presentation flags. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).

Starts the material glow of a board card object (+0x94) when it has none: cards in the Graveyard or Banished pile (zones 0xe/0xf) share one glow per pile (table 0x098e759c, {handle, count}, count incremented); otherwise creates a glow task (ui_create_card_glow_task, style 2, or 0 when confirmed is set) at the object position, for the piles at the pile-top height (field_3d_board_get_pile_height of count + 1), raised for hand cards, with the Euler angles of its rotation. Registers the object in the glow list 0x098e6d9c and adds the callback ui_sync_card_glow_transform. No return value. Side effects: draw task, glow tables, object callback. Callers: 2 (ui_cmd_mark_synchro_material, ui_cmd_mark_fusion_material).

Ends the material glow of a board card object: for the Graveyard and Banished piles decrements the shared count (0x098e759c + zone x 8) and flags the shared task when it reaches 0; otherwise flags the object's own task (+0x94). Sets +0x94 to -1, removes the object from the glow list 0x098e6d9c and removes the callback ui_sync_card_glow_transform. No return value. Side effects: tasks, tables, callbacks. Callers: 2 (ui_cmd_show_fusion_material_sent, ui_cmd_show_synchro_material_sent).

Ends the material glow (+0x94) of every object in the glow list 0x098e6d9c: flags the task, sets the handle to -1, clears the entry and removes the callback ui_sync_card_glow_transform. The shared pile counts are not reset. No return value. Side effects: tasks, list, callbacks. Callers: 2 (ui_cmd_end_synchro_material_marks, ui_cmd_end_fusion_material_marks).

Update callback of a deferred hand re-layout: when no board object is busy and the board is settled it calls field_3d_board_resync_hand(side = obj +0x18) and deletes itself; otherwise it raises presentation flag 0x12. No return value. Side effects: hand objects, object deletion, presentation flag. No direct caller (installed by ui_request_hand_relayout).

Re-lays out side's hand now (field_3d_board_resync_hand) when no board object is busy and the board is settled, otherwise creates a retry object (update ui_retry_hand_relayout, data = side) and raises presentation flag 0x12. No return value. Side effects: hand objects or duel object, presentation flag. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_shuffle_hand).

Update callback of a deferred monster-zone shuffle animation: raises presentation flag 0x29 and, when no object is busy, the board is settled and no object effect is pending, calls field_3d_board_gather_monster_objects(data[0], data[1]) (data = obj +0x18) and deletes itself. No return value. Side effects: board objects, object deletion, presentation flag. No direct caller (installed by ui_request_gather_monsters).

Raises presentation flag 0x29 and gathers side's monster objects now (field_3d_board_gather_monster_objects(side, arg)) when the board is idle, settled and has no pending object effect; otherwise creates a retry object with an 8-byte data block {side, arg} (update ui_retry_gather_monsters, free ui_free_duel_object_data). No return value. Side effects: board objects or duel object, presentation flag. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_shuffle_monster_zones).

column2: void ui_show_counter_change(void *obj, int old_count, int which)
column3: Shows a counter-change popup over a board card object: reads the zone's counter of type 0x01 (which 0) or 0x00 (which non-zero) for the object's location (+0x82), computes the increase (current - old_count, at least 0), creates a wait object with presentation flag 0x27 and starts ui_create_stat_change_popup(which == 0, object position +0x10, increase, current, ui_destroy_duel_object, wait object) so the wait ends with the popup. No return value. Side effects: wait object, popup task. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_show_value_changes).

column2: void ui_show_value_increment_popup(float *pos, int value, int arg)
column3: Shows a popup counting from value - 1 to value at pos: allocates 0x10 bytes {value, arg, hold object, flag 0x25}, creates a hold object (update 0x09863434, free ui_free_duel_object_data) stored at +0x08, raises presentation flag 0x25 and starts ui_create_value_change_popup(pos, value - 1, value, done callback 0x0986343c, data). No return value. Side effects: duel object, popup task, presentation flag. Callers: 2 (ui_retry_value_increment_popup, ui_request_value_increment_popup).

Update callback that waits for a card display object (data +0x08, data = obj +0x18) to disappear from the duel object list; when it has gone and the duel UI mode is 1 (field cursor) it shows the value popup at the origin (ui_show_value_increment_popup(zero vector, data[0], data[1])) and deletes itself; otherwise it keeps presentation flag data[3] raised. No return value. Side effects: popup, object deletion, presentation flag. No direct caller (installed by ui_request_value_increment_popup).

column2: void ui_request_value_increment_popup(void *obj, int value, int ref)
column3: Shows a turn-counter increment: with a board card object, at its position (+0x10) via ui_show_value_increment_popup(pos, value, ref); without one (obj NULL), first shows the card of instance ref in the centre (ui_create_card_info_display(owner view side, card id, 0x25, 0)) and creates a waiting object (update ui_retry_value_increment_popup, data {value, ref, display, 0x25}) that shows the popup afterwards, raising presentation flag 0x25. No return value. Side effects: duel objects, popups, presentation flag. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_advance_turn_counter).

Update callback of a deferred counter popup: raises presentation flag 0x27 and deletes the object when draw flag 8 has been cleared (the object's free callback ui_run_deferred_effect_call then starts the popup). No return value. Side effects: presentation flag, object deletion. No direct caller (installed by ui_start_zone_value_change).

Free callback of a deferred counter popup: creates a wait object with presentation flag 0x27 and calls the stored effect starter data[1](board object data[0] + 0x10, data[2], data[3], ui_destroy_duel_object, wait object), then frees data (ui_free_duel_object_data). No return value. Side effects: wait object, popup task, heap free. No direct caller (installed by ui_start_zone_value_change).

column2: void ui_start_zone_value_change(void *obj, int old_value, int kind)
column3: Shows a counter or countdown change over a board card object for kind 0-0x12: picks the reader (counter types 0x0f, 0x0d, 0x0e, the battle destruction countdown for kind 3, 0x10, 0x11, 0x03, 0x02, 0x12, 0x04-0x0c, 0x13) and the popup starter (ui_create_stat_change_popup_alt, ui_duel_create_thing_sprite_b/c/d/e tasks and variants, ui_create_value_change_popup_alt, ui_duel_create_thing_icon_task_r0c0..r2c1), reads the current value for the object's location (+0x82), computes the increase (current - old_value, at least 0) and, unless draw flag 8 is set, starts the popup with a wait object (presentation flag 0x27, 0x28 for kind 3); while flag 8 is set it defers the call in a 0x10-byte object {obj, starter, increase, current} (update ui_update_counter_change_hold, free ui_run_deferred_effect_call) and raises the flag. Other kinds do nothing. No return value. Side effects: popup tasks, duel objects, presentation flags. Callers: 2 (ui_cmd_replace_slot_effect_value, ui_cmd_show_value_changes).

Creates a duel object that keeps presentation flag flag raised while it exists: 4-byte data {flag}, update callback 0x09863a94 (raises the flag each frame, hypothesis from the pattern, confidence medium), free 0x09862214; raises the flag once now. Returns the object (completion callbacks destroy it with ui_destroy_duel_object). Side effects: heap allocation, duel object, presentation flag. Callers: 10 (ui_show_destiny_board_progress, ui_start_deck_shuffle_anim, ui_start_dice_roll, ui_start_zone_value_change, ...).

Update callback of the location pointing pause: after 0.5 s (obj elapsed time +0x14) unlocks the field cursor (ui_field_cursor_set_locked(0)) and deletes itself; before that raises presentation flag 0x19. No return value. Side effects: cursor lock, object deletion, presentation flag. No direct caller (installed by ui_start_location_point_hold).

Locks the field cursor (ui_field_cursor_set_locked(1)), creates a duel object with update callback ui_update_location_point_hold and raises presentation flag 0x19, so the cursor stays on the pointed location for 0.5 s. No return value. Side effects: cursor lock, duel object, presentation flag. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_point_at_location).

Completion callback of the LP change popup: destroys the wait object data[0], adds the change data[2] to the LP display target of side data[1] (ui_add_lp_display_target) so the counter starts rolling, and frees data. No return value. Side effects: wait object destroyed, LP target, heap free. No direct caller (passed by ui_start_lp_change_effect).

Starts the flying LP change number for side: creates a wait object (presentation flag 0x10) and a 0xc-byte record {wait object, side, delta}, then ui_duel_create_value_popup_task_moving(start point of side from 0x098cf8b0, delta, colour (0xff, 0x3c, 0x3c) for a loss or (0, 0xef, 0xbb) for a gain, alpha 0xff, end point of side from 0x098cf8c8, ui_on_lp_change_effect_done, record). No return value. Side effects: wait object, popup task, heap allocation. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_change_life_points).

Completion callback of the deck shuffle animation: sets the deck-effect done flag of side data[1] (ui_set_deck_effect_done_flag), destroys the wait object data[0], frees data and clears the deck-effect running flag (ui_set_deck_effect_running(0)). No return value. Side effects: those listed. No direct caller (passed by ui_start_deck_shuffle_anim).

Update callback of a deferred deck shuffle: when no board object is busy and the board is settled it starts ui_start_deck_shuffle_anim(side = obj +0x18) and deletes itself; otherwise raises presentation flag 0x15. No return value. Side effects: shuffle animation, object deletion, presentation flag. No direct caller (installed by ui_start_deck_shuffle_anim).

Starts the deck shuffle animation of side when the board is idle and settled: allocates {wait object (presentation flag 0x15), side}, clears the side's deck-effect done flag, creates field_3d_create_deck_shuffle_task(side == 0, deck object count, ui_on_deck_effect_done, record) and sets the deck-effect running flag; otherwise creates a retry object (update ui_retry_deck_effect, data = side) and raises flag 0x15. No return value. Side effects: shuffle task, wait or retry object, flags. Callers: 2 (ui_cmd_shuffle_deck, ui_retry_deck_effect).

Completion callback of the coin toss: hides the HUD coin icon (ui_set_coin_toss_state(-1)) and destroys the wait object. No return value. Side effects: coin state, object destroyed. No direct caller (passed by ui_start_coin_toss).

column2: void ui_start_coin_toss(int unused, int coin_count, int state, uint results, int card_id)
column3: Starts a coin toss animation with a wait object (presentation flag 0x3c): the three result flags are the inverted bits 0-2 of results; for an Arcana Force card (card_db_is_arcana_force(card_id)) it starts the arcana roulette (ui_start_arcana_roulette(card_id, bit 0 clear, point 0x098cf8e0, ui_on_coin_toss_done, wait)), otherwise it shows the HUD coin icon (ui_set_coin_toss_state(state)) and creates field_3d_create_coin_toss_task(coin_count, flags, ui_on_coin_toss_done, wait). The fifth argument is in t0; the first is not used. No return value. Side effects: wait object, effect task, coin state. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_start_coin_toss).

Starts a one-die roll animation showing value: creates a wait object (presentation flag 0x3d) and field_3d_create_dice_roll_task(1, {value}, side == 0, ui_destroy_duel_object, wait). No return value. Side effects: wait object, effect task. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_roll_dice).

Update callback of a conditional wait: raises presentation flag data[0] and deletes the object when the predicate data[1]() returns non-zero (data[2] set) or zero (data[2] clear). No return value. Side effects: presentation flag, object deletion. No direct caller (installed by ui_create_wait_until_object).

column2: void ui_create_wait_until_object(int flag, void *predicate, int expected)
column3: Unless the condition already holds (predicate() non-zero when expected is set, zero when it is clear), raises presentation flag flag and creates a wait object with data {flag, predicate, expected} (update ui_update_wait_until_object, free 0x09864114) that holds the flag until it does. No return value. Side effects: presentation flag, duel object. Callers: 4 (ui_cmd_set_life_points, ui_cmd_on_phase_banner_done, ui_cmd_show_battle_damage, ui_cmd_show_turn_limit_milestone).

column2: void ui_start_fusion_summon_fx(int arg0, int arg1, int arg2)
column3: Creates a wait object (presentation flag 0x3a) and the Fusion Summon effect task field_3d_create_fusion_summon_fx_task(arg2, arg1, arg0, ui_destroy_duel_object, wait) (arguments passed in reverse order). No return value. Side effects: wait object, effect task. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_show_fusion_synchro_summon).

column2: void ui_start_synchro_summon_fx(int arg0, int arg1, int arg2)
column3: Creates a wait object (presentation flag 0x3a) and the Synchro Summon effect task field_3d_create_synchro_summon_fx_task(arg2, arg1, arg0, ui_destroy_duel_object, wait) (arguments passed in reverse order). No return value. Side effects: wait object, effect task. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_show_fusion_synchro_summon).

Shows the Destiny Board letters: when final is 0, creates a wait object (presentation flag 0x40) and field_3d_create_destiny_board_letters_task(letters + 1, 0, ui_destroy_duel_object, wait); when final is set, cut-in display is enabled and letters is 4, sets the card viewer card to 0x1468 and pushes duel UI mode 0xb (movie). No return value. Side effects: wait object and task, or UI mode stack. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_show_special_win).

Update callback: deletes the object when the card effect task (object data) has finished (field_3d_is_card_fx_task_finished) and raises presentation flag 0x3f. No return value. Side effects: object deletion, presentation flag. No direct caller (installed by ui_start_final_countdown_win_fx).

Starts card effect task 0x14 (field_3d_create_card_fx_task(0x14, 0, 0)) and a duel object with that task as data and update callback ui_update_final_countdown_win_wait, which holds presentation flag 0x3f until the effect ends. No return value. Side effects: effect task, duel object. Callers: 1 (ui_start_duel_end_card_fx_14).

Update callback: deletes the object when the burst effect handle (object data) has finished (ui_is_burst_effect_finished) and raises presentation flag 0x3e. No return value. Side effects: object deletion, presentation flag. No direct caller (installed by ui_update_burst_event_hold).

Update callback: after 1 / ui_get_anim_speed_factor seconds (obj elapsed time +0x14) flags the burst task (ui_duel_set_draw_task_flag1(handle)) and switches the object's update callback to ui_update_burst_event_wait_done; raises presentation flag 0x3e. No return value. Side effects: task flag, object callback, presentation flag. No direct caller (installed by ui_start_burst_event_3e).

Starts the screen burst effect at (0x13a, 0x84, 0) (ui_start_burst_effect) and a duel object with its handle as data and update callback ui_update_burst_event_hold, raising presentation flag 0x3e. No return value. Side effects: effect task, duel object, presentation flag. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_play_screen_burst_3e).

Update callback of the stacked-deck draw: raises presentation flag 0 and, once the glow task has set the done word (data +0x0c, data = obj +0x18), clears the engine's deck-stacked flag (duel_core_clear_deck_stacked_flag), moves the card object with field_3d_board_move_object(from code, to code, instance, 0) and deletes itself. No return value. Side effects: engine flag, board object move, object deletion. No direct caller (installed by ui_start_stacked_draw_effect).

column2: void ui_start_stacked_draw_effect(int from_location, int to_location, int instance, int arg)
column3: Delays a draw from a stacked deck behind a glow: allocates 0x10 bytes {u16 from, u16 to, instance, arg, done word 0}, creates a duel object (update ui_update_stacked_draw_wait, free ui_free_duel_object_data), starts field_3d_create_stacked_draw_glow_task(destination side == 0, callback 0x09864548, object) and raises presentation flag 0. No return value. Side effects: duel object, effect task, presentation flag. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_move_card).

Frees data to the duel draw heap when it is not NULL and clears the object's data pointer (+0x18) when it was that block. No return value. Side effects: heap free, writes obj +0x18. Callers: 1 (ui_run_deferred_effect_call); also installed as the free callback of many duel objects.

Card object callback that keeps its glows on the card: when the object has a material glow (+0x94) or highlight (+0x90) it computes the Euler angles of the object rotation (+0x40) and moves each glow task to the object position (+0x10) with ui_set_card_glow_task_transform (scale 0x098c4e5c). Returns 0 (the callback stays installed). Side effects: draw task transforms. VFPU code read from the Ghidra pseudo-ops; lower confidence. No direct caller (installed with ui_add_card_object_callback).
Stores running != 0 in the deck-effect running flag 0x098e761c. No return value. Side effects: writes 0x098e761c. Callers: 2 (ui_start_deck_shuffle_anim, ui_on_deck_effect_done).

Opens a confirmation prompt with entry 3 of the duel dictionary (ui_get_duel_dict_word(3), ui_open_confirm_prompt(text, 2, 1, 0)), clears the message-window word (ui_set_message_window_word_09bdd3ec_inverted(0)), moves the message window to (0, 100) and suppresses the two-panel card view (ui_card_info_set_pair_suppressed(1)). No return value. Side effects: message window, card information panel. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).

Answer callback of the card confirmation prompt: lifts the two-panel suppression and, when card_id is positive and the message-window choice is 1 or 2, opens the card viewer on card_id (ui_set_card_viewer_card_id, ui_push_duel_ui_mode(5), ui_set_duel_ui_mode_arg(mode_arg)). No return value. Side effects: card information panel, UI mode stack. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).
Clears the attack-ready markers word 0x098e7620 and enables the markers (ui_set_attack_ready_markers_enabled(1)). No return value. Side effects: writes 0x098e7620. Callers: 1 (ui_init_duel_objects).

When the markers are enabled (0x098e7620), the duel is in the Battle Phase (phase 3) and no deck effect runs, draws a marker over each monster zone 0-4 of the turn player that can declare an attack (duel_core_view_can_declare_attack), has a resting card object and is not the attack pointer's zone (ui_draw_attack_ready_marker). No return value. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_duel_objects).

Draws the bobbing attack-ready marker of a monster zone: model matrix at the zone's board transform raised by sin(frame / 10) x 5 + 10, white ambient, quad drawn on GE layer 5 with ui_draw_attack_ready_marker_quad. No return value. Side effects: GE commands; GUM matrix pushed and popped. VFPU code read from the Ghidra pseudo-ops; lower confidence. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_attack_ready_markers).

Binds duel texture 0x40006, enables normal blending and draws the 4-vertex strip at 0x098cf900 (vertex type 0x183: float UV and position) with the current matrices. Returns the advanced display list (Ghidra shows no return; the caller uses v0). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_attack_ready_marker).

column2: int ui_start_card_info_flash(int card_id, float *point, int arg2, int arg3)
column3: Creates a draw task ui_draw_card_info_flash with 0x18 bytes of data (ui_duel_create_draw_task(callback, arg2, arg3, 0x18)) and stores card_id at data +0x04 and the point at +0x08 (ui_copy_point3). Returns the task handle, or -1 when no task was free. Side effects: draw task. Callers: 1 (ui_create_card_info_display).

Copies three 32-bit words (a 3D point) from src to dest. Returns dest. Side effects: writes dest. Callers: 7 (ui_start_burst_effect, field_3d_create_card_popup_task, ui_start_arcana_roulette, ui_start_card_info_flash, ...).

Draw-task callback of the centre card flash (data from ui_start_card_info_flash: [0] frame, [1] card id, [2]/[3] centre, [5] sound-once flag): plays sound 0x7a1b once at frame 0, binds the card face texture of the card and draws 16 concentric copies of the 108 x 154 card, each scaled by 1 + i x 0.25 / 16, in colour 0x5064c8 with additive blending and an alpha of progress(frame, 8) x cosine ease(frame, 24) x (16 - i) x 90 / 16, on GE layer 7. Advances the frame by ui_duel_get_anim_frame_step. Returns 2 (keep running) until frame 24, then 4 (finished). Side effects: GE commands, sound, writes data. No direct caller (draw task created by ui_start_card_info_flash).

Creates a draw task ui_draw_card_picture_fade with 0x14 bytes of data (ui_duel_create_draw_task(callback, done_cb, done_arg, 0x14)) and stores the point at data +0x04. Returns the task handle, or -1. Side effects: draw task. Callers: 1 (ui_create_card_info_display).

Draw-task callback of the card picture fade ([0] frame, [1]/[2] centre, [4] sound-once flag): plays sound 0x7a3e once, then on GE layer 7 draws a black 108 x 154 rectangle centred on the point with alpha progress(frame, 4) x fade-out(frame, 4, 24) x 128, and over it effect texture 0x17 (source 0x55 x 0x79 stretched to 108 x 154) in white with additive blending and the same alpha. Two random draws and a trailing matrix pop have no visible use in the decompilation. Returns 2 until frame 24, then 4. Side effects: GE commands, sound, writes data. No direct caller (draw task created by ui_start_card_picture_fade).

True when the draw task handle (passed through a0 to ui_duel_get_draw_task_data) no longer has data or its grow counter (data +0x04) is above 59. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_update_burst_event_wait_done).

Creates the draw task ui_draw_burst_effect with 0x20 bytes of data: [0] its own handle, [3]-[5] the point (ui_copy_point3). Returns the task handle, or -1. Side effects: draw task. Callers: 1 (ui_start_burst_event_3e).

Draw-task callback of the screen burst ([1] grow counter 0-60, [2] fade counter 0-8, [6] sound-once flag, [7] ring counter 0-32): plays sound 0x7a1b once; draws effect texture 0x21 centred on the point as a 128-px sprite scaled by 0.5 + 0.5 x sine ease(grow, 8) with alpha 255 x that ease x cosine fade, and while the ring counter is below 32 sixteen expanding grey rings with additive blending. When the task's flag 1 is set (ui_duel_test_draw_task_flags) the grow and ring counters jump to their ends and the fade advances. Returns 2 until the fade reaches 8, then 4. Side effects: GE commands on layer 7, sound, writes data. No direct caller (draw task created by ui_start_burst_effect).

column2: int ui_start_arcana_roulette(int card_id, int reversed, float *point, void *done_cb, void *done_arg)
column3: Creates the draw task ui_update_arcana_roulette with 0x120 bytes of data: [0] its handle, [7] card id, [8] reversed flag, [9]-[11] the point. The fifth argument is in t0. Returns the task handle, or -1. Side effects: draw task. Callers: 1 (ui_start_coin_toss).

Draw-task callback of the Arcana Force roulette: on the first call (phase 1) sets the target spin data +0x18 to 0x40 steps, or when the reversed flag (+0x20) is set to 0x20 or 0x60 at random (system_effect_rand_u15), and builds the card quad (108 x 154, corners +-54/+-77). State +0x04: 0 fade in over 8 frames, 1 pause 8 frames then spin (2) while the angle +0x14 is below the target (sound 0x7a43, or 0x7a44 for the last 8 steps) or stop (3), 2 advance the angle by 8 steps, 3 pause 8 frames, 4 fade out, 5 done. Each frame draws a black full-screen sprite (alpha up to 128) and the card face (field_3d_dl_bind_card_face_texture) rotated about Z by angle x 0x098c4f28 / 8 at the point, from a double-buffered vertex copy (data +0xa0/+0xe0). Returns 4 in state 5, else 2. Side effects: GE commands on layer 7, sounds, writes data. VFPU code read from the Ghidra pseudo-ops; lower confidence. No direct caller (draw task created by ui_start_arcana_roulette).

column2: int ui_create_zone_highlight_task(float scale, int style, float *pos, float *euler, int duration, void *done_cb, void *done_arg)
column3: Creates the draw task ui_draw_zone_highlight_task with 0x94 bytes of data: [0] handle, [1] GE layer 5, [3] duration in frames (-1 = until flagged), [7] style, [8]-[10] position, [11]-[13] Euler angles, [14]-[16] scale on three axes. Returns the task handle, or -1. Side effects: draw task. Callers: 2 (ui_create_zone_highlight_task_dl, ui_create_zone_highlight).

column2: int ui_create_zone_highlight_task_dl(float scale, int layer, int style, float *pos, float *euler, int duration, void *done_cb, void *done_arg)
column3: Creates a zone highlight task (ui_create_zone_highlight_task with the remaining arguments; scale passes through f12) and then sets its GE layer (data +0x04) to layer; ui_create_zone_highlight uses layer 4 for its kind-7 highlight. Returns the task handle, or -1. Side effects: draw task. Callers: 1 (ui_create_zone_highlight).

Draw-task callback of a zone highlight: on the first call builds a 96 x 96 quad (corners +-48) whose UV cell is style mod 4 and style / 4 of a 4 x 2 atlas; draws it with effect texture 0x16 on its layer (data[1]) with depth test, normal blending, colour 0xff0000ff for style 6 else white, under a model matrix translated, rotated (Euler) and scaled from the data; alpha = fade-in (data[4] / 4) x (1 - fade-out data[5] / 8) x pulse (0x098c4f50 + 0x098c4f24 x cos of a 32-frame phase) x 255. Counts its age data[2]; with duration -1 it fades out over 8 frames once task flag 1 is set, otherwise in the last 8 frames of the duration. Returns 2 while running, 4 when finished. Side effects: GE commands, writes data. No direct caller (draw task created by ui_create_zone_highlight_task).

column2: int ui_create_card_glow_task(float scale, int style, float *pos, float *euler, int duration, void *done_cb, void *done_arg)
column3: Creates the draw task ui_draw_card_glow_task with 0x90 bytes of data: [0] handle, [1] style (0 highlight, 1 confirmed material, 2 material), [3] duration (-1 = until flagged), [7]-[9] position, [10]-[12] Euler angles, [13]-[15] scale. Returns the task handle, or -1. Side effects: draw task. Callers: 2 (ui_start_card_highlight, ui_start_card_target_glow).

column2: bool ui_set_card_glow_task_transform(float scale, int handle, float *pos, float *euler)
column3: Moves a card glow task: when the task (handle, passed through to ui_duel_get_draw_task_data) exists, copies pos to data +0x1c, euler to +0x28 and sets the scale vector +0x34 to (scale, scale, scale). Returns true when the task exists. Side effects: writes the task data. Callers: 1 (ui_sync_card_glow_transform).

Draw-task callback of a card glow: on the first call builds a 96 x 96 quad (corners +-48) with UVs per style (style 1 mirrored); draws it on GE layer 5 with depth test and normal blending using effect texture 0x1a (style 0), 0x1c (style 1) or 0x25 (others), under a model matrix translated, rotated (Euler), scaled and turned about Y by age x 0x098c4f20, with the same fade-in, pulse and fade-out alpha as the zone highlight. Ends like it (flag 1 when the duration is -1, else after the duration). Returns 2 while running, 4 when finished. Side effects: GE commands, writes data. No direct caller (draw task created by ui_create_card_glow_task).

column2: void ui_draw_rolling_digit_glyph(float fraction, int layer, int x, int y, int width, int digit, int from_top)
column3: Draws one 19 x 22 glyph (source u = digit x 19 of the bound texture) at (x, y) with the given width on GE layer layer: fully when fraction is 1, nothing when 0, otherwise only fraction x 22 pixels of height, anchored at the top (from_top 1) or at the bottom (the rolling-digit effect). No return value. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 2 (ui_draw_value_change_digits, ui_duel_draw_bouncing_value).

column2: void ui_draw_value_change_digits(float fraction, int x, int y, int from, int to)
column3: Draws a number changing from from to to as 19 x 22 glyphs on GE layer 5: a leading glyph 10 at x, then the digits right to left (narrowed when either number has two or more digits); digits equal in both numbers are drawn whole, differing digits roll vertically with ui_draw_rolling_digit_glyph (the old digit with 1 - fraction, the new with fraction, direction by whether the value rises).
