Draw command handler: stops all card target glows (ui_stop_all_card_target_glows). Returns 1. Side effects: glow tasks ended. No direct caller: handler of the duel draw command table 0x098d0180.

column2: int ui_cmd_show_synchro_material_sent(int side, int zone, int instance)
column3: Draw command handler: on the 3D object of instance in (view side, zone), stops its target glow, starts the material-send effect with kind 0 (Synchro; field_3d_start_material_send_fx(object, view side, zone, 0)) and sets bit 4 of object byte +0x8d. Returns 1. Side effects: the object's flags, effect state. No direct caller: handler of the duel draw command table 0x098d0180.

column2: int ui_cmd_show_chain_link_activated(int side, int zone, int link_number)
column3: Draw command handler for a new chain link: for link 1 only remembers it (pending flag 0x098e9498 = 1, saved side 0x098e94b0, zone 0x098e94b4, number 0x098e94b8 = 1); for link 2 sets the chain-shown flag 0x098e9494 and first pushes the saved link 1 marker; for every link >= 2 pushes the marker of this link (ui_push_chain_link_marker(view side, zone, link_number)) and clears the pending flag. A single-link chain therefore shows no marker. Returns 1. Side effects: writes 0x098e9494-0x098e94b8, chain marker stack. No direct caller: handler of the duel draw command table 0x098d0180.

Completion callback of the chain-resolve layout: from the 8-byte heap record (u16 location code +0: bit 0 side, bits 1-5 zone, bits 6+ link number; card id +4) requests the card-info display of style 0x34 when the card id is positive (ui_request_card_info_display), pops the chain link marker (ui_pop_chain_link_marker(side, zone, number)) and frees the record (system_duel_draw_heap_free). Side effects: card info request, chain marker stack, heap release. No direct caller (installed as the layout callback by ui_cmd_show_chain_link_resolving).

column2: int ui_cmd_show_chain_link_resolving(int side, uint zone, uint link_number)
column3: Draw command handler for a resolving chain link. Reads the last trigger entry of the engine trigger queue (duel_core_get_trigger_queue: entry (count at +0x480) - 1 of 0x18 bytes at +0x300, card id u16 +0). Does nothing while a link 1 is pending (0x098e9498). When the chain-shown flag 0x098e9494 is clear, requests the card info display (style 0x34) for that card when it is non-zero and the entry's flag byte +4 has bit 1 clear and bits 2-3 zero, then pops the chain marker; when the flag is set it clears it, builds an 8-byte heap record (location code with view side, zone, link number; card id) and plays the chain-resolve layout 0x2000c (request +0x1c = 0x34, +0x20 = 1, +0x24 = 0x7a35) with ui_finish_chain_link_resolve_anim as completion callback (+0x14) and the record as its argument (+0x18). Returns 1. Side effects: 0x098e9494, heap record, layout animation, chain markers, card info. No direct caller: handler of the duel draw command table 0x098d0180.

column2: int ui_cmd_show_prompt(int kind, ushort *text, uint arg)
column3: Draw command handler that opens a duel prompt. text is a dialog string number when its high half is 0 (resolved with card_db_get_dialog_string) or a string pointer. Stores kind as the input prompt kind and dispatches: 0 confirm prompt; 1 confirm prompt with a 600-frame timeout unless arg (an engine side) is the local side and the local player is human (then nothing is opened); 2 shows the card info of instance arg (when > 0) and opens a confirm prompt whose third argument is 1 for dialog string 6; 3 sets the engine dialog answer to 0 and, for arg 2/3, opens the card prompt dialog (ui_duel_open_card_prompt_dialog) unless the setting save_get_setting_b2_bits1_2 and the held confirm/cancel buttons (ui_get_pad_state, system_get_confirm_button) skip it, for arg 1 opens it (outside setup mode 2) depending on the trigger queue (+0x59c, +0x490), the view side and the same setting, for arg 0 only while the confirm button is held; 4 engine option list; 5 flag choice; 6 Type (race) select; 7 Attribute select (arg low/high halves); 8 card yes/no dialog plus the card info of instance arg & 0xffff; 9 simple choice; 0xa card row dialog; 0xb number choice (arg bits 16-19, 24-31, 20-23, 0-15); 0xd info panel; 0xe count message. Then ui_cmd_on_phase_banner_done. Returns 1. Side effects: prompt kind 0x098e9acc, the dialog opened, engine dialog answer. No direct caller: handler of the duel draw command table 0x098d0180.

Draw command handler that opens a card list picker by list_kind: 0x4a and 6 a single-pick list (ui_duel_open_card_list_picker(1, 1, 0, 0)); 0x4b-0x4e the card name picker (ui_open_card_name_picker(list_kind)); 0x48 a picker with max = duel_core_get_candidate_pick_limit and min 0; 7-0x26 one with min = max = the pick limit; 0x28-0x47 one with max = the pick limit and min 1; 1-5 a browse list titled with dialog string (list_kind - 1) * 2 + view side + 0x246, after moving the field cursor (locked) to the list's zone (1 → 0xc, 2 → 0xd, 3 → 0xe, 4 → 0xf; not for 5) and with the fourth argument 1 for kinds 3 and 4; 0x27 and other values open nothing. Returns 1. Side effects: picker state, field cursor. No direct caller: handler of the duel draw command table 0x098d0180.

Draw command handler: converts the side bit of the location code to the view side and starts (or defers) the summon effect (field_3d_start_or_defer_summon_fx) on the 3D object at index 0 of that zone when there is one. Returns 1. Side effects: effect state. No direct caller: handler of the duel draw command table 0x098d0180.

Draw command handler: starts (or defers) the placed-summon effect (field_3d_start_or_defer_placed_summon_fx) on the 3D object at index 0 of (view side of code bit 0, zone code bits 1-5) when there is one. Returns 1. Side effects: effect state. No direct caller: handler of the duel draw command table 0x098d0180.

column2: int ui_cmd_show_fusion_synchro_summon(int arg_a, int instance, int show, int method)
column3: Draw command handler (event 0x3a, posted by duel_core_cmd_announce_fusion_synchro_summon; ui.md): when show is non-zero, reads the material references attached to instance (duel_core_get_instance_marker_values, count first, then into a heap array from the duel draw heap), converts them to card ids, and starts the Synchro summon effect (method 2) or the Fusion summon effect (method 0 or 1) with (card id of instance, material ids, show) (ui_start_synchro_summon_fx / ui_start_fusion_summon_fx); frees the array. Returns 1. Side effects: effect state, temporary heap block. No direct caller: handler of the duel draw command table 0x098d0180.

Draw command handler: shows the card info of card_id (ui_card_info_show_card_id(card_id, 0)). Returns 1. Side effects: card info panel. No direct caller: handler of the duel draw command table 0x098d0180.

column2: int ui_cmd_start_coin_toss(uint code, int arg_b, int arg_c)
column3: Draw command handler (coin, 0x3c in ui.md): starts the coin toss with (view side of code bit 0, code bits 6-13, code bits 14-15, arg_c, arg_b) (ui_start_coin_toss). Returns 1. Side effects: coin toss state. No direct caller: handler of the duel draw command table 0x098d0180.

column2: int ui_cmd_roll_dice(int side, int arg_b, int result)
column3: Draw command handler (dice, 0x3d in ui.md): starts the dice roll for the view side of side with result (ui_start_dice_roll(view side, result)); arg_b is unused. Returns 1. Side effects: dice roll state. No direct caller: handler of the duel draw command table 0x098d0180.

Draw command handler: when enable is non-zero starts burst event 0x3e (ui_start_burst_event_3e). Returns 1. Side effects: burst effect state. No direct caller: handler of the duel draw command table 0x098d0180.

Draw command handler for a special duel end: reason 3 starts the Exodia win scene (ui_duel_start_exodia_win_scene), reason 7 the Final Countdown win effect (ui_start_duel_end_card_fx_14); other reasons do nothing. Returns the callee's result, or 1. Side effects: those of the callees (UI mode stack, effects). No direct caller: handler of the duel draw command table 0x098d0180.

column2: int ui_cmd_show_special_win(int arg_a, int arg_b, int progress, int arg_d)
column3: Draw command handler: shows the Destiny Board progress with (progress, arg_d) (ui_show_destiny_board_progress); arg_a and arg_b are unused. Returns 1. Side effects: Destiny Board display state. No direct caller: handler of the duel draw command table 0x098d0180.
Starts the Final Countdown win effect (ui_start_final_countdown_win_fx) and returns 1. Side effects: those of the callee. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_dispatch_duel_end_scene).

Draw command handler: for milestone 0 creates a wait-until object of kind 0x41 with callback ui_close_active_duel_ui_mode (third argument not visible in the decompilation); milestones 1 and 2 and other values do nothing. Returns 1. Side effects: possibly a wait object. No direct caller: handler of the duel draw command table 0x098d0180.

Draw command handler: sets the value range of the cut-in of the side's duelist (field_3d_board_get_side_duelist(view side)) from the current LP display target (ui_get_lp_display_target) to new_lp (field_3d_cutin_set_lp_roll_range). Returns 1. Side effects: cut-in value range. No direct caller: handler of the duel draw command table 0x098d0180.

One-time initialisation of the duel presentation module: changes the current thread attribute (sceKernelChangeCurrentThreadAttr(0, 0x4000), VFPU use), installs the two duel draw heaps (system_duel_draw_set_heaps(heap_a, heap_b)), initialises the 3D render state on GE layer 0 (field_3d_init_render_state, commit), sets the 3D allocator to system_duel_draw_heap_alloc/_free, sorts the duel resource tables (ui_sort_duel_resource_tables), clears the input result 0x098e94cc and the active flag 0x098e94c8 and resets the card menus (ui_reset_card_menus_a). Side effects: heaps, GE layer 0, allocator, resource tables sorted, 0x098e94c8/0x098e94cc, menus. Callers: 1 (system_duel_draw_scene_start); exported; module callers via import stubs: rel_duel_mgr(system_duel_mgr_lib_init, system_duel_mgr_step_module_loading, system_duel_mgr_scene_main).

Takes the duel set-up record of the duel manager: copies its 0x74 bytes (ui_copy_duel_draw_setup) to 0x098e94d8 (word 0 = duelist count, 2 or 4), copies for each of the 4 duelists the 0xc0-byte deck pointed to by setup word 0x11 + i into 0x098e9558 + i * 0xc0 (zeroed when NULL; pointer kept in 0x098e951c + i * 4) and the 0x60-byte block of word 0x15 + i into 0x098e9858 + i * 0x60 (pointer in 0x098e952c + i * 4); clears 0x098e94c8/0x098e94cc, clears all draw flags then sets flag 0x80 (ui_test_set_draw_flags); when both active-duelist words 0x098e953c/0x098e9540 are 0 sets 0x098e9540 to 1; initialises the draw options with setup word 0x1c (ui_init_duel_draw_options); sets the tag-duel flag when the duelist count is >= 3; calls ui_stub_noop_dialog_hook, field_3d_cutin_init_system and ui_reset_duel_ui_mode_state; copies 0x098e953c, 0x098e9540, 0x098e9544 to 0x098e954c, 0x098e9550, 0x098e9554 (active duelist per side and first player). Side effects: the set-up copies 0x098e94d8-0x098e98d7, draw flags, options, tag flag, cut-in system, UI mode state. Callers: 1 (system_duel_draw_scene_start); exported; module callers via import stubs: rel_duel_mgr(system_duel_mgr_lib_start_duel_draw, system_duel_mgr_step_module_loading).
Copies the 0x1d words (0x74 bytes) of the duel draw set-up record from src to dest and returns dest. Side effects: writes dest[0..0x1c]. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_draw_setup).

Tears the duel presentation down at the end of a duel: clears the view matrices, the duel UI mode state, the duel objects (ui_term_duel_objects), the cut-in system, closes the card list and dialogs, calls ui_stub_noop_duel_draw_reset, ui_term_duel_draw_state and destroys the duel object models. Side effects: those of the callees. No direct caller; exported; module callers via import stubs: rel_duel_mgr(system_duel_mgr_finish_duel).

Starts the asynchronous loads of a duel: the duel archives 0x80001 and 0x80002 (ui_load_duel_archive); unless archives_only is non-zero, also gets each duelist's character pair (ui_get_duelist_character for the 0x098e94d8 duelists), sets up and loads the cut-in slots and archives (field_3d_setup_cutin_slots, field_3d_load_cutin_archives), opens the card art readers with the token list (ui_init_card_art_list) and adds each duelist's deck (pointer 0x098e951c + i * 4, passed in a register the decompilation hides) to the card art list (ui_add_deck_to_card_art_list). Side effects: file loads started, cut-in slots, card art list 0x098e9b00. Callers: 1 (system_duel_draw_scene_start); exported; module callers via import stubs: rel_duel_mgr(system_duel_mgr_lib_start_duel_draw, system_duel_mgr_lib_init, system_duel_mgr_step_module_loading).

Polls the loads started by ui_duel_draw_start_loading: returns 0 until both duel archives 0x80001 and 0x80002 are loaded (ui_load_duel_archive returns non-zero) and, unless archives_only is non-zero, the cut-in archives (field_3d_are_cutin_archives_loaded) and the small card arts of every listed card (ui_are_small_card_arts_loaded); then also polls the large arts (result ignored) and returns 1. Side effects: card art textures decoded into the readers' caches as a side effect of the polls. Callers: 1 (system_duel_draw_scene_start); exported; module callers via import stubs: rel_duel_mgr(system_duel_mgr_lib_init, system_duel_mgr_step_module_loading).

Starts the duel presentation after loading: enables font colour codes, initialises the view-side map, the duel draw state and duel objects, the view matrices and the 3D board; builds the deck objects of each duelist (field_3d_board_build_deck_objects(i, deck 0x098e951c[i])); assigns to view sides 0 and 1 the active duelist of their engine side (0x098e954c + engine side * 4); sets both LP display targets to 8000 immediately; sets the HUD turn player to the view side of the first player 0x098e9554 and the HUD phase to 7, both immediate; enters duel UI mode 1 (field cursor); sets up the cut-in slot of every duelist from its character pair; sets the active flag 0x098e94c8. Side effects: the whole duel presentation state, 0x098e94c8. Callers: 1 (system_duel_draw_scene_start); exported; module callers via import stubs: rel_duel_mgr(duel_core_setup_engine_for_duel).

column2: void ui_move_field_cursor(int side, int zone, int index)
column3: Exported wrapper: moves the field cursor to (view side of engine side, zone, index) with ui_field_cursor_set(…, 0). Side effects: field cursor position. No direct caller; exported (1 import stub without callers).

Reads the field cursor location code (ui_field_cursor_get_location) and stores, for each non-NULL pointer, its view side (bit 0), zone (bits 1-5) and index (bits 6+). Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 1 (ui_get_cursor_card_id); exported (1 import stub without callers).

Gets the saved location pair (ui_get_saved_location_pair, arguments passed through) and converts the side bit (bit 0) of each non-NULL output from the view side to the engine side (duel_core_view_side_to_engine). Side effects: writes the outputs. No direct caller; exported (1 import stub without callers).

Exported variant of the phase banner: when immediate is 0 plays the phase banner layout 0x20009 (request +0x1c = 0, +0x24 = 0x7a23) over the frame range of phase (0 0-0x18, 1 0x19-0x31, 2 0x32-0x4a, 3 0x4b-0x63, 4 0x64-0x7c, 5 0x7d-0x95, other 0-end) with ui_play_hud_layout_anim; otherwise does nothing. Side effects: layout animation. No direct caller; exported (1 import stub without callers).

Returns mask & the duel draw flags 0x098e94d0 (value before the change), then clears the mask bits when mode is 0, sets them when mode > 0 and leaves them when mode < 0 (test only). Known bits: 8 cut-in mode active (scene drawing suspended), 0x10 one-frame skip, 4 info panel drawn, 0x20 fade layer drawn, 0x80 set at duel set-up; 0x87 is cleared while the help viewer is open. Side effects: writes 0x098e94d0 when mode >= 0. Callers: 26 (ui_update_action_highlight_flag, ui_is_cutin_mode_active, ui_get_field_input_block_level, field_3d_update_backdrop_transition, ...).

Returns 0x098e9858 + duelist * 0x60, the duelist's 0x60-byte block copied by ui_duel_draw_setup. No side effects. Callers: 3 (ui_card_action_get_mask, ui_cmd_begin_player_input, ui_card_action_execute).

One frame of the duel presentation: sets the depth range 50000-10000 on GE layer 0; draws the duel scene (ui_draw_duel_scene) unless draw flag 8 (cut-in) is set; updates the scene with the frame step 0x098c5f5c; clears flag 0x10 when set; when flag 8 is set and 0x10 clear, sets a scissor (100, 0, 0x118, 0x110) on layer 8, clears it (black, stencil and depth 0), dispatches the cut-in motion start, draws the cut-in layer and runs the current cut-in's frame hook; draws the active duel UI mode on layer 8 (ui_draw_duel_ui_mode), the duel objects, and updates them; under the same cut-in condition draws the cut-in subtitle and updates the current cut-in; with flag 4 and UI mode != 9 draws the info panel; with flag 0x20 draws the screen fade on layer 10. Side effects: GE display lists and all per-frame presentation state. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_draw_frame_if_active).

Returns the character pair of a duelist from the set-up copy: character 0x098e94dc + duelist * 4 and variant 0x098e94ec + duelist * 4; in a network session (system_get_net_active_flag) a character id below 2 is replaced by the pair at 0x098e94fc/0x098e950c (the remote player's choice: hypothesis, confidence medium). Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 3 (ui_set_portrait_expression, ui_duel_draw_start_loading, ui_duel_draw_begin).

Switches the cut-in mode: when active and draw flag 8 is clear, clears the cut-in skip flag, sets flag 8 and pushes duel UI mode 6 (cut-in); when not active and flag 8 is set, pops the UI mode, clears flag 8 and stops the current cut-in. Other combinations do nothing. Side effects: draw flags 0x098e94d0, UI mode stack, cut-in state. No direct caller; exported; module callers via import stubs: rel_duel_mgr(audio_voice_set_talk_active).

Returns draw flag 8 (cut-in mode active) by tail-calling ui_test_set_draw_flags(8, -1) (Ghidra shows the return as void). No side effects. Callers: 2 (ui_request_card_info_display, ui_retry_card_info_display); exported; module callers via import stubs: rel_duel_mgr(audio_voice_set_talk_active).

Clears the 0x44-byte duel draw options block 0x098e9ab0 (tag flag, prompt kind, input pending, coin state, …), stores the argument at 0x098e9ab4 (read by ui_is_cutin_display_enabled: non-zero disables cut-ins) and sets the coin-toss state 0x098e9ac8 to -1. Side effects: writes 0x098e9ab0-0x098e9af3. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_draw_setup).

True when byte +0x191 of the duel set-up buffer (deck_get_duel_setup_buffer) is not 2 (2 = match duel). No side effects. Callers: 3 (ui_cmd_show_duel_result, ui_draw_turn_indicator_layout, ui_draw_duel_hud).

Returns the HUD mark of a match game for side from the duel set-up tail block (deck_get_duel_setup_tail_block): when game is below the game count u16 +0x34, the result s16 +0x36 + game * 2 gives 2 for 3 (draw), (side == 0) for 2, (side != 0) for 1, and -1 otherwise; -1 for games not played. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_duel_hud).

Decides whether the HUD shows the local player as active, with hysteresis: when view side 1 awaits input its counter 0x098e9ad4 counts up and after 0x28 frames the result is false; when side 0 awaits input counter 0x098e9ad0 counts up and after 0x28 frames the result is true; otherwise both counters reset. Before the threshold: true when the engine has an open input mode, or the duel UI mode is 2 or 4, or the turn side is view side 0. Side effects: writes 0x098e9ad0 and 0x098e9ad4. Callers: 3 (ui_draw_player_portrait_panel, ui_draw_hud_button_prompt, ui_is_opponent_side_active).
True when ui_is_local_side_active is false and the turn side is view side 1. Side effects: those of ui_is_local_side_active (its counters). Callers: 1 (ui_draw_player_portrait_panel).
Returns the address of the duelist's name in the duel set-up buffer: buffer + duelist * 0x1ac + 0x1bc (records of 0x1ac bytes). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_duel_hud).
Returns the engine turn counter (duel_core_get_turn_counter) + 1. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_hud_centre_number).

Returns 2 while the cut-in mode is active (draw flag 8); otherwise 1 when the local side is 2 (no local side), or when the local side is not awaiting input, a presentation flag is set (system_any_presentation_flag_set) or the local duelist is not human; otherwise returns (input pending flag 0x098e9ac4 == 0), i.e. 0 lets the player use the field cursor. No side effects. Callers: 5 (ui_field_cursor_draw_normal, ui_field_cursor_mode_draw, ui_can_open_expression_picker, ui_card_info_update, ...).

Returns 1 when the save option flag 2 is on, view_side is not a human duelist, no network session is active and the cancel button (system_get_confirm_button(1)) is not held; otherwise 0. No side effects. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).

True when byte +0x190 of the duel set-up buffer (deck_get_duel_setup_buffer) is 2 (a duel mode in which prompts are auto-answered and help is unavailable; 5 is another mode that blocks the help: hypothesis, confidence medium). No side effects. Callers: 13 (ui_card_info_menu_build_list, ui_update_duel_draw_common_input, ui_can_open_expression_picker, ui_field_cursor_mode_update, ...).

Returns 1 when no network session is active, the save option flag 0 (cut-ins) is on and the options word 0x098e9ab4 is 0; otherwise 0. No side effects. Callers: 7 (field_3d_are_cutin_archives_loaded, ui_show_destiny_board_progress, field_3d_cutin_play_for_card, ui_duel_start_exodia_win_scene, ...).

Returns the index of the first duelist record (0x1ac bytes in the duel set-up buffer) whose s16 +0x1a4 is 1 (the player), searching 2 records or 4 in a tag duel; -1 when none. No side effects. Callers: 3 (ui_set_portrait_expression, ui_is_portrait_expression_settled, ui_draw_portrait_expression_picker).

Copies the saved location codes 0x098e9abe (to out_a) and 0x098e9ac0 (to out_b) when the pointers are non-NULL (ui_copy_location_code). Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 2 (ui_cmd_move_card, ui_get_saved_location_pair_engine).

Normalises two location codes (a code with index 1-4 in bits 6+ becomes zone + index with index 0) and stores them at 0x098e9abe and 0x098e9ac0 (the pair the attack pointer and card movement refer to: hypothesis, confidence medium). Side effects: writes 0x098e9abe and 0x098e9ac0. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer or export).

Decides whether the card at a location code may be shown face up to the local player: zones 0xc-0xf (piles) by the engine's face-up state (duel_core_view_is_card_face_up_at); other zones above 9 except 0xa are never viewable; zones 0-0xa first accept a 3D object with byte +0x85 bit 6; then the hand (0xb) and field cards are viewable when the side is the local side, the card is face up, or its 3D object has byte +0x8c bit 7 or 6 or byte +0x8d bit 0 set (revealed). No side effects. Callers: 5 (ui_card_action_get_mask, ui_field_cursor_mode_update, ui_field_cursor_update, ui_field_cursor_draw, ...).

Per-frame update of the turn-timer blink state: when the timer of view side 0 is negative (no timer) clears both blink words 0x098e9adc/0x098e9ae0; otherwise for each view side compares the timer (duel_core_view_get_turn_timer_frames) with the last value 0x098e9ae4 + side * 4: a rise stores it and clears the blink, a change sets the blink to 1 and restarts the still-counter 0x098e9aec + side * 4, and an unchanged value counts that counter and clears the blink after 0x1e frames. Side effects: writes 0x098e9adc-0x098e9af3. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).

Returns the animation speed index 0-3: the save setting save_get_setting_b1_bits3_4, except while the pad's held buttons equal 0x200 alone (R trigger: hypothesis, confidence medium), when it returns 3 for settings below 3 and 1 for setting 3 (hold to speed up). No side effects. Callers: 16 (ui_update_card_object_motion, ui_duel_get_anim_frame_step, ui_start_zone_stat_tweens, ui_create_card_info_display, ...).
Returns the word 0x098d0574 + ui_get_anim_speed() * 4 (a per-speed factor table). No side effects. Callers: 2 (ui_move_attack_pointer, ui_update_burst_event_hold).

Sorts by id (qsort, comparator 0x0989ff00) the four duel resource tables: models 0x098d0960 (0x28 records of 0x18 bytes), archives 0x098d0dd0 (4 of 0xcc), textures 0x098d1380 (0x23 of 0x10) and layouts 0x098d16e0 (0xd of 0x14), so ui_find_resource_entry can binary-search them. Side effects: reorders the tables. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_draw_init).

Releases the duel presentation resources: ui_release_duel_resources, ui_destroy_card_art_readers, field_3d_release_cutin_slots, field_3d_destroy_duel_object_models, then waits frame by frame until the file thread is idle (container_is_file_thread_busy). Side effects: those of the callees. Callers: 2 (ui_duel_draw_term, system_duel_draw_scene_end).

Clears the caches of the duel resource tables: destroys the model instances of the 0x28 model records (+0x14 at 0x098d0974) and clears them; frees the buffers of the 4 archive records (+0xc4 at 0x098d0e94) to the duel draw heap; for the 0x23 texture records frees the cached data (+0xc) when the archive id +4 is -1 (stand-alone file) and clears the cache in every case; clears the cache (+0x10) of the 0xd layout records. column3: Plays a duel movie: looks up its path (ui_find_duel_movie_path; returns -1 when none), builds the full path in a 256-byte buffer (container_resolve_path_lbn with root 3), allocates 0x17cc00 bytes of movie work memory from the duel draw movie heap (system_movie_set_work_memory), ends the frame, plays it (system_movie_play_with_volume(path, flags, 0x28)), clears 0x110000 bytes of VRAM (sceGeEdramGetAddr) and releases the work memory. Returns 1 when the player returned non-zero, else 0. Side effects: blocking playback, VRAM cleared, heap use. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_movie_mode_draw); exported; module callers via import stubs: rel_duel_mgr(audio_voice_queue_process).

Finds the movie path for a key in the table 0x098d27f0 (0x4b records of 0x10 bytes, path pointer at +8; sorted on first use with qsort, flag 0x09bdd144, comparator 0x098a44d8): searches first for key + 100000 (with key_b as the second compared word), then for key; returns the path or NULL. Side effects: sorts the table once. Callers: 2 (ui_play_duel_movie, ui_preload_duel_movie).
Frees the card name picker block 0x09bdd148 to the duel draw heap and clears the pointer, when allocated. Side effects: heap release, 0x09bdd148. Callers: 1 (ui_reset_card_menus_b).

Opens the card name picker (declare a card name): allocates the 0x3794-byte picker block (u32 card ids from +0, count +0x3788, chosen index +0x378c, window +0x3790) in 0x09bdd148, builds its list for list_kind (ui_build_card_name_picker_list), opens the message window with duel string 0x2c as caption, style 0x20 and set-up callback ui_card_name_picker_setup_window, pushes duel UI mode 4 with argument 0x36, installs the close/update callbacks ui_close_card_name_picker/ui_update_card_name_picker and plays sound 0x7a0c. Side effects: heap block, message window, UI mode stack, sound. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_open_card_list).

Set-up callback of the card name picker window: before opening (before_open != 0) stores the window in the picker block +0x3790, sets the item count +0xcc to the list count, 10 visible rows (+0xce), the item width +0xf0 (ui_card_name_picker_get_width: 200 or 300) and height +0xf2 = 0x12, and the item draw callback +0xfc = 0x098a46a0; after opening moves the window down by 16 pixels (+0x5a). Side effects: writes the window and picker block. No direct caller (callback passed to ui_open_message_window).

Close callback of the card name picker: sets the engine dialog answer to the card id at the chosen index (block +0x378c) (duel_core_set_dialog_answer), frees the picker block and clears 0x09bdd148. Side effects: engine answer, heap release. No direct caller (message window close callback).

Fills the picker block 0x09bdd148 with the valid non-token card ids of 0xe88-0x1f39 (card_db_is_valid, card_db_is_token) filtered by list_kind: 0x4e monsters only, 0x4d monsters whose frame (card_db_get_frame) is not 3, 0x4c any card whose frame is not 3, other kinds every card; stores the count at +0x3788 and sorts by card_db_get_sort_position (ui_compare_card_sort_position). Side effects: writes the picker block. Callers: 1 (ui_open_card_name_picker).
qsort comparator: card_db_get_sort_position(*a) - card_db_get_sort_position(*b). No side effects. No direct caller (passed to qsort by ui_build_card_name_picker_list).

Update callback of the card name picker: while pad input is available updates the list window (ui_update_list_window, result stored as chosen index +0x378c); when the window is open (state +0xe9 = 3) adds page jumps: left jumps to the first card of the previous sort group (card_db_get_top_group), right to the next group (sound 0x7a0d), R + up / R + down move 9 entries; then sets the window's top index +0xd0 and cursor row (+0xd2 bits 0-4) so the target is visible in the 10-row view. Returns true when the message window is no longer open. Side effects: window and picker state, sounds. No direct caller (message window update callback).
Returns the picker item width: 200 for language 0 (Japanese), otherwise 300. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_card_name_picker_setup_window).

Opens the grid selector (Type/Attribute dialogs): clears the 0x150-byte state 0x09bdd14c, copies the 0x2c-byte descriptor (ui_grid_select_copy_descriptor: first value, end value, columns, caption, label/item/mark draw callbacks, cell width/height, min and max picks), copies the caption (UTF-16, up to 0x40 characters) to 0x09bdd214 and points the caption field 0x09bdd158 at the copy, and clears 0x09bdd292. Side effects: writes the grid state. Callers: 2 (ui_duel_open_race_select_dialog, ui_duel_open_attribute_select_dialog).
Copies the 11-word (0x2c-byte) grid selector descriptor from src to dest and returns dest. Side effects: writes dest[0..10]. Callers: 1 (ui_grid_select_open).

Sizes a list window for the grid selector: rows = ceil((end - first) / columns); sets window flags +0xc8 bits 0 and 1, item width +0xf0 and height +0xf2 from the cell size, item count +0xcc = columns, +0x60 = 0; stores the grid pixel width (columns * cell width) in 0x09bdd294 and height (rows * cell height) in 0x09bdd298; window width +0x6c = grid width + margins +0x90/+0x92 + 9, height +0x6e = grid height + byte +0x98 + margins +0x94/+0x96 + 0x32. Side effects: writes the window and 0x09bdd294/0x09bdd298. Callers: 2 (ui_attribute_select_setup_window, ui_race_select_setup_window).

column2: void * ui_grid_select_draw_grid(void *list, void *window, int x, int y)
column3: Draws the grid selector at (x, y): the header bar with the label of the highlighted value (ui_grid_select_draw_header_bar; none on the confirm row 9), then every cell (columns of the window +0xcc, cell size from the window), with the list-window cursor frame on the highlighted cell, the item drawn by the descriptor callback 0x09bdd160 (list, x + centre, y + centre, value) and the selected mark by 0x09bdd164 for picked cells; finally positions and draws the confirm button window 0x09bdd210 centred below the grid. Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands, confirm window position. Callers: 2 (ui_race_select_draw_panel, ui_attribute_select_draw_panel).

Input of the grid selector, by state 0x09bdd20c: 2/3 (closing) update the window and free the confirm window when it reaches state 6; 1 waits until the confirm window leaves state 4, then starts closing the main window (state 2). State 0 (while the message window is idle): cancel removes the last pick, or with no picks and a cancellable window (+0xc8 bit 2 clear) sets +0xe8 bit 0 and closes (state 3); up/down move the cursor row 0x09bdd184 with row 9 as the confirm button; left/right move the column 0x09bdd180 within the row; confirm on row 9 accepts when at least the minimum 0x09bdd170 is picked (chooses item 0 of the confirm window, state 1, sound 0x7a05; otherwise error sound 0x7a07), confirm on a cell toggles it (a new pick needs fewer than the maximum 0x09bdd174 picks and the window's disabled mask +0xdc bit clear; reaching the maximum moves the cursor to the confirm row). Sounds 0x7a04 move, 0x7a05/0x7a06/0x7a07. Side effects: grid state, selection list, windows, sounds. Callers: 2 (ui_attribute_select_update, ui_race_select_update).

Returns the grid pixel width cached in 0x09bdd178, computing it as cell width 0x09bdd168 * columns 0x09bdd154 when not yet set. Side effects: writes the cache. Callers: 5 (ui_race_select_draw_panel, ui_attribute_select_draw_panel, ui_grid_select_draw_grid, ui_attribute_select_setup_window, ...).

Returns the grid panel height cached in 0x09bdd17c, computing it as ceil((end - first) / columns) * cell height + 0x2a when not yet set. Side effects: writes the cache. Callers: 5 (ui_race_select_draw_panel, ui_attribute_select_draw_panel, ui_grid_select_draw_grid, ui_attribute_select_setup_window, ...).

Returns the picked grid cells as a bit mask: OR of 1 << index for each of the 0x09bdd208 picks in 0x09bdd188, shifted left by the descriptor's first value 0x09bdd14c (so bit n is value n). No side effects. Callers: 2 (ui_race_select_on_decide, ui_attribute_select_on_decide).

column2: uint * ui_grid_select_draw_header_bar(void *list, int x, int y, int width, int height, int value)
column3: Draws the grid selector's header bar: binds window01.gim from the icon archive (container_get_icon_archive) and draws three sprites (left cap 4 px, middle stretched to width - 9, right cap 5 px, 16 px high, from texture row 0x60) vertically centred in height; when value >= 0 and the label callback 0x09bdd15c returns a string, draws it in white at scale 10x12 (ui_draw_text_to_screen_right_edge) through the font's external list. Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_grid_select_draw_grid).

column2: void ui_draw_text_to_screen_right_edge(int x, int y, ushort *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 2 (ui_grid_select_draw_confirm_label, ui_grid_select_draw_header_bar).

column2: void ui_grid_select_create_confirm_window(short x, short y, short width, short height)
column3: Allocates and opens the 0x120-byte confirm-button list window of the grid selector (pointer 0x09bdd210): zeroed, +0x4c = 1, position +0x58/+0x5a, size +0x6c/+0x6e, +0x70 = -1, heap +0xc4 = duel draw heap, flags +0xc8 bits 0, 1, 3, one item (+0xcc = 1), item draw callback +0x100 = ui_grid_select_draw_confirm_label; then ui_open_list_window. Does nothing when the allocation fails. Side effects: heap block, window opened, 0x09bdd210. Callers: 1 (ui_grid_select_open_confirm_button).
Resets (ui_list_window_reset) and frees the confirm window 0x09bdd210 and clears the pointer, when it exists. Side effects: heap release, 0x09bdd210. Callers: 1 (ui_grid_select_update).

column2: void ui_grid_select_draw_confirm_label(void *list, int x, int y)
column3: Item draw callback of the confirm window: draws the cursor frame when the grid cursor is on the confirm row (0x09bdd184 == 9), then the caption copy 0x09bdd214 centred in the window at scale 12x12, grey (0xff808080) while fewer than the minimum picks are made, black otherwise. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window callback installed by ui_grid_select_create_confirm_window).
Returns 1 when index is among the 0x09bdd208 picks at 0x09bdd188, else 0. No side effects. Callers: 3 (ui_toggle_list_item_selection, ui_grid_select_draw_grid, ui_grid_select_update).

Adds index to the pick list 0x09bdd188 (count 0x09bdd208) when select is non-zero and it is not picked, or removes it (shifting the later picks down) when select is 0 and it is picked. Side effects: writes the pick list and count. Callers: 1 (ui_grid_select_update).

column2: void ui_open_confirm_prompt(ushort *text, int kind, int flag, int timeout)
column3: Opens a yes/no style prompt: stores flag in 0x09bdd29c and timeout (frames, 0 = none) in 0x09bdd2a0, opens the message window with text and choice style 3 for kind 2, otherwise 1 (set-up callback ui_confirm_prompt_setup_window), pushes duel UI mode 4 with argument 0x36, installs ui_close_confirm_prompt and ui_update_confirm_prompt and plays sound 0x7a0c. Side effects: message window, 0x09bdd29c/0x09bdd2a0, UI mode stack, sound. Callers: 2 (ui_cmd_show_prompt, ui_open_word3_confirm_prompt).

Close callback of the confirm prompt: clears the timeout 0x09bdd2a0 and sets the engine dialog answer to 1 when the message window choice is 1 or 2, else 0 (duel_core_set_dialog_answer). Side effects: engine answer, 0x09bdd2a0. No direct caller (message window close callback).

Update callback of the confirm prompt. When the duel set-up word +0x854 is 0, the window is open (+0xe9 = 3), the prompt kind is >= 0 and confirm or cancel was pressed: maps the pressed button to the current choice (confirm: +0xd3 & 0xf; cancel: +0xd4) and asks the validator 0x09bdd2a8 (prompt kind, answer 1 or 0); a refusal hides the pad from the window for this frame (zeroed 0x28-byte state at +0x11c). Updates the list window (unless +0x854 is set) and stores the choice (ui_set_message_window_choice; a result of -2 becomes +0xd4). With a timeout, counts 0x09bdd2a0 down by 2 * speed^3 + 1 per frame (ui_get_anim_speed) and closes the window at 0. Returns true when the message window is no longer open. Side effects: window state, choice, timeout. No direct caller (message window update callback).

Resets the duel message window 0x09bdd2ac (ui_list_window_reset) and frees its two heap blocks 0x09bdd3e0 and 0x09bdd3e4 when present. Side effects: window state, heap release. Callers: 1 (ui_close_card_list_and_dialogs).

Draw handler of the duel message window: saves the font flags, enables Japanese line breaking (system_font_set_flag_1) for language 0 or trimming of wrap spaces otherwise, calls the extra draw callback 0x09bdd3d0 when set, draws the list window 0x09bdd2ac (ui_draw_list_window) and restores the flags. Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (draw handler of the message-window UI modes in table 0x098d1f5c: hypothesis, confidence medium).

Update handler of the duel message window: when an update callback 0x09bdd3d8 is installed returns its result for the window 0x09bdd2ac; otherwise feeds the pad state to the window (+0x11c), updates it (ui_update_list_window, result stored at 0x09bdd3dc), calls the cursor-move callback 0x09bdd3d4 (window, old index) when the selected index (top +0xd0 + row +0xd2) changed, and returns 1 when the window is no longer open. Side effects: window state, 0x09bdd3dc. No direct caller (update handler in table 0x098d1f5c: hypothesis, confidence medium).

Returns 0 when the message window state byte 0x09bdd395 (window +0xe9) is 0, 1 or 6 (closed), else 1. No side effects. Callers: 7 (ui_engine_option_list_update, ui_attribute_select_update, ui_update_message_window, ui_race_select_update, ...).

Calls the message window close callback 0x09bdd3cc once and clears it. Side effects: the callback's effects (typically the engine answer), 0x09bdd3cc. No direct caller (exit handler of the message-window UI modes: hypothesis, confidence medium).
Returns the message window word 0x09bdd3e8 (block +0x13c). No side effects. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).
True when the message window word 0x09bdd3ec (block +0x140) is 0. No side effects. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).
Adds dx and dy to the message window position 0x09bdd304/0x09bdd306 (window +0x58/+0x5a). Side effects: writes the position. Callers: 1 (ui_open_word3_confirm_prompt).

column2: void ui_open_message_window(ushort *caption, ushort *text, int style, void *setup)
column3: Opens the duel message window 0x09bdd2ac (0x144-byte list window block): clears it, applies window defaults (ui_init_window_defaults), sets caption and text, stores style 0x20/0x30 in +0xc9 bits 3-6 (2 or 3) or choice style 1/3 in +0xca bits 0-3, sets +0x64 = 0x109, calls setup(window, 1), opens the list window with Japanese line breaking (language 0) or wrap-space trimming, centres it on (314, 132) from its size +0x6c/+0x6e, and calls setup(window, 0). Side effects: the window block, font flags restored. Callers: 13 (ui_open_confirm_prompt, ui_duel_open_card_info_menu, ui_duel_open_phase_select_dialog, ui_duel_open_engine_option_list, ...).

Returns the last result of the message window 0x09bdd3dc; when the window has a choice style (+0xca bits 0-3 of 0x09bdd376 non-zero) any result other than 1, 2 or 3 is returned as 0. No side effects. Callers: 9 (ui_number_choice_on_decide, ui_card_prompt_on_decide, ui_simple_choice_on_decide, ui_card_yes_no_on_decide, ...).

Replaces the message window caption: frees the previous copy 0x09bdd3e0, allocates a copy of the UTF-16 caption from the duel draw heap (wcslen/wcscpy) when caption is non-NULL, and points the window's caption field 0x09bdd34c (+0xa0) at it (NULL when none). Side effects: heap, 0x09bdd3e0, 0x09bdd34c. Callers: 1 (ui_open_message_window).

Replaces the message window body text: frees the previous copy 0x09bdd3e4, copies text to a new duel draw heap block when non-NULL and points the window's text field 0x09bdd330 (+0x84) at it. Side effects: heap, 0x09bdd3e4, 0x09bdd330. Callers: 2 (ui_phase_select_set_caption, ui_open_message_window).

Stores value in the message window word 0x09bdd3e8 (block +0x13c; set to 1 by the card info and card action menus). Side effects: writes 0x09bdd3e8. Callers: 2 (ui_duel_open_card_info_menu, ui_duel_open_card_action_menu).
Stores (value == 0) in the message window word 0x09bdd3ec (block +0x140). Side effects: writes 0x09bdd3ec. Callers: 1 (ui_open_word3_confirm_prompt).

Clears a 0x120-byte list window and sets the duel defaults: +0x4c = 1, +0x55 = 2, +0x60 = 1, +0x70 = -1, +0x78/+0x7c/+0x88 = 1, margins +0x90/+0x92 = 10 and +0x94/+0x96 = 8, font size +0x98 = 0xc, text colour +0x9c = 0xff000000, +0xa4 = 0xc, +0xa8 = -1, +0xac/+0xb0 = 2, scales +0xb4/+0xb8 = 1.0, heap +0xc4 = the duel draw heap, flag byte +0xc8 = bits 1 and 2 only, +0xc9 bit 0 and bits 3-6 clear, +0xca low nibble clear, and the item/cursor fields +0xcc-+0x118 zero. Side effects: writes the window. Callers: 5 (ui_card_list_open_command_menu, ui_card_list_open_filter_menu, ui_card_row_dialog_open_sub_window, ui_open_message_window, ...).

Opens the duel info panel (a one-line message box) unless it is already in use (state 0x09bdd6b4 non-zero): initialises the window list 0x09bdd3f0 on the duel draw heap, sets state 6, the close test 0x09bdd6c0 = ui_info_panel_default_close_test, clears the offsets and extra draw callback 0x09bdd6c4-0x09bdd6cc, copies 0x200 bytes of text to 0x09bdd4b4, builds the 0x78-byte window descriptor 0x09bdd43c (text pointer, +0x18 = 0x109, margins 10/10/8/8, font 0xc, colour 0xff202020, scale 1.0, +0x70 = 6), adds and opens it, then sets state 3 (panel at the top) when the field cursor is on view side 0 or 2 (bottom) otherwise, registers the field-cursor blocker 0x098a6d44 (ui_field_cursor_add_listener) and plays sound 0x7a0c. Side effects: info panel state 0x09bdd3f0-0x09bdd6cf, cursor blocker, sound. Callers: 5 (ui_duel_open_auto_close_message, ui_duel_open_count_message, ui_open_info_panel_at_offset, ui_cmd_show_prompt, ...).

column2: void ui_open_info_panel_at_offset(ushort *text, int dx, int dy)
column3: Opens the info panel with text (ui_open_info_panel) and stores the position offsets dx in 0x09bdd6c8 and dy in 0x09bdd6cc. Side effects: those of ui_open_info_panel, the offsets. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_open_count_message).

Per-frame update and draw of the info panel: returns when the panel is unused (state 0) or in state 6 with its window closed (window state 4); otherwise runs ui_update_info_panel, draws the window list 0x09bdd3f0 on GE layer 9 (ui_draw_window_list), calls the extra draw callback 0x09bdd6c4 (list, window list, descriptor) when set, and commits the layer. Side effects: GE commands, panel state. Callers: 1 (ui_run_duel_draw_frame).
Returns 1 when the info panel state 0x09bdd6b4 is 0 (unused) or 6 (closed), else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).
Stores the extra draw callback of the info panel in 0x09bdd6c4 (called by ui_draw_info_panel after the window list). Side effects: writes 0x09bdd6c4. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_open_count_message).

State machine of the info panel (state 0x09bdd6b4; 3/4 placed at the top, 1/2 at the bottom, 4 and 1 moving to the other position, 5 closing, 6 closed): when the window has closed (window state 4) 5 becomes 6, 4 becomes 2 and 1 becomes 3, and a closed window in state 2 or 3 is reopened; the window y is 0x42 - height/2 (top) or 0xca - height/2 (bottom) plus the offset 0x09bdd6cc, x is 314 - width/2 plus 0x09bdd6c8. When the close test 0x09bdd6c0 returns 0, a moving panel (1, 4) closes its window once its transition is done; when it returns non-zero, state 6 with a closed window frees the window list, removes the cursor blocker and sets state 0, and other open states close the window (state 5). Side effects: panel state and window position, window list. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_info_panel).

Field-cursor blocker callback of the info panel: given the cursor location code, moves the panel away from the cursor: for view side 0 (bit 0 clear) state 4 becomes 3 and 2 becomes 1 (go to the top); for side 1, 3 becomes 4 and 1 becomes 2 (go to the bottom). Side effects: writes 0x09bdd6b4. No direct caller (registered with ui_field_cursor_add_listener by ui_open_info_panel).
Default close test of the info panel: true when duel_core_get_pending_action_count_result returns 0. No side effects. No direct caller (installed in 0x09bdd6c0 by ui_open_info_panel).

column2: void * ui_draw_polyline_frame(void *list, int style, int count, float *points, int closed)
column3: Draws a frame line through count points (x, y, z floats, stride 0xc) with the window01.gim texture of the icon archive: stores style in 0x09bdd6d0 (index of a 0x58-byte style record at 0x098d2cd8 giving the texture rectangles), reserves 2 * count * 0x14 bytes of inline vertices, classifies each segment as right/down/left/up, emits a corner sprite between consecutive directions (helpers at 0x098a7398-0x098a7950) and a straight segment for each direction (ui_emit_polyline_segment_down and siblings), closing the shape when closed is non-zero, and draws both vertex arrays as sprites (prim 6, vtype 0x800102). Returns the display list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 5 (ui_engine_option_list_draw_item, ui_card_list_draw_sort_item, ui_draw_coin_toss_result_icon, ui_race_select_draw_panel, ...).

column2: void ui_draw_frame_style_quad(void *list, int style, float *top_left, float *bottom_right)
column3: Draws one textured sprite from window01.gim (icon archive) between the two corner positions, using the texture rectangle (u, v, width, height at +0x20 of the 0x58-byte style record 0x098d2cd8 + style * 0x58). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 2 (ui_card_list_draw_sort_item, ui_draw_coin_toss_result_icon).

column2: short * ui_emit_polyline_segment_down(short *vertices, short x, short y, int x_end, short y_end)
column3: Writes the two sprite vertices of a downward frame segment: texture rectangle from the style record selected by 0x09bdd6d0 (u, v at +0, size at +4 of 0x098d2cd8 + style * 0x58), positions (x - width, y_end, 0) and (x, y, 0). Returns vertices + 10 shorts. Side effects: writes 20 bytes of vertices. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_polyline_frame).

Opens the chain-response card prompt (prompt kind 3): clears the 0x4c-byte prompt state 0x09bdd6d4, collects the cards that could be activated (ui_card_prompt_collect_cards), opens the message window with text and choice style 3 (set-up callback 0x098a7a5c), pushes duel UI mode 4 with argument 0x36, installs ui_card_prompt_on_decide and ui_update_confirm_prompt and plays sound 0x7a0c. mode is not used here. Side effects: prompt state, message window, UI mode stack, sound. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_show_prompt).
Close callback of the card prompt: sets the engine dialog answer to 1 when the message window choice is 1 or 2, else 0. Side effects: engine answer. No direct caller (message window close callback).

Draw callback of the card prompt: draws the small art of each collected card (references 0x09bdd6d8, count 0x09bdd718; ui_bind_card_art_texture of duel_core_get_card_id_by_ref) as 20x30 sprites 22 px apart, centred along the bottom of the window 0x09bdd6d4 (40 px above its lower edge); when more cards exist than fit (flag 0x09bdd71c, or the count exceeds (width - 9) / 22) the last slot is replaced by the text at 0x098d2f80 (an ellipsis: hypothesis, confidence medium) at scale 6x12. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window draw callback).

column2: void ui_card_prompt_draw_text(int x, int y, ushort *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (ui_card_prompt_draw_cards).

Collects up to 16 card references that the local player could activate in response, for the card prompt: with the current trigger entry (last of the engine trigger queue, count +0x484, entries of 0x18 bytes at +0x300, or NULL), the field slots 0-10 of both sides that duel_core_view_can_activate_slot_card accepts (duel_core_view_get_slot_instance) and the hand cards of view side 0 that duel_core_view_can_activate_hand_card accepts (duel_core_view_get_hand_instance) go to 0x09bdd6d8 (count 0x09bdd718); the overflow flag 0x09bdd71c is set when 16 are reached or a list candidate exists (duel_core_view_build_candidate_list(0, 0xfffe, 0xe | 0x20000 with a trigger)). Side effects: writes 0x09bdd6d8-0x09bdd71f. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_open_card_prompt_dialog).

Opens the card info menu (triangle on the field): stores the 8-byte request (card id, location callback) at 0x09bdd720 (ui_card_info_menu_store_ref), builds the item list (ui_card_info_menu_build_list) and, when it has items, opens the message window (style 0x20, set-up ui_card_info_menu_setup_window), pushes duel UI mode 4 with argument 0x36, installs ui_card_info_menu_on_decide and the layout callback ui_card_info_menu_layout_callback, sets the window word 0x09bdd3e8 to 1 and plays sound 0x7a08. Side effects: menu state, message window, UI mode stack, sound. Callers: 1 (ui_field_cursor_mode_update).

Builds the card info menu items in 0x09bdd72c: 0 view card (when the card id 0x09bdd720 is positive), 1 (when the open input mode is 2 or 3; closes the input), 2 options (unless setup mode 2), 3 help (when ui_can_open_duel_help); stores the count in 0x09bdd73c and the widest label width (duel strings from the table 0x098d2f94, 16-byte records, measured at scale 12) in 0x09bdd740. Side effects: writes 0x09bdd72c-0x09bdd743. Callers: 2 (ui_card_info_menu_setup_window, ui_duel_open_card_info_menu).

Set-up callback of the card info menu window: before opening stores the window in 0x09bdd728, rebuilds the list, clears flag +0xc8 bit 2, sets item count +0xcc and visible rows +0xce to the item count, item size 100 x 15, draw callback ui_card_info_menu_draw_item, +0x56 = 1 and all margins 2; after opening sets the item width +0xf0 (and +0xf8) to the widest label + 0x12, the window width +0x6c to it plus margins + 8, and clamps y +0x5a at 0. Side effects: writes the window. No direct caller (callback passed to ui_open_message_window).

Close callback of the card info menu: for the chosen item (message window choice >= 0) 3 opens the help mode, 2 the options mode, 1 closes the player input when answered, 0 sets the card viewer card to 0x09bdd720 and pushes duel UI mode 5. Side effects: UI mode stack, engine input. No direct caller (message window close callback).

column2: void ui_card_info_menu_place_at_card(void *window, int side, uint zone, uint index)
column3: Positions a menu window over a card on the 3D board: takes the position and rotation of the hand card's 3D object (zone 0xb) or of the location transform (field_3d_board_get_location_transform of the code side | zone << 1 | index << 6), multiplies the GU projection, view and model matrices (sceVfpuMatrix4Mul) and transforms the position (sceVfpuMatrix4Transform); screen x = px * 480 / w + 314, y = -py * 272 / w + 132 - 20 - window height; sets window x (+0x58) centred on it, clamped to [0x94, 480 - width], y (+0x5a) clamped at 0, and the pointer offset +0x74 = screen x - window x clamped to [4, width - 4]. Does nothing for a NULL window. Side effects: writes the window position. Callers: 1 (ui_card_info_menu_layout_callback).

Draw callback of the card info menu: gets the location from the request's callback 0x09bdd724, copies it (ui_copy_location_code) and places the menu window 0x09bdd728 over that card (ui_card_info_menu_place_at_card). Returns list unchanged. Side effects: window position. No direct caller (message window draw callback).

column2: void ui_card_info_menu_draw_item(void *list, uint item, int x, int y)
column3: Item draw callback of the card info menu: for the item kind of row item (0x09bdd72c), draws a 13x13 icon from texture 0x40005 at the (u, v) of the 16-byte record 0x098d2f8c + kind * 0x10 and the label (duel string of the record) in black at scale 12, 15 px to the right. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window item callback).

column2: void ui_card_info_menu_draw_text(int x, int y, ushort *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (ui_card_info_menu_draw_item).

While pad input is available, updates the auxiliary list window 0x09bdd744 (ui_update_list_window) and stores the result in 0x09bddc68. Side effects: window state, 0x09bddc68. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).
Returns 0 when the state byte 0x09bdd82d (+0xe9) of the auxiliary window 0x09bdd744 is 0, 1 or 6, else 1. No side effects. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).

Opens the 6-item icon choice dialog of prompt kind 5 (the phase choice: hypothesis, confidence medium, see ui_phase_select_on_decide): clears the 0xc-byte state 0x09bddc70 and stores the mask of selectable items, opens the message window with text as caption and body (style 0x30, set-up ui_phase_select_setup_window), pushes duel UI mode 4 with argument 0x36, installs ui_phase_select_on_decide, the draw callback 0x098a8b50 and the cursor callback ui_phase_select_set_caption, and plays sound 0x7a08. Side effects: dialog state, message window, UI mode stack, sound. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_show_prompt).

Set-up callback of the icon choice dialog: before opening places the cursor (+0xd4) on the first enabled item (mask 0x09bddc70, items 0-5), sets 6 items in one row (+0xcc, +0xce = 6), the disabled mask +0xdc = ~mask, flags (+0xc8 bit 2 clear, bit 5 set, +0xc9 bit 0 set), cell 40x40 with spacing values +0xf4 = 5, +0xf8 = 0x1e, +0xfa = 0x28, the item draw callback ui_phase_select_draw_item, and stores the window in 0x09bddc78; after opening measures the five captions (duel strings 0x15-0x19), widens the window to at least its margins + 8 and shows the caption of the current item (ui_phase_select_set_caption). Side effects: writes the window and 0x09bddc78. No direct caller (callback passed to ui_open_message_window).

column2: void ui_phase_select_set_caption(void *window, int arg, int item)
column3: Cursor callback of the icon choice dialog: sets the message window text to duel string 0x15 + item (ui_set_message_window_text) and stores item in 0x09bddc74. Side effects: window text, 0x09bddc74. Callers: 1 (ui_phase_select_setup_window); also installed as the message window cursor callback.

Close callback of the icon choice dialog: for a choice >= 0, in setup mode 2 submits it as action code 0x0d + choice (ui_submit_player_action(0, 0, 0, choice + 0xd, 0); the phase menu codes of duel-runtime.md), and when that submission is refused replaces the answer by the lowest enabled item below 0xd; then sets the engine dialog answer. Side effects: engine answer or player action. No direct caller (message window close callback).

column2: void * ui_phase_select_draw_item(void *list, uint item, int x, int y)
column3: Item draw callback of the icon choice dialog: draws the 20x32 icon of item from texture 0x40025 (u = item * 0x14, v = 0 when enabled in 0x09bddc70, 0x20 when disabled) at (x + 10, y + 4) and, between items, a 7x11 arrow (u 0x78) that blinks every 15 frames (system_get_frame_timing) next to the item after the cursor. Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window item callback).

Opens the Ritual level counter message (prompt kind 0xe): the info panel with text (at offset (0, 15) in setup mode 2), the extra draw callback ui_count_message_draw_icons, the close test ui_count_message_is_done, a panel 40 px taller (descriptor +0x22/+0x4a), the initial remaining level total 0x09bddc7c (duel_effects_get_ritual_level_total) and a 10-frame close delay 0x09bddc80. Side effects: info panel, 0x09bddc7c, 0x09bddc80. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_show_prompt).

Extra draw callback of the count message: while the panel window is open (state 2) draws one 17x17 icon (texture 0x40005, u 0x33, v 0x20) per level of the initial total 0x09bddc7c, 20 px apart and centred, in full colour for the levels already covered (initial - duel_effects_get_ritual_level_total) and grey (0xff808080) for the rest; otherwise sets presentation flag 0x36. Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands, presentation flag. No direct caller (info panel callback).

Close test of the count message: returns 1 when the remaining Ritual level total is below 1 and the delay 0x09bddc80 has run out (it is decremented each call), else 0. Side effects: writes 0x09bddc80. No direct caller (info panel close test).

Opens the Attribute selector (prompt kind 7): builds a grid descriptor (values 1-6, 6 columns, caption = a duel string whose index the decompilation hides, labels card_db_get_attribute_name, item draw 0x098a9530, mark draw ui_attribute_select_draw_cursor, 25x25 cells, min = max = pick_count), stores disabled in 0x09bddc88, opens the grid (ui_grid_select_open) and the message window (caption duel string 0x2c, body text, style 0x30, set-up ui_attribute_select_setup_window), pushes duel UI mode 4 with argument 0x36, installs ui_attribute_select_update/ui_attribute_select_on_decide and plays sound 0x7a0c. Side effects: grid state, message window, UI mode stack, sound. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_show_prompt).

Set-up callback of the Attribute selector: before opening stores the window in 0x09bddc84, lays out the grid (ui_grid_select_layout_window), sets the draw callback +0x100 = ui_attribute_select_draw_panel, the disabled mask +0xdc = ~(0x09bddc88 >> 1), +0x60 = 0, and the window size from the grid size plus margins (+0x5c wide, +0x3a high); after opening opens the confirm button (ui_grid_select_open_confirm_button). Side effects: writes the window and 0x09bddc84. No direct caller (callback passed to ui_open_message_window).

Close callback of the Attribute selector: sets the engine dialog answer to the picked attributes as a bit mask (ui_get_list_selection_mask, bit n = attribute n). Side effects: engine answer. No direct caller (message window close callback).

Update callback of the Attribute selector: runs the grid input on window 0x09bddc84 (ui_grid_select_update) and returns true when the message window is no longer open. Side effects: grid state. No direct caller (message window update callback).

column2: void ui_attribute_select_draw_panel(void *list, int x, int y)
column3: Draw callback of the Attribute selector: draws the panel background (window01.gim sprite) and its frame (ui_draw_polyline_frame style 0 through six corner points around the grid), a 17x17 icon (texture 0x40005, u 0x55, v 0x20) with duel string 0x2b beside it at scale 12, and the grid at (x + 0x2d, y + 0x18) (ui_grid_select_draw_grid). Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window draw callback).

column2: void ui_attribute_select_draw_text(int x, int y, ushort *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (ui_attribute_select_draw_panel).

column2: void ui_attribute_select_draw_cursor(void *list, int x, int y)
column3: Selected-mark callback of the Attribute grid: draws the 25x24 mark from texture 0x40005 (u 0x1c, v 0x5d) at (x, y). Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (grid descriptor callback).

Opens a plain choice dialog (prompt kind 9): message window with text (style 0x30, set-up 0x098a9750), duel UI mode 4 with argument 0x36, close callback ui_simple_choice_on_decide, sound 0x7a0c. Side effects: message window, UI mode stack, sound. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_show_prompt).
Close callback of the plain choice dialog: sets the engine dialog answer to the message window choice. Side effects: engine answer. No direct caller (message window close callback).

column2: void ui_draw_coin_call_choice(void *list, int x, int y)
column3: Draws a two-way coin choice in the window 0x09bddc8c: the cursor frame, a spinning coin sprite (field_3d_draw_spinning_coin_sprite, 100x100, showing the other face for choice 1), left/right arrows, and below it duel string 0xa (choice 0) or 0xb (choice 1) centred in black at scale 12. The coin and the two strings suggest the coin call (heads/tails) rather than a card choice (hypothesis, confidence medium). Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window draw callback).

column2: void ui_two_way_choice_draw_text(int x, int y, ushort *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_coin_call_choice).

column2: void ui_duel_open_card_row_dialog(ushort *text, int arg_a, int arg_b)
column3: Opens the card row dialog (prompt kind 0xa): clears the 0x14c-byte state 0x09bddc90, clears the entry count 0x09bdddd0, stores arg_a in 0x09bdddd4 and arg_b in 0x09bdddd8, opens the message window with text (style 0x30, set-up 0x098a9a2c), pushes duel UI mode 4 with argument 0x36, installs the close callback 0x098a9acc and the update callback 0x098a9b14 and plays sound 0x7a0c. column2: void * ui_card_row_dialog_draw(void *list, int x, int y)
column3: Draw callback of the card row dialog: draws the 0x09bdddd0 entries (models in 0x09bdddb8) as 40x40 renders centred in a row (field_3d_render_model_to_texture_128); in state 0 (0x09bdddb4) also draws the cursor frame, a 100x100 render of the item under the cursor (index + 1) and left/right arrows below the row; in state 1 draws the confirmation sub-window (ui_card_row_dialog_draw_sub_window). Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window draw callback).

Opens the confirmation sub-window 0x09bddc94 of the card row dialog with the default window settings, text = dialog string 0x24e (card_db_get_dialog_string), caption = duel string 0x2a, margins 20/20/10/10, flags (bit 5 set, bit 2 clear), +0xd4 = 3 and choice style 3. Side effects: writes and opens the sub-window. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).
Updates the card row dialog's sub-window 0x09bddc94 (ui_update_list_window). Side effects: window state. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).

column2: void * ui_card_row_dialog_draw_sub_window(void *list, short x, short y)
column3: Centres the sub-window 0x09bddc94 horizontally on x (x - width/2, width 0x09bddd00) at y and draws it (ui_draw_list_window). Returns the list pointer. Side effects: window position, GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_card_row_dialog_draw).

Opens the effect option list (prompt kind 4): clears the no-option flag 0x09bddde0, opens the message window (caption duel string 0x2c, body text, style 0x30, set-up ui_engine_option_list_setup_window); when the set-up found no window or no enabled option, closes the window again and answers 0 (duel_core_set_dialog_answer(0)); otherwise pushes duel UI mode 4 with argument 0x36, installs ui_engine_option_list_on_decide/ui_engine_option_list_update and plays sound 0x7a0c. Side effects: message window, UI mode stack, engine answer, sound. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_show_prompt).

Set-up callback of the effect option list: before opening reads the engine's option block (duel_core_get_duel_state_block: count +0x0c, 4-byte entries from +0x14 whose low 14 bits are a dialog string number and whose byte +1 bit 7 marks the option usable), marks unusable options in the disabled mask +0xdc, sets one row of count tabs (+0xcc, +0xce), tab width 0x118 / count, height 0x12, bottom margin +0x96 = 0x50 (room for the description), item draw callback ui_engine_option_list_draw_item and +0x10c = 0x098aa804; stores the window in 0x09bddddc and sets 0x09bddde0 when no option is usable. Side effects: writes the window, 0x09bddddc, 0x09bddde0. No direct caller (callback passed to ui_open_message_window).
Close callback of the effect option list: sets the engine dialog answer to the chosen option index. Side effects: engine answer. No direct caller (message window close callback).

column2: void * ui_engine_option_list_draw_item(void *list, uint item, int x, int y)
column3: Item draw callback of the effect option list (tabs): for item 0 also draws the description area below the tabs (frame through ui_draw_polyline_frame and, in a text box, the dialog string of the selected option, black when usable and grey 0xff666666 when not); then draws the tab from texture 0x4001a (left cap, stretched middle and right cap, 8x18 pieces; white for the selected tab, grey 0xff808080 and 2 px lower otherwise; the last tab has its own right cap) and the tab label (duel string 0x10 formatted with item + 1, scale 11x12 for language 5, else 12x12) centred and clipped with a scissor. Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window item callback).

column2: void ui_option_list_draw_text(int x, int y, ushort *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (ui_engine_option_list_draw_item).

Update callback of the effect option list: while pad input is available updates the list window and stores the choice (ui_set_message_window_choice); while the window is open (+0xe9 = 3) L moves to the previous tab and R to the next (ui_list_window_cursor_up/_down, sound 0x7a04). Returns true when the message window is no longer open. Side effects: window state, choice, sound. No direct caller (message window update callback).

column2: void ui_duel_open_number_choice_dialog(ushort *text, int base, int count, int step, int format)
column3: Opens the number choice dialog (prompt kind 0xb): stores base 0x09bddde4, count 0x09bddde8, step 0x09bdddec and the format dialog string number 0x09bdddf0, opens the message window (caption duel string 0x2c, style 0x20, set-up 0x098aa968), pushes duel UI mode 4 with argument 0x36, installs ui_number_choice_on_decide and plays sound 0x7a0c. Side effects: dialog state, message window, UI mode stack, sound. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_show_prompt).

Formats the value of choice index (base 0x09bddde4 + index * step 0x09bdddec) with the dialog string 0x09bdddf0 as format (swprintf) into the buffer 0x09bdddf8 and returns it. Side effects: writes the buffer. Callers: 1 (ui_number_choice_draw_value).

column2: void ui_number_choice_draw_value(void *list, int x, int y)
column3: Draw callback of the number choice dialog: formats the value under the cursor of the window 0x09bdddf4 (ui_number_choice_format_value), draws it centred in black at scale 12 inside a cursor frame, and draws an up arrow above it unless at the first value and a down arrow below it unless at the last. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window draw callback).

column2: void ui_number_choice_draw_text(int x, int y, ushort *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (ui_number_choice_draw_value).

Opens the Type (race) selector (prompt kind 6): builds a grid descriptor (values 1-0x15, 5 columns, caption = a duel string whose index the decompilation hides, labels card_db_get_race_name, item draw 0x098ab1b8, mark draw ui_race_select_draw_cursor, 25x25 cells, exactly one pick), opens the grid (ui_grid_select_open), stores disabled in 0x09bddff8, opens the message window (caption duel string 0x2c, body text, style 0x30, set-up ui_race_select_setup_window), pushes duel UI mode 4 with argument 0x36, installs ui_race_select_update/ui_race_select_on_decide and plays sound 0x7a0c. Side effects: grid state, message window, UI mode stack, sound. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_show_prompt).

Side effects: writes the window and 0x09bddffc. No direct caller (callback passed to ui_open_message_window).

Close callback of the Type selector: answers the lowest picked Type number 1-0x15 from the selection mask (ui_get_list_selection_mask), or 0 when none. Side effects: engine answer. No direct caller (message window close callback).

Update callback of the Type selector: runs the grid input on window 0x09bddffc and returns true when the message window is no longer open. Side effects: grid state. No direct caller (message window update callback).

column2: void ui_race_select_draw_panel(void *list, int x, int y)
column3: Draw callback of the Type selector: panel background and frame as in the Attribute selector, a 17x17 icon (texture 0x40005, u 0x66, v 0x20) with duel string 0x2d beside it, and the grid at (x + 0x2d, y + 0x18). Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window draw callback).

column2: void ui_race_select_draw_text(int x, int y, ushort *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (ui_race_select_draw_panel).

column2: void ui_race_select_draw_cursor(void *list, int x, int y)
column3: Selected-mark callback of the Type grid: draws the 25x24 mark from texture 0x40005 (u 0x1c, v 0x5d) at (x, y). Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (grid descriptor callback).

Draws the L-button shortcut legend on GE layer 9: measures the two 0x60-byte label records at 0x098d2fe8 (ui_label_panel_measure_record), centres the panel on (314, 132) for Japanese or (240, 136) otherwise, draws its nine-slice frame from texture 0x40026 with a title tab (pieces of 4, 0x24 and 9 px, an icon 23x11) and the title text at 0x098d30a8, then draws both records (ui_label_panel_draw_record: badge plus four labels). Side effects: GE commands on layer 9. Callers: 1 (ui_field_cursor_mode_draw).

column2: void ui_label_panel_draw_text(int x, int y, ushort *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_draw_label_panel).

Measures the duel string label[0] in a 480x272 text box (system_font_measure_text_box(0x7800, 0x4400, …)) and stores its width and height in pixels (rounded up). Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 3 (ui_duel_draw_label_panel, ui_label_panel_draw_label, ui_label_panel_measure_record).

Size of a legend record (four 0x18-byte labels): width = label 2 width + |label 2 dx (+0x38)| + label 3 width + |label 3 dx (+0x50)|, height = label 0 height + |label 0 dy (+0x0c)| + label 1 height + |label 1 dy (+0x24)|. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_draw_label_panel).

column2: void * ui_label_panel_draw_badge(void *list, int x, int y, int variant)
column3: Draws the 47x38 button badge of a legend record from texture 0x40026 centred near (x, y) (u = (1 - variant) * 0x2f). Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_label_panel_draw_record).

Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_label_panel_draw_record).

column2: void ui_label_panel_draw_record(void *list, int x, int y, int variant, void *record)
column3: Draws a legend record: the badge (ui_label_panel_draw_badge, arguments passed through) and its four labels at record +0, +0x18, +0x30, +0x48 (ui_label_panel_draw_label). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_draw_label_panel).

column2: void ui_duel_open_card_yes_no_dialog(ushort *text, uint instance, int show_other)
