Side effects: dialog state, message window, UI mode stack, sound. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_show_prompt).
Close callback of the card yes/no dialog: answers (choice != 0). Side effects: engine answer. No direct caller (message window close callback).

column2: uint * ui_card_position_choice_draw_item(void *list, short item, int x, int y)
column3: Item draw callback of the card yes/no dialog: item 0 draws the card 0x09bde000 upright (31x44) with duel string 0x24 below it, item 1 draws it sideways (44x31, flipped; face-down art when 0x09bde004 is 0) with duel string 0x25 (attack/defence position choice: hypothesis, confidence medium); text is centred in black at scale 12 with wrap-space trimming outside Japanese. Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window item callback).

Clears the flag-message signal 0x09bde00c, opens the info panel with text, installs the close test 0x098abfb8 (presumably waiting for that signal) and sets byte +8 of the info panel descriptor to 3. Side effects: info panel, 0x09bde00c. Callers: 1 (ui_flag_message_mode_enter).
Resets the card action menu (ui_card_action_menu_reset_a) and the card info menu state (ui_clear_card_info_menu_state_a). Side effects: those menu states. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_draw_init).

Resets the card action menu (ui_card_action_menu_reset_b), frees the card name picker and clears the card info menu state (ui_clear_card_info_menu_state_b). Side effects: those states, heap release. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_draw_term).
Resets the card list windows, frees the message window and the grid confirm window. Side effects: window states, heap release. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_draw_reset).

Resets the two card list windows 0x09bde010 (main list) and 0x09bde130 (sort/command/filter sub-window) with ui_list_window_reset. Side effects: window states. Callers: 1 (ui_close_card_list_and_dialogs).

Initialises the card list picker from a request {count, unused, card id array, browse flag, title or NULL}: clears the 0x2ca8-byte state 0x09bde010, copies up to 0x200 ids to 0x09bde458, sets ascending sort (0x09be0c78 = 1, key 0x09be0c74 = 0), builds the filtered list 0x09bdec5c (ui_card_list_filter_by_frame, count 0x09bdec58), copies it to the display list 0x09bdf45c and sorts it, copies the title (or duel string 4) to 0x09bde250, configures and opens the main list window 0x09bde010 (5 visible rows of 0x14 px, 0x31 x 0x98 item area, item draw 0x098ac968, extra callback 0x098ad078, x 0xbb) and plays sound 0x7a0c. Side effects: picker state, window opened, sound. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_open_card_list_picker).

column2: void ui_duel_open_card_list_picker(int max_picks, int min_picks, ushort *title, int browse)
column3: Opens the card list picker over the engine's candidate list: clamps max_picks and min_picks to the candidate count (duel_core_get_candidate_count), collects the card ids (low 14 bits of duel_core_get_candidate_entry), initialises the picker (ui_card_list_picker_init with title and browse), pushes duel UI mode 2, sets the picker decide callback 0x09bdd0ec = ui_card_list_picker_on_decide, mode argument 0x36, and the pick range (ui_card_list_picker_set_select_range(min, max)). Side effects: picker state, UI mode stack. Callers: 1 (ui_cmd_open_card_list).

Draw step of duel UI mode 2: draws the main list window 0x09bde010 and, by the sub-menu state 0x09be0c70, the sort menu (1), command menu (2) or filter menu (3). Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller: entry of the duel UI mode table 0x098d1f5c.

Update step of duel UI mode 2. Sets window flag +0xc8 bit 2 when any pick is required or made. While the window is open: sub-menu 3/2/1 run the filter, command or sort menus (command result 3 opens the filter menu, 2 the sort menu, 1 returns); with no sub-menu, triangle opens the command menu; on the list (0x09bde450 = 0) the list window is updated, a new cursor row previews its card (ui_card_list_picker_preview_entry), confirm toggles the pick (ui_card_list_picker_toggle_selection), cancel undoes the last pick, down at the end (or an empty list) moves to the bottom button; on the bottom button, up returns to the list, and in browse mode (no picks required) confirm/cancel close, otherwise confirm closes when enough cards are picked (sound 0x7a05; error 0x7a07 if not) and cancel undoes a pick and returns to the list. Side effects: picker state, windows, sounds. No direct caller: entry of the duel UI mode table 0x098d1f5c.
Returns 0 when the main list window state byte 0x09bde0f9 (+0xe9) is 0, 1 or 6, else 1. No side effects. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).
Copies the picked entry indices 0x09be046c (count 0x09be0468) to out when non-NULL and returns the count. Side effects: writes out. Callers: 1 (ui_card_list_picker_on_decide).

column2: int ui_draw_card_list_menu_text(int x, int y, int width, ushort *text)
column3: Read from the disassembly (Ghidra shows an empty body): pixel-to-font-unit wrapper that shifts x, y and width left by 6 (1/64-pixel units) and tail-jumps to the import stub of system_font_draw_text_fit_width(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text, -1) (vram_offset -1 in t0). Returns that result. Side effects: those of system_font_draw_text_fit_width (glyph cache, text sprites). Callers: 1 (ui_card_list_draw_command_item).
Returns word +4 of the frame timing block (system_get_frame_timing). No side effects. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).

Shows the card of display row row in the card info panel: the candidate's visible card id (duel_core_get_candidate_visible_card_id; -1 when not positive) and, when it differs, its name id (duel_core_get_candidate_name_id) as second argument, else 0 (ui_card_info_show_card_id). Side effects: card info panel. Callers: 1 (ui_card_list_picker_update).

Toggles the candidate of display row row in the pick list 0x09be046c: a picked entry is removed (later picks shift down, sound 0x7a06); otherwise it is appended while fewer than the maximum 0x09be0460 are picked (sound 0x7a05; reaching the maximum moves the cursor to the bottom button), else the error sound 0x7a07 plays. Side effects: pick list and count, 0x09bde450, window flags, sounds. Callers: 1 (ui_card_list_picker_update).

Removes the last pick (sound 0x7a06); with no picks closes the list window (sound 0x7a06) unless window flag +0xc8 bit 2 (picks required) is set, which plays the error sound 0x7a07. Callers pass a row index that the body does not use. Side effects: pick count, window, sounds. Callers: 1 (ui_card_list_picker_update).

Decide callback of the card list picker: gets the picks (ui_card_list_picker_get_selection), sets the engine's selected candidate to the first (duel_core_set_selected_candidate_index), answers the pick count (duel_core_set_dialog_answer) and records the pick order 1..n of each pick (duel_core_set_candidate_pick_order). Side effects: engine candidate state and answer. No direct caller (stored in 0x09bdd0ec by ui_duel_open_card_list_picker).

column2: void ui_draw_number_up_to_9999(void *list, int x, int y, int value)
column3: Draws value (clamped to 9999) right-aligned from x + 0x15 with 7 px per digit at scale 10x12 through the font's external list, or the text at 0x098d30fc when value is negative. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).

column2: void ui_draw_number_digit_text(int x, int y, char *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_number_up_to_9999).

Scans the 11 (mask, value) pairs at 0x098d3100 in order and writes to out[0] and out[1] the values of the first two pairs whose mask intersects flags (fewer when fewer match). Side effects: writes out. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).

column2: void ui_draw_hud_atlas_icon16(void *list, int x, int y, int index)
column3: Draws icon index of the 16x16 atlas in texture 0x40005 (u = (index % 8) * 16, v = (index / 8) * 16) at (x, y). Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).

Opens the sort menu in the sub-window 0x09bde130: default window settings, caption duel string 0x5f, 17x17 items drawn by ui_card_list_draw_sort_item, 10 items in a row, position (0xf0, 0x32); saves the display list (0x09bdfc60, count 0x09bdfc5c) and the sort key/order (0x09be0c7c, 0x09be0c80) for cancel; sound 0x7a08. Side effects: sub-window, saved state, sound. Callers: 1 (ui_card_list_picker_update).

Update of the sort menu: while it stays open (update returns -1) and its transition is done, up/down (0x50) toggles ascending/descending 0x09be0c78 and moving the cursor changes the sort key 0x09be0c74; on either change the display list is restored and re-sorted (ui_card_list_sort). On close (-2 = cancel restores the saved list, key and order) closes the sub-window and returns 1; otherwise returns 0. Side effects: sort state, display list, sound 0x7a04. Callers: 1 (ui_card_list_picker_update).
Draws the sub-window 0x09bde130 (ui_draw_list_window) and returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_card_list_picker_draw).

column2: void ui_card_list_draw_sort_item(void *list, uint item, int x, int y)
column3: Item draw callback of the sort menu: draws the 17x17 sort-key icon of item (ui_card_list_draw_sort_icon) and, for the item under the cursor, a framed box below it (grey shadow, then a translucent box offset by 4 px with ui_draw_frame_style_quad and ui_draw_polyline_frame) showing the sort order icon (ui_card_list_draw_sort_order_icon, ascending flag 0x09be0c78). Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window item callback).

column2: void ui_card_list_draw_sort_icon(void *list, int x, int y, int key)
column3: Draws the 17x17 icon of sort key key at (x, y) with texture coordinates from the (u, v) short pairs at 0x098d3158 + key * 4. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_card_list_draw_sort_item).

column2: void ui_card_list_draw_sort_order_icon(void *list, int x, int y, int ascending)
column3: Draws the 17x17 ascending/descending icon at (x, y) with texture coordinates from 0x098d3180 (entry 1 when ascending is non-zero, else entry 0). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_card_list_draw_sort_item).

column2: void ui_card_list_sort(int *rows, uint count, int key, int ascending)
column3: Sorts a list of candidate indices by a sort key: builds 8-byte records {u16 index, u16 original position, u32 key} on the duel draw heap with ui_card_list_get_sort_key(index, card id 0x09bde458[index], key), sorts them with qsort (comparator 0x098ae2e0 when ascending, 0x098ae36c otherwise), writes the indices back and frees the records. Side effects: rewrites rows, temporary heap block. Callers: 3 (ui_card_list_update_sort_menu, ui_card_list_picker_init, ui_card_list_update_filter_menu).

column2: uint ui_card_list_get_sort_key(uint index, int card_id, int key)
column3: Sort key of candidate index (card card_id) for the card list: 0 when the candidate is hidden (duel_core_get_candidate_visible_card_id < 1); key 0 list order (index, or 0x200 - index when the browse flag 0x09be0cb4 is set), 1 card_db_get_sort_position, 2 card_db_get_frame, 3 0xffff - level, 4 0xffff - ATK and 5 0xffff - DEF (0 for the value 0xffff), 6 card_db_get_race, 7 card_db_get_attribute (keys 3-7 for monsters only), 8 a rank of card_db_get_icon from the byte tables 0x098d3188 (frame 7) or 0x098d3190 (frame 8) for Spells/Traps; 9 the current card limit (deck_get_current_card_limit); keys that do not apply to the card return 0xffff7fff (sorted last). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_card_list_sort).

Returns 1 when the picker is browse-only (minimum 0x09be0464 and maximum 0x09be0460 both 0) or at least the minimum number of cards is picked (0x09be0468), else 0. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_card_list_picker_update).

Opens the picker's command menu in the sub-window 0x09bde130: builds the item list (ui_card_list_build_command_menu), applies the window defaults with margins 2, no caption, item count and visible rows from 0x09be0cac, item width = widest label 0x09be0cb0 + 0x12, height 0x11, item draw ui_card_list_draw_command_item; opens it and centres it horizontally on the main list window, 0x1e px above the main window's lower edge; sound 0x7a08. Side effects: sub-window, sound. Callers: 1 (ui_card_list_picker_update).

Update of the picker's command menu: returns 0 while open; on a choice runs it by item kind (0x09be0c8c): 0 view the card under the list cursor (card viewer id, push duel UI mode 5 with argument 0x36), 1 return value 2 (open the sort menu), 2 return value 3 (open the filter menu), 3 options mode, 4 help mode; a cancel (-2) or kinds 0/3/4 return 1. Closes the menu (ui_card_list_close_command_menu) on any result. Side effects: menu state, UI mode stack. Callers: 1 (ui_card_list_picker_update).
Draws the sub-window 0x09bde130 (ui_draw_list_window) and returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_card_list_picker_draw).

column2: void ui_card_list_draw_command_item(void *list, uint item, int x, int y)
column3: Item draw callback of the picker's command menu: for the item kind (0x09be0c8c) draws its 13x13 icon from texture 0x40005 at the (u, v) of the 16-byte record 0x098d30b0 + kind * 0x10 and its label (duel string of the record) in black at scale 12 through the text helper ui_draw_card_list_menu_text (x + 15, y + 1, width 0x7c). Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window item callback).

Builds the picker's command list in 0x09be0c8c: 0 view card (only when the cursor is on the list and the candidate's card is visible), then 1 sort and 2 filter, 3 options (unless setup mode 2), 4 help (when ui_can_open_duel_help); stores the count in 0x09be0cac and the widest label width at scale 12 (labels from 0x098d30b8 + kind * 0x10) in 0x09be0cb0. Side effects: writes 0x09be0c8c-0x09be0cb3. Callers: 1 (ui_card_list_open_command_menu).

column2: int ui_card_list_filter_by_frame(int *out, int count, int filter)
column3: Fills out with the indices 0..count-1 of the picker's entries that pass a frame filter: filter 0 keeps all; otherwise keeps the entries whose card frame (card_db_get_frame of 0x09bde458[i]) equals the word 0x098d3198 + filter * 4, plus hidden candidates. Returns the number kept. Side effects: writes out. Callers: 2 (ui_card_list_picker_init, ui_card_list_update_filter_menu).

Opens the picker's filter menu in the sub-window 0x09bde130: caption duel string 0x4b, 8 items in a row of 17x17 icons drawn by ui_card_list_draw_filter_item, position (0xf0, 0x32); saves the display list and the current filter (0x09be0c88 = 0x09be0c84) for cancel; sound 0x7a08. Side effects: sub-window, saved state, sound. Callers: 1 (ui_card_list_picker_update).

Update of the filter menu: while open, a cursor move to a new filter rebuilds the filtered list (ui_card_list_filter_by_frame), re-sorts the display list, updates the main window's item count and resets its cursor when out of range, returning 0; on close (a cancel -2 first restores the saved filter the same way) closes the sub-window and returns 1. Side effects: picker lists, window state. Callers: 1 (ui_card_list_picker_update).
Draws the sub-window 0x09bde130 (ui_draw_list_window) and returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_card_list_picker_draw).

column2: void ui_card_list_draw_filter_item(void *list, short item, int x, int y)
column3: Item draw callback of the filter menu: binds texture 0x40006 and draws the filter's icon (ui_card_list_draw_filter_icon). Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window item callback).

column2: void ui_card_list_draw_filter_icon(void *list, int x, int y, int filter)
column3: Draws the 17x17 icon of filter at (x, y) with texture coordinates from the (u, v) short pairs at 0x098d31b8 + filter * 4. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_card_list_draw_filter_item).
Clears the 0xa0-byte card action menu state 0x09be0cb8 and the auto-choose callback 0x09be0d58. Side effects: writes 0x09be0cb8-0x09be0d5b. Callers: 1 (ui_reset_card_menus_a).

Clears the 0xa0-byte card action menu state 0x09be0cb8 and the auto-choose callback 0x09be0d58 (same body as ui_card_action_menu_reset_a). Side effects: writes 0x09be0cb8-0x09be0d5b. Callers: 1 (ui_reset_card_menus_b).

Opens the action menu for the card at the location given by the request's callback (request[0], e.g. ui_field_cursor_get_location): stores the source (ui_card_action_store_source), clears the item count, width and window, reads the card id (duel_core_view_get_location_card_id, 0x09be0d50) and builds the action list (ui_card_action_build_list). When an auto-choose callback 0x09be0d58 returns n > 0, executes action n - 1 at once. Otherwise: no actions plays the error sound 0x7a07; a list made only of table entries 0xb/0xd that starts with 0xb executes directly (sound 0x7a05); else opens the message window (style 0x20, set-up ui_card_action_setup_window), pushes duel UI mode 4 (argument 0x36 unless setup mode 2), installs ui_card_action_on_decide, ui_card_action_layout_callback and ui_card_action_update, sets the window word 0x09bdd3e8, plays sound 0x7a08 and shows the card info of the targeted card (top card of the Graveyard/banished pile; deck and Extra Deck as the pile) when it may be viewed or its object has byte +0x8d bit 5 set. Side effects: menu state, message window, UI mode stack, card info, sounds, possibly an answer. Callers: 2 (ui_cmd_begin_player_input, ui_field_cursor_mode_update).

column2: void ui_card_action_draw_icon(void *list, int x, int y, int entry)
column3: Draws the 13x13 icon of action table entry entry from texture 0x40005 at the (u, v) of the 16-byte record 0x098d31d8 + entry * 0x10. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 2 (ui_card_action_draw_item, ui_field_cursor_draw_action_icons).

Set-up callback of the card action menu window: before opening rebuilds the action list, clears flag +0xc8 bit 2, sets item count and visible rows to the action count, item size 100 x 15, item draw ui_card_action_draw_item, +0x56 = 1 and margins 2; after opening sets the item width (+0xf0, +0xf8) to the widest label 0x09be0d40 + 0x12, the window width accordingly, stores the window in 0x09be0d44 and clamps y at 0. Side effects: writes the window and 0x09be0d44. No direct caller (callback passed to ui_open_message_window).

Builds the card action list: gets the source location (callback 0x09be0cb8), its action mask (ui_card_action_get_mask, stored in 0x09be0d4c), and lists the indices of the 16 action table entries (0x098d31d8, 16-byte records; bit number at +0x0c) whose bit is set, in 0x09be0cc0 (up to 0x20); measures the labels (ui_card_action_get_label of record +0x08) and lowers the font x-scale from 12 until the widest label is at most 300 px; stores the width 0x09be0d40, scale 0x09be0d54 and count 0x09be0cbc. Side effects: writes the menu state. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer; also called by ui_card_action_setup_window and ui_duel_open_card_action_menu).

Positions the card action window 0x09be0d44 over its card, as ui_card_info_menu_place_at_card does: projects the hand object's position or the location transform (field_3d_board_get_location_transform) through the GU projection, view and model matrices (sceVfpuMatrix4Mul/Transform) to screen x = px * 480 / w + 314, y = -py * 272 / w + 132; centres the window above that point (20 px plus its height), clamps x to [0x94, 480 - width] and y at 0, and sets the pointer offset +0x74 clamped to [4, width - 4]. Does nothing without a window. Side effects: writes the window position. Callers: 1 (ui_card_action_layout_callback).

Close callback of the card action menu: for a choice >= 0 (0x09be0d48) executes the action code (record +0x0c of the chosen table entry) at the source location (ui_card_action_execute). Side effects: those of ui_card_action_execute. No direct caller (message window close callback).

Executes a card action at a location code: actions below 0xd are submitted to the engine (ui_submit_player_action(side, zone, index, action, 0)); 0xd pushes duel UI mode 5 (card viewer); 0xf puts the duelist's chosen card on top of the deck (duel_core_stack_deck_card_on_top(turn side, ui_get_duelist_setup_block(side's duelist))) and submits action 0xc; 0xe and others do nothing. Side effects: engine input or deck state, UI mode stack. Callers: 2 (ui_card_action_on_decide, ui_duel_open_card_action_menu).

Draw callback of the card action menu: places the window over its card (ui_card_action_place_at_card) and returns list unchanged. Side effects: window position. No direct caller (message window draw callback).

column2: void ui_card_action_draw_item(void *list, uint item, int x, int y)
column3: Item draw callback of the card action menu: draws the action's icon (ui_card_action_draw_icon) and its label (ui_card_action_get_label of record +0x08) in black at the fitted x-scale 0x09be0d54 and y-scale 12, 15 px to the right. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window item callback).

column2: void ui_card_action_draw_text(int x, int y, ushort *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (ui_card_action_draw_item).

Returns the action mask of the card at a location code: the engine's mask (duel_core_view_get_card_action_mask) plus 0x2000 (view card) when the location's card (top of Extra Deck 0xc or deck 0xd, hand card, field slot; none for piles 0xe/0xf) exists and may be viewed (ui_can_view_card_at_ref; the card viewer id is set to it as a side effect), plus 0x8000 when the mask has 0x1000 and the duelist's chosen card can be stacked (duel_core_view_can_stack_deck_card). Side effects: card viewer id. Callers: 1 (ui_card_action_build_list).

Update callback of the card action menu: while pad input is available, R (new press 0x200) on an open window whose mask has 0x1000 chooses the item of table entry 0xc directly (sound 0x7a05); then updates the list window and stores the choice in 0x09be0d48. Returns true when the message window is no longer open. Side effects: window state, choice, sound. No direct caller (message window update callback).

Returns duel string label, replacing labels 0x20, and 0x1f for a non-monster card 0x09be0d50, by 0x1e unless both mask bits 0x40 and 0x80 are set in 0x09be0d4c. No side effects. Callers: 2 (ui_card_action_draw_item, ui_card_action_build_list).

column2: void * ui_draw_nine_slice_frame(void *list, int x, int y, int width, int height, void *gim)
column3: Draws a nine-slice frame of width x height at (x, y) from gim (corners 4/5 px from texture rows 0x36, 0x3a, 0x3b, edges and centre stretched); does nothing when gim is NULL. Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 2 (ui_draw_portrait_expression_picker, ui_duel_draw_label_panel).

Opens the duel options screen: allocates the 0x3c-byte state from heap (system_heap_alloc, pointer 0x09be0d5c) and clears it; +0 variant, +0x1c heap, +0x20 archive; captures the current settings twice (+8 working copy, +0x10 copy restored on cancel; ui_duel_options_capture_settings); sets the cursor and first item (u16 +4/+6) to 0 (variants 0 and 2) or 3 (variant 1) and the three colours +0x30/+0x34/+0x38 per variant; finds the variant's menu texture (one of three 0x40-byte names at 0x098d32d8, menu_opt01.gim first) in the archive and stores it at +0x24. Side effects: heap block, 0x09be0d5c. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_options_mode_enter).

Packs the current settings into the 8-byte options record: byte 0 bit 0 save_test_setting_b0_bit3, bits 1-2 save_get_setting_b0_bits4_5, bits 3-4 save_get_setting_b1_bits3_4 (animation speed), bit 5 option flag 0 (cut-ins), bit 6 option flag 5, bit 7 option flag 2; byte 1 bits 0-1 save_get_setting_b2_bits1_2, bit 2 option flag 4, bit 3 option flag 3; u16 +2, +4, +6 the volume settings 2, 0 and 1 (audio_get_volume_setting). Side effects: writes out. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_options_open).

Writes an 8-byte options record (layout of ui_duel_options_capture_settings) back to the save settings and option flags and sets the three volume settings (audio_set_volume_setting 2, 0, 1). Side effects: save settings, audio volumes. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_options_update).

Input of the duel options screen (state at 0x09be0d5c, settings record at +8, saved copy at +0x10): confirm applies the settings and returns 2 (sound 0x7a05); cancel restores the saved copy, applies it and returns 2 (sound 0x7a06); up/down move the cursor (u16 +4) over items 0-0xb with wrap, skipping item 2 outside Japanese and item 7 in variant 1; left/right change the item: 0 byte0 bit 0 (left sets, right clears), 1 bits 1-2 (0-2), 2/3/4 the volumes 2/0/1 (0-15, applied at once, item 2 with sound 0x7a0a), 5 the animation speed (0-3), 6/7/8 the option bits 5/6/7 (left sets, right clears), 9 byte1 bits 0-1 (0-2), 10 byte1 bit 2 (right sets), 11 byte1 bit 3 (left sets); sound 0x7a04. Sets the redraw byte +0x18, advances the 24-bit frame counter +0x2c and returns 1. Side effects: options state, live volume changes, save settings on exit, sounds. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_options_mode_update).
Copies the 8-byte options settings record (four u16) from src to dest and returns dest. Side effects: writes dest. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_options_update).

Draw step of the duel options screen (state 0x09be0d5c): sets up the render state with the menu texture (ui_duel_options_set_render_state), then for the item groups of the variant (variant 1 skips the first two groups; the per-group item counts come from the table 0x098d3408, 0x098d3418 adjusted per variant) draws each group's nine-slice panel (ui_draw_nine_slice_from_table, styles from 0x098d3398/0x098d33a8), the item frames (ui_duel_options_draw_section_frame), the cursor (ui_duel_options_draw_cursor), the item values (ui_duel_options_draw_item_value), the labels (ui_duel_options_draw_item_label, ui_duel_options_draw_value_label) and the help bar; the panel starts at x 0x6d (0x29 in variant 2) and y 0x22/0x36/0x17 by variant, 6 px lower outside Japanese; finally clears the redraw byte +0x18. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (draw step reached through the options mode, table 0x098d1f5c).

column2: void ui_duel_options_draw_cursor(void *list, int x, int y)
column3: Draws the options cursor: maps the cursor item (u16 +4) to its group (0, 1, 2 for items 2-4, 3 for 5-0xb), adds 14 px for every multi-item group up to it and 10 px per preceding group, adjusts for the skipped items of the variant, and draws a 0xfa-wide cursor frame at y + (row - first item) * 12 + 1 (ui_duel_options_draw_cursor_frame style 0). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_options_draw).

column2: void * ui_duel_options_draw_item_value(void *list, int group, int row, int x, int y)
column3: Draws the value control of one options item: group 0 an on/off frame for byte0 bit 0; group 1 a three-way choice for bits 1-2 (ui_duel_options_draw_choice_pair, highlighted when the cursor is on item 1); group 2 the three volume level bars (ui_duel_options_draw_level_item); group 3 the speed choice (4 values), the option bits as on/off frames, and the byte1 choices (3 and 2 values) for rows 5/6, with the row mapping shifted in variant 1. Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_options_draw).

column2: void ui_duel_options_draw_cursor_frame(void *list, int x, int y, int is_toggle, int on)
column3: Draws an options frame with ui_draw_nine_slice_from_table: the 0xfa x 0xb row cursor (style 8) when is_toggle is 0, otherwise a 0x28 x 0xb toggle box (style 0xb) at x + 3 when on, x + 0x2d when off. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 2 (ui_duel_options_draw_cursor, ui_duel_options_draw_item_value).

column2: void ui_draw_nine_slice_from_table(void *list, int x, int y, int width, int height, int style)

column2: void ui_duel_help_open(int topic, void *heap, void *gim, void *topic_table, void *label_table)
column3: Opens the duel help viewer on topic: clears the 300-byte state 0x09be0e4c, stores topic, heap, gim, the window01.gim of the icon archive, the two string tables; selects the topic group layout (ui_duel_help_get_topic_group: group 1 for topics 0xd-0x18 uses the index table 0x098c620c and image table 0x098d3c70 with range values 0xe/0xc/0xf/0x62/0x52/0xd/0x54, group 0 uses 0x098c61d8 and 0x098d3910 with 0xf/0xd/0x10/0x6b/0x5a/0/0x5c); creates the full-screen background window (480 x 272), opens the topic list, loads the index list and topic text, opens the footer, deactivates both lists and starts a 16-frame fade-in. Side effects: help viewer state 0x09be0e4c-0x09be0f77, window lists, fade. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_help_mode_update).

Per-frame update of the help viewer: updates the topic and index lists; state 0x09be0e64: 0 waits for the fade-in (then 1), 1 handles input (ui_duel_help_read_input: 3 starts a fade-out to state 2, 2 focuses the text, 1 opens the topic list over the index), 2 waits for the fade (then 3), 3 returns 1 (finished). In text focus it scrolls the text with the stick; in topic focus a cursor change reloads the index and text of the new topic, and a closed topic list returns focus (restoring the index cursor on cancel). An index cursor change reloads the text; when the page's image index changes, frees the previous image and loads the new one (path built with sprintf from 0x098d3dc8, container_get_file_size and container_load_file from root 3 into a heap block, completion 0x098b3cb8). Returns 0 while running. Side effects: help state, heap blocks, file loads, fades. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_help_mode_update).

Draws the help viewer: header, text pane, index list, a translucent black overlay (0x80000000 over 3, 0x1e, 0x1d9 x 0xee) when the topic list has focus, footer, topic list, and the screen fade. Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_help_mode_draw).

Closes the help viewer: returns 0 while an image load is pending (0x09be0e7c == -1); otherwise closes the topic list, index list, text pane and footer, frees the background window list and the image block, clears the 300-byte state and returns 1. Side effects: window lists, heap, state. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_help_mode_exit).

Reads the help viewer buttons: 3 for start (close), and while the text has focus (0x09be0e68 == 1) 3 for cancel and 1 for triangle (open the topic list); 0 otherwise. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_help_update).

Loads the index (page) list of topic: with the (first, last) pair of the topic's 4-byte record in the index table 0x09be0eac, opens the index list (ui_duel_help_open_index_list with the viewer's heap, textures and tables) when reuse is 0, or only changes its range (ui_duel_help_set_index_range); resets the page cursor 0x09be0e70. Side effects: index list state. Callers: 2 (ui_duel_help_update, ui_duel_help_open).

Loads the text of the current page: string number = page 0x09be0e70 + first entry of the topic's record (index table 0x09be0eac, topic - 0x09be0ea4) + offset 0x09be0ea8 in the topic string table (card_db_get_dictionary_word); opens the text pane (reuse 0) or replaces its body, then updates the page index. Side effects: text pane state. Callers: 2 (ui_duel_help_update, ui_duel_help_open).

Computes the global page number 0x09be0e80 = page 0x09be0e70 + the topic's first entry - (0x09be0e98 + 1) (index into the image table). Side effects: writes 0x09be0e80. Callers: 2 (ui_duel_help_load_topic_text, ui_duel_help_update).

Draws the help header: background window list, a 0x1d9 x 0x1a bar (0xffa0cedf) and a 1-px line (0xff48a3be), an icon from the help texture (u 0x20, v 0, 9 x 0xe) at (10, 10) and the title (label string 8) with the header font through ui_draw_help_header_text. In the sort sub-menu (0x09be0c70 == 2, list inactive) it records the position of the cursor item in 0x09bde188/0x09bde18a. Returns the display list. Side effects: GE commands, 0x09bde188/0x09bde18a. No direct caller (installed by ui_card_list_picker_init 0x098ac074).

Extra draw callback of the card list picker window 0x09bde010: below the content (ui_window_measure_content_bottom) draws duel string 0x5e with the current sort key icon (0x09be0c74) and order icon (0x09be0c78), and when a filter is set (0x09be0c84) duel string 0x4b with the filter icon; then a horizontal scroll bar with pulsing arrows for the visible range (top 0x09bde0e0, visible 0x09bde0de, total 0x09bde0dc); then the button of the window (ui_draw_list_window_button, highlighted when 0x09bde450 is set) labelled duel string 9 (no minimum/maximum picks) or 0x13, in grey until enough cards are picked (ui_card_list_picker_has_enough_selected); German text uses font scale 10 x 12. No return value (the decompiler shows none). Side effects: GE commands, font state. No direct caller (installed by ui_card_list_picker_init 0x098ac074).

Comparator of the 8-byte sort records {u16 index, u16 original position, s32 key} built by the card list sort: the key at +4 orders the records ascending, a key of -0x8001 always sorts last, and equal keys are ordered by the position +2 ascending (stable). Returns -1, 0 or 1. No side effects. No direct caller (passed to system_qsort by the card list picker sort).

Comparator of the 8-byte sort records {u16 index, u16 original position, s32 key} built by the card list sort: the key at +4 orders the records descending, a key of -0x8001 always sorts last, and equal keys are ordered by the position +2 descending (stable). Returns -1, 0 or 1. No side effects. No direct caller (passed to system_qsort by the card list picker sort).

Frees the duel options block *0x09be0d5c with the heap stored at its +0x1c (system_heap_free). No return value. Side effects: heap release (the pointer is not cleared). No direct caller (tail-jumped to by 0x098a26f4, the exit entry of duel UI mode 9 in the table 0x098d1f5c).

Load-completion callback of a duel help page image: returns 0 when size < 1; otherwise, when the requested image index 0x09be0e80 still equals *request, attaches the loaded image 0x09be0e78 to the text pane (ui_help_text_set_image) and records the index in 0x09be0e7c; when the page changed meanwhile it frees the image block from the help heap 0x09be0e50, detaches the image and sets 0x09be0e7c = -2. Returns 1. Side effects: 0x09be0e78/0x09be0e7c, heap, help text pane. No direct caller (passed to container_load_file by ui_duel_help_update 0x098b3494).
